About the Role

Okta is seeking a highly analytical and forward-thinking Global Paid Search Marketing Manager with exceptional Martech integration skills to join our Global Digital Acquisition Team.

In this role, you won't just manage campaigns, you will own our search portfolio's evolution. You will be responsible for moving beyond traditional lead-gen metrics to implement advanced Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models that align search spend directly with downstream pipeline value. Leveraging cutting-edge AI capabilities and robust statistical testing, you will maintain complete visibility over all in-market campaigns, ensuring every dollar spent is backed by data and optimized for maximum business impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Value-Based Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive, AI-driven paid search strategies across Google Ads and Bing Ads. Lead the transition to and optimization of Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models to prioritize high-value pipeline and revenue over raw lead volume.
  • AI Integration & Innovation: Proactively leverage AI and machine learning capabilities within search platforms (e.g., Smart Bidding, Broad Match + Smart Bidding loops, AI-powered ad assets and campaign types) to scale performance, uncover hidden demand, and push our strategy past the industry curve.
  • Rigorous Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze structured A/B and multivariate tests (bidding, copy, landing pages). Champion a scientific approach, ensuring all test outcomes are measured for statistical significance before scaling.
  • Holistic In-Market Reporting: Maintain a unified, real-time view of all in-market campaigns. Deliver clear, executive-ready reporting that tracks performance across the entire funnel from click to closed-won revenue ensuring complete transparency of our search footprint.
  • Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo). Ensure accurate offline conversion tracking (OCT) to feed VBB algorithms high-quality feedback loops.
  • Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
  • Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
  • Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.

Qualifications

  • Education: BA or BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.
  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven track record of using statistical significance models to validate test results and drive data-backed decisions.
  • VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
  • AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
  • Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
  • Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.

Position Overview:
The Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will play a key role in building and managing Kubernetes platforms that support cloud-native applications and services. This position focuses on architecting and managing reliable, scalable, and secure Kubernetes-based platforms on AWS, ensuring high availability and performance while optimising costs and automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes platform creation, Helm charts, Karpenter scaling, and Istio service mesh.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Kubernetes Platform Creation: Design, implement, and maintain highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant Kubernetes platforms. Ensure clusters are optimised for production workloads, providing high resilience and operational efficiency.
  • AWS Infrastructure Management: Build, manage, and optimise AWS cloud infrastructure, including EKS, ECS, S3, VPCS, RDS, IAM, and more. Implement best practices for cost management, scaling, and security within AWS.
  • Helm Management: Utilise Helm to automate and streamline the deployment of applications and services to Kubernetes clusters. Create, maintain, and manage Helm charts for production-ready deployments.
  • Karpenter Implementation: Implement and manage Karpenter to dynamically scale Kubernetes clusters in response to workload demands. 
  • Istio Service Mesh Management: Configure and manage Istio to provide service-to-service communication, security, and observability within the Kubernetes clusters. Enable fine-grained traffic management, service discovery, and policy enforcement.
  • Platform Automation & Scaling: Automate the deployment, scaling, and management of infrastructure and applications. Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure a seamless flow from development to production with minimal downtime.
  • Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues related to performance, availability, and security in a timely and effective manner.
  • Security & Compliance: Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure with appropriate access controls, network security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain detailed documentation for Kubernetes platform setup, operational procedures, and best practices. Promote knowledge sharing across teams.
Required Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of experience with Kubernetes/ K8s, Helm,Karpenter,Istio;
  • 8+ years of Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Chef or  Ansible
  • 8+ years of Experience with serverless computing (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) and microservices architecture.
  • Proven experience with AWS (EKS, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFormation, IAM, etc.) and solid understanding of cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes platform creation, management, and optimisation (e.g., setting up highly available clusters, networking, and storage).

  • Practical experience with Karpenter for dynamic scaling of Kubernetes clusters and optimising resource usage.
  • Expertise in managing and securing Istio for service mesh, including traffic management, security, and observability features.
  • Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI, Terraform, Spinnaker, Ansible).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Go for infrastructure management and platform automation.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and ELK Stack.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with multi-region cloud environments.
  • Understanding of security best practices for cloud platforms and Kubernetes (e.g., role-based access control (RBAC), encryption, and compliance frameworks).
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerization principles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).

The AI Journey Operations Manager will own the business strategy, qualification framework, routing logic, operating model, and performance optimization for AI-assisted xDR capabilities across the Global Demand Center.

It is a senior, cross-functional capability-owner role responsible for determining how AI-assisted qualification and engagement should operate, how it connects to human xDR and Sales follow-up, and how it contributes to measurable funnel and pipeline outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines AI-enabled GTM experience, xDR/Sales process knowledge, demand generation, revenue operations, and journey strategy. They can translate business priorities into qualification logic, routing rules, AI engagement workflows, handoff requirements, measurement frameworks, and ongoing optimization plans.

What You’ll Do

Own AI xDR qualification strategy

  • Define qualification frameworks for AI-assisted engagement across priority inbound, account-based, product-led, customer, and signal-triggered motions.
  • Establish the fit, behavior, intent, engagement, and business-context criteria used to determine whether a lead or account should be engaged, progressed, routed, recycled, or suppressed.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations, xDR leadership, Sales Operations, and Marketing to align AI qualification logic with lifecycle definitions and Sales acceptance requirements.
  • Establish governance for qualification-model changes, exceptions, and regional or segment-specific variations.

Design routing, handoff, and disposition models

  • Define AI qualification criteria based on fit, intent, behavior, engagement, account context, and business priority. Partner with Sales, xDR, Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Growth, and Journey teams to determine when AI should engage, when a human xDR or seller should take over, and when an account should move into nurture, suppression, or another follow-up path.
  • Design next-best-action rules, handoff thresholds, escalation paths, service-level expectations, and exception handling.
  • Establish consistent acceptance, rejection, disposition, recycling, and re-entry processes across Marketing, AI xDR, and Sales teams.
  • Identify and resolve leakage, latency, and ownership gaps between AI engagement and human follow-up.

Connect AI xDR to revenue outcomes

  • Define how AI xDR performance will be measured across qualified engagement, human acceptance, meetings, opportunity creation, pipeline progression, and other agreed funnel outcomes.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Analytics to establish reporting, attribution, and feedback loops.
  • Diagnose where AI-engaged leads and accounts stall or fail to progress and recommend changes to qualification, routing, handoff, or follow-up logic.
  • Use funnel data to prioritize use cases and determine where AI xDR should expand, change, or stop.

Lead the cross-functional operating model

  • Serve as the primary business owner for AI xDR across Marketing, xDR, Sales, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, and Journey Architecture.
  • Translate business policies and revenue-process requirements into specifications for technical builders and platform administrators.
  • Establish decision rights, governance, documentation, testing, launch readiness, and ongoing change-management processes.
  • Lead expansion planning across regions, segments, platforms, and use cases.

Guide workflow implementation

  • Partner with Qualified, Outreach, CRM, marketing automation, and related platform owners to ensure workflows reflect approved qualification, routing, and handoff requirements.
  • Validate that implementation matches the intended business logic and revenue operating model.
  • Monitor workflow accuracy, operational compliance, and downstream outcomes.
  • Recommend technical or process changes based on funnel performance and stakeholder feedback.

What You’ll Bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, revenue operations, Sales operations, xDR operations, marketing operations, growth operations, or a related GTM operations discipline.
  • Experience with AI SDR or AI xDR platforms, conversational marketing, automated qualification, or agent-assisted engagement.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or operationalizing AI-assisted, automated, or rules-based qualification and engagement workflows in a B2B GTM environment. This may include AI SDR/xDR, conversational marketing, automated lead qualification, intelligent routing, next-best-action workflows, or comparable AI-enabled buyer engagement models.
  • Strong understanding of how Marketing, xDR, and Sales processes connect to opportunity creation and pipeline progression.
  • Experience defining business rules and translating them into technical workflow requirements.
  • Experience partnering directly with xDR leadership, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Sales stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical ability, including experience evaluating conversion, acceptance, progression, and pipeline performance.
  • Ability to lead a complex cross-functional capability without direct authority.
  • Strong documentation, governance, and operating-process design skills.
  • Familiarity with Qualified, Outreach, Salesforce, Marketo, Common Room, Clay, or comparable GTM platforms.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience designing routing models, next-best-action frameworks, or automated Sales handoffs.
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B SaaS go-to-market motions.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, identity, developer platforms, customer identity, application development, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience marketing to Product, Engineering, developer, application, or technical buyer audiences.
  • Experience with account-based, product-led, signal-led, customer expansion, and partner-influenced demand motions.
  • Experience in lead or account qualification, lifecycle management, routing, disposition, recycling, and Sales handoff processes.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Accuracy and effectiveness of AI-assisted qualification.
  • Human xDR and Sales acceptance rates.
  • Speed and quality of AI-to-human handoffs.
  • Reduction in routing, ownership, and follow-up leakage.
  • Progression from AI engagement to meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.
  • Adoption and confidence among xDR, Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
  • Scalability and governance of the AI xDR operating model.

title: Product Architect, AI (Auth0)
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Auth0, an Okta company, we help organizations build secure, seamless customer experiences. As AI agents become active participants in software systems (acting on behalf of people, organizations, and other agents) identity becomes even more foundational. We are building for a future where agents can securely authenticate, access resources, delegate authority, and operate within clear, auditable boundaries.

We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.


The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Architect, AI to help define how Auth0 and Okta lead the market in agentic identity, secure AI application development, and standards-based access for agents.

This is a senior, highly strategic, and deeply hands-on role. You will work across Product, Engineering, Security, Developer Relations, Design, Go-to-Market, and our customer community to shape the technical and product direction for AI-native identity capabilities.

You will bring a strong point of view on where the industry is going, grounded in real experience building AI-powered and agentic systems. You will help us translate fast-moving technical developments (including MCP, A2A, agentic commerce, delegated authorization, and emerging agent identity standards) into secure, practical product capabilities that customers can adopt with confidence.

This role is for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation: setting a long-term vision, designing platform primitives, engaging directly with customers and partners, contributing to standards and open source communities, and occasionally writing production-quality code or prototypes to prove what is possible.


What you’ll be doing

  • Define and evolve Auth0’s strategy for building, operating, and securing AI agents and agentic applications.
  • Shape the product and technical strategy for agentic identity, including how agents authenticate, receive delegated authority, access resources, establish trust, and maintain auditable boundaries.
  • Define approaches for securely exposing protected resources (including APIs, tools, data services, and MCP servers) to authorized agents.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering leaders to turn strategic opportunities into clear product bets, architectural principles, product requirements, and durable platform capabilities.
  • Help design and, where valuable, implement core identity capabilities that enable secure agent-to-resource and agent-to-agent interactions.
  • Develop an informed perspective on emerging technologies and standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent protocols, agentic commerce, AAuth, authorization frameworks, workload identity, and related specifications.
  • Deep curiosity and a disciplined approach to staying ahead of the AI landscape, including foundation models, agent harnesses, AI frameworks, orchestration tools, evaluation and observability platforms, and rapidly evolving developer practices. You can distinguish durable shifts from short-lived hype and articulate their implications for customers, developers, and Auth0’s product strategy.
  • Identify important industry shifts early, assess their implications for customers and the identity ecosystem, and communicate a clear point of view internally and externally.
  • Work directly with strategic customers to understand their AI and identity architectures, uncover unmet needs, validate product direction, and help them build securely.
  • Collaborate with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Trust teams to ensure that AI-related identity capabilities are secure, responsible, compliant, and usable in real-world enterprise environments.
  • Represent Auth0 and Okta in the developer and identity communities through technical content, speaking engagements, customer conversations, standards participation, and open-source engagement.
  • Build prototypes, reference implementations, and technical demonstrations using technologies such as Node.js, React, Python, and Go.
  • Partner with Developer Relations and Go-to-Market teams to make complex identity and AI concepts approachable for developers, architects, customers, and partners.
  • Raise the technical bar across the organization by mentoring others, documenting architectural patterns, and creating clarity in an evolving technical landscape.


What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in product architecture, technical product management, software architecture, platform engineering, developer platforms, or a similarly customer- and technology-facing leadership role.
  • Experience building and shipping AI-powered applications, agentic systems, developer tools, or platforms used by developers to build them.
  • Deep expertise in modern identity and authorization standards, especially OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, workload identity, token exchange, delegated authorization, API authorization, and related identity protocols.
  • A strong understanding of how to securely design access to APIs, tools, data, and services in distributed systems.
  • Practical familiarity with the emerging agent ecosystem, including MCP, agent-to-agent interactions, tool invocation, AI application architectures, and the evolving questions around agent identity, authorization, delegation, consent, intent, and auditability.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop a strategy in ambiguous, quickly evolving markets and turn it into concrete product and technical decisions.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, developers, and partners to solve complex technical problems and influence product direction.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain deeply technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • A strong external presence in relevant technical communities through speaking, standards work, open-source contributions, technical writing, or other visible contributions.
  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries, influencing without direct authority and driving alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong software development skills and comfort writing code in one or more of Node.js/TypeScript, React, Python, or Go.


And extra credit if you have

  • Experience contributing to or participating in identity, security, AI, or agent-related standards organizations and open-source projects.
  • Experience designing developer-facing authentication, authorization, API security, or identity platform products.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, B2B platforms, consumer-facing applications, or both.
  • Experience with authorization policy systems, fine-grained authorization, consent, entitlements, and delegated access models.
  • Experience building or operating MCP servers, AI agent platforms, AI-enabled workflows, or agent-to-agent systems.
  • Experience with cloud security, workload identity, zero trust, API gateways, service-to-service authorization, or secure software supply chains.
  • A track record of helping organizations navigate major platform shifts, such as cloud, mobile, API-first development, or AI.
  • A pragmatic approach to innovation: excitement about emerging technology paired with a clear understanding of security, customer value, operational realities, and adoption barriers.

  • Making Social Impact
  • Developing Talent and Fostering Connection
  • Promoting Work-Life Flexibility and Inclusivity

Okta cultivates a dynamic work environment, providing the best tools, technology, and benefits to empower employees to work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs.

Below outlines some key attributes for a Renewals Manager:

  • Sales and Negotiation Skills: Demonstrate strong sales and negotiation skills to successfully renew customer contracts at favorable terms.   • Solution knowledge: Utilise strong knowledge of Okta’s solutions, products, contract structures to position the best renewal options and minimise friction in the renewal process. Understands value based positioning and can link and communicate it to C-Suite personal as well as procurement. title: Staff FullStack Engineer, Secures AI
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. You are the architect of our unified control plane, ensuring that we operationalize our North Star: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every agent action.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Proactively shape the technical strategy of the Identity Security Fabric, partnering with leadership to prioritize open standards like IPSIE.
  • Govern and monitor agentic behavior by implementing the four-pillar maturity model across our fullstack ecosystems.
  • Architect for the agentic era, ensuring systems can discover and secure all agents, including "Shadow AI" assets.
  • Enforce secure access and least privilege for agents through capabilities like Agent Gateways and short-lived credentials.
  • Drive continual evolution in the adoption of AI-native development practices, helping the team rethink how we design, review, and ship software with AI as a core part of the workflow.
  • Proactively identify and prioritize tech debt; drive improvements in areas beyond feature work - CI/CD, observability, documentation, reliability, and support processes.
  • Partner with Product and Design to understand and own the desired customer outcome, not just the technical deliverable.
  • Actively invest in the growth of peer engineers, taking responsibility for raising the technical bar of the team as a whole.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Operates well beyond basic AI tool usage - understands how to apply AI meaningfully across the full software development lifecycle, can evaluate and adopt new AI tooling with good judgment, and is able to establish practices and bring a team along.
  • Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies - including the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with lasting org-wide impact.
  • Solid understanding of web authentication and authorization fundamentals - how auth flows work, and best practices for securing sensitive user data.                                                                                                                                               
  • Deep expertise in building highly reliable, secure, enterprise-grade software using Java or another type safe programming language.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to navigate and contribute to the frontend to unblock feature development.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, with experience designing and operating large-scale services on AWS

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following! 

  • Prior experience leading a team of engineers through a meaningful shift in ways of working - whether around AI adoption, developer tooling, or engineering culture change.
  • Experience building or maintaining publicly released SDKs used by external developers.
  • Experience in one of the following areas is preferred: developing Identity and Access Management (IAM) tooling and contributing to a "zero-to-one" startup-like team.

The team is responsible for driving the compensation plan design, implementation, and assessment of variable pay participants across Okta while delivering compensation plans that ensure alignment with the overall goals and objectives of the GTM organization. 

This role will report to the Director, GTM Strategy & Incentive Design and play a pivotal role in developing scalable sales incentive programs for our Go-To-Market Sales and Customer First organizations. Success in this role requires the individual to operationalize Okta’s incentive compensation plans and operational processes to be clear, measurable, cost-efficient, and effective. They will be expected to work cross functionally with a huge emphasis on operational efficiency, scaling our business processes, and driving effective change management.

In this role, you will drive strategic compensation initiatives by developing data-driven recommendations aligned with business objectives, influencing cross-functional leadership, and building consensus on complex compensation architecture decisions. You'll lead compensation plan design and optimization across Go-To-Market functions - ensuring incentives are strategically aligned with role responsibilities and organizational goals. You will establish robust metrics and analytics frameworks to track compensation plan performance, measure ROI, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement using quantitative analysis and business intelligence. Balancing strategic vision with operational rigor, you'll translate high-level business objectives into executable compensation plans while ensuring systems, processes, and analytics support accurate tracking and meaningful insights. Collaborating closely with Sales, Regional Sales Operations, People Ops, Finance and Legal teams, you will own operational excellence, drive productivity improvements through data-informed compensation strategy adjustments, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on compensation strategy, market competitiveness, and sales force effectiveness.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement compensation analytics and reports that align with the company's strategic goals and values. Support a high-performance culture by partnering strategically with our leadership team.
  • Oversee the administration of all incentive compensation reporting and analytics to ensure timely and accurate payment of incentives, adhering to design governance. This includes attainment and earnings reports, predictive cost modeling, data validation and reconciliation, and ad-hoc reporting.
  • Serve as a data & business process SME demonstrating knowledge surrounding Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) systems, our upstream financial reporting and CRM systems, and downstream BI and reporting capabilities.
  • Develop and document data and business process flows. Identify efficiencies to support end-to-end automation, provide requirements and recommendations for ICM Analytics configuration changes, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) related to commissions.
  • Develop cost models, scenario analyses, and insights into our Incentive Plan design and Sales Performance by synthesizing information from various sources. Assist leadership in interpreting findings to make informed decisions and continuously enhance dashboard visualizations.
  • Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with key business partners within GTM Operations, Commission Operations, Finance, and Sales.


What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation design, strategy, or analytics within public SaaS, software, or technology companies, with demonstrated expertise in organizational scaling
  • Proven leadership capability to build, mentor, and manage diverse teams across multiple levels—from individual contributors and analysts to managers—fostering high performance and professional development

title: Staff Product Designer, Login and MFA (Auth0)
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Team

Our Login and MFA team owns the most consequential surface in software: the exact moment someone proves who they are. Getting this right means designing security that's invisible when it works, flows that guide without friction, and experiences that people trust without thinking twice. We're looking for a designer who obsesses over the details that make that possible.

You'll join a distributed and diverse team of designers who see design as both craft and catalyst. We believe design is never static, it evolves with our users, our products, and our own curiosity. Some days that means diving deep into research and validation, others it's refining existing flows, and often it's imagining bold new ways to move our product forward.

Our team thrives on collaboration and feedback. We learn from one another, challenge ourselves to raise the bar, and create space to experiment and grow. Designers here have real ownership, influencing product direction alongside engineering and product management while shaping experiences that reach millions of people worldwide.

If you're energized by complex problems, motivated to push boundaries, and eager to hone your craft while making a lasting impact, this is the place to do it.

The Role

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll tackle some of the hardest design challenges in identity: making authentication seamless for end users while remaining powerful and configurable for the developers who build on it. You'll lead design across Auth0's key login and multi factor authentication flows by guiding strategy and raising the craft.

What you'll be doing

When everyone on the team can generate UI, the designer's role shifts. You become the person responsible for strong systems thinking, taste, quality, experience, and being the voice of the customer. You hold the quality bar when speed is pushing everything toward "fine."

  • Prototype at volume: Use AI tools and code to explore dozens of directions fast, then narrow based on what works and what solves the actual problem. The artifacts you create will be functional and inclusive of all Auth0 developer interfaces.
  • Simplify complexity: Shape intuitive, scalable experiences for our customers with high standards for security and composability. You'll be designing customization journeys that make secure and frictionless authentication seamless.
  • Raise the craft: Help the broader design org see what this way of working looks like in practice. We're all figuring this out together. You'll take pride in expanding your contributions through code and research-driven insights.

What you'll bring to the role

  • You have craft: This matters most. Considered typography, intentional spacing, polished micro-interactions, details that show someone genuinely cared. We're looking for someone with a refined sense of design taste and a deep appreciation for the details that create a polished, trustworthy experience.
  • You build: You've established a mature AI workflow that helps you bring ideas to life quickly. Instead of letting the backlog of small design debt collect, you take action and fix things directly in code.
  • You have a real AI practice: Not experimentation, but an actual workflow. You have opinions about where AI tools help and where they fall short.
  • You simplify: Auth0 is a robust and composable product. It is your job to create clarity and moments of magic amidst the complexity.

Note for when applying

In your application, please include a link to your portfolio with password (if protected). We prioritize a review of your design craft and any examples of your work in code.

We collaborate closely with the Machine Learning team and various product teams to ensure the seamless and secure delivery of AI-enhanced features that provide real value to our users.

The Opportunity: 

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the Generative AI team, you will help shape, architect, and accelerate our Generative AI strategy by contributing across the stack of model development, infrastructure, and platform services. You’ll drive design and implementation of production-ready AI/ML systems at scale: ranging from LLM-powered features to reusable components that other teams across Okta can build on.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Architect, design, and deploy robust Machine Learning & GenAI systems, ensuring seamless integration with diverse platform services and establishing scalable LLMOps pipelines in production.
  • Drive technical decision making while striving to hit the right balance between factors such as simplicity, flexibility, reliability, and performance.
  • Lead initiatives to tune, optimize, and deploy agentic applications in production with a focus on performance, reliability, and security.
  • Partner with Product, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to design AI-powered experiences that are both innovative and trustworthy.
  • Design and implement scalable infrastructure and platform services for large-scale Generative AI use cases.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, researchers, and engineers to deliver secure, high-quality, and scalable AI/ML systems.

 What you will do:

  • Spearhead the design of scalable, observable ML and Generative AI systems that integrate retrieval, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Develop and iterate on structured prompting, context retrieval, and RAG workflows that improve accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency in Claude-based systems.
  • Build and refine automated evaluation pipelines to measure model quality, correctness, groundedness, and safety in production.
  • Implement schema validation, structured output enforcement, and other guardrails that keep AI outputs reliable, auditable, and compliant with enterprise standards.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, contributing to the growth of the team and the larger engineering community.

What you bring:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, with strong programming expertise in Python (and familiarity with Go or Typescript a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with applied machine learning, from feature engineering to training and fine-tuning models.
  • Hands-on experience with modern Generative AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and knowledge-base workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with LiteLLM, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, or other related AI agent frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks (FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark ML) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, etc.).
  • Experience defining evaluation metrics, pipelines, and feedback loops for ML/GenAI systems.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive greenfield initiatives forward, navigate unknowns, and iterate quickly and frequently.
  • Experience building tools or infrastructure for AI/ML applications, with a deep understanding of the developer lifecycle in an AI-native world.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience integrating AI-driven systems with identity, authentication, or security products.
  • Exposure to ethical AI, model risk, or compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with evaluation datasets, synthetic data generation, or LLM-as-a-judge methods.

Please note that we encourage candidates to apply even if you do not have experience with all of the criteria or technologies listed above; these are provided to give insight into the tech stack and general responsibilities for the role.

title: Staff Data Analyst, People Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. With data and advanced analytics at the center of our people strategy, we are seeking an analytically driven People Analytics professional to join our People Analytics team. In this role, you will develop, optimize, and enhance data-driven insights across the employee lifecycle. You will partner closely with stakeholders across HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT, and Legal to deliver analytics that support strategic workforce planning, improve employee experiences, and enable informed business decisions.

You will apply advanced analytics, predictive modeling, statistical techniques, and emerging AI capabilities to ¯solve complex workforce challenges. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys transforming data into actionable insights, collaborating across functions, and continuously advancing modern analytics practices within HR.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

People Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze and report on the employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding through development and exit—by developing dashboards and reports that provide insights into hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, promotions, compensation, headcount, and organizational health.
  • Partner with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Finance, and other Centers of Excellence to deliver analytics supporting quarterly business reviews, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
  • Design scalable reporting solutions and self-service dashboards that improve access to trusted workforce insights.
  • Collaborate with HR Technology and data teams to ensure data quality, governance, and consistency across people data platforms.
  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches and communicate findings through compelling visualizations and executive-ready presentations.

Advanced People Analytics

  • Design, develop, and maintain predictive analytics models that help identify workforce trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Apply advanced statistical techniques, including regression analysis, clustering, forecasting, survival analysis, and segmentation, to solve business problems.
  • Build and validate predictive models supporting areas such as:
    • Attrition prediction
    • Workforce forecasting
    • Employee lifecycle and tenure analysis
    • Hiring and talent pipeline analytics
  • Recommend data-driven solutions that improve workforce planning and organizational decision-making.

Continuously evaluate emerging analytical methods and technologies to improve People Analytics capabilities.

AI & Natural Language Processing (NLP)

  • Apply Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to analyze employee feedback from surveys, onboarding, exit interviews, and other listening channels.
  • Use topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and text analytics to identify emerging themes and actionable insights.
  • Explore and prototype Generative AI use cases that automate narrative reporting, summarize workforce trends, and enhance the delivery of people insights.
  • Partner with HR Technology and analytics teams to evaluate AI-enabled solutions that improve reporting efficiency and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance and data privacy standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–8 years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Science, or a related analytics discipline.

Skills & Experience

  • Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Snowflake, Excel, SQL, and other enterprise HR platforms eg Workday, ServiceNow, Greenhouse.
  • Strong programming skills using Python and/or R for statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and automation.
  • Experience applying advanced statistical methods, including regression, clustering, forecasting, text analytics, and sentiment analysis.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying sound data management and governance practices.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Excellent data visualization and storytelling skills tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and influence decisions through data.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and emerging AI technologies applied to analytics is preferred.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Success in This Role

Successful candidates will:

  • Deliver high-quality analytics that enable better workforce decisions.
  • Build scalable dashboards, predictive models, and AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.
  • Partner effectively across HR and business functions to solve complex workforce challenges.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting, automation, and analytics capabilities.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of People Analytics through innovation, technical expertise, and a strong customer-focused mindset.

title: Staff Product Security Engineer, Reviews
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. The Staff Product Security Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Product Security Engineer, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Okta’s products by conducting comprehensive security reviews, guiding engineering teams in secure development practices, and handling externally reported vulnerabilities. You will engage in code reviews, penetration testing, and architectural security assessments to ensure the security of Okta’s platforms and features.

This role is not suited for individuals who rely solely on automated vulnerability scanning. Instead, you must possess a deep technical understanding of web applications, backend services, penetration testing methodologies, and secure design principles.

A successful candidate will have expertise in authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC), threat modeling, and a strong desire to automate security processes by building tools that proactively identify vulnerabilities. You will also be responsible for communicating risks, impact, and remediation strategies to developers, leadership, and external audiences through documentation, presentations, and external publications. The ideal candidate will also demonstrate a deep technical background in assessing AI-integrated software architectures and securing Large Language Models (LLMs) against emerging threats and modern vulnerability classes.

The ideal candidate will have an attacker mindset—the ability to think critically, creatively, and like an adversary when solving security challenges. We actively support public disclosure of research and findings through white papers, blog posts, and conference presentations.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct security reviews, including design reviews, threat modeling, and penetration testing of new features and major changes.
  • Perform manual secure code reviews across multiple programming languages.
  • Identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities, providing clear guidance to engineering teams.
  • Lead product security incidents, assess risks, and drive remediation efforts.
  • Develop security tools and automation to improve vulnerability detection and assessment.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide guidance to non-security staff on secure development practices.
  • Represent Okta externally through security research, conference talks, and publications.

What You Bring

  • Expertise in identifying OWASP Top 10 / CWE Top 25 vulnerabilities through manual code review.
  • Strong experience in penetration testing and secure development practices.
  • Deep technical background in assessing Large Language Models (LLMs) and securing AI-integrated software architectures.
  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python, C/C++).
  • Deep understanding of authentication & authorization protocols (OIDC, SAML, OAuth).
  • Strong communication skills to explain risks and remediation to developers and leadership.
  • Ability to automate security testing using LLMs and scripting (Python, Bash, etc.).
  • Experience leading security incidents and risk assessments.

Desired Skills and Abilities

  • Experience in mobile (iOS/Android) and desktop (Windows/macOS) security testing.
  • Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, and fuzzing tools.
  • Strong cryptographic knowledge and secure implementation practices.
  • Experience analyzing network protocols and traffic security.
  • Ability to develop proof-of-concept exploits to demonstrate vulnerabilities.

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.
  • Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.
  • Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.
  • Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.
  • Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.
  • Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering

  • Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.
  • Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.
  • Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.
  • Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.
  • Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.
  • Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

Own the Product

  • Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.
  • Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.
  • Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.
  • Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.
  • Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.
  • Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.
  • Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.
  • Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.
  • Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.
  • Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.
  • Strong technical background that allows you to influence technical design and investment decisions, particularly in security architectures.
  • Ability to produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous security inputs.
  • Strong track record of influencing teams and operating effectively as a player-coach.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences, especially when discussing complex security concepts.
  • Strong leadership skills and executive presence.
  • Passion for Okta’s immense opportunity and growth potential in the identity security market.
  • 8+ years product management experience.
  • Experience interviewing and selecting candidates.
  • Mentoring early-in-career product managers.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in a technical or business field.
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise security products and services, including cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.
  • Extensive knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) and its intersection with security.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and threat detection standards.
  • Experience with developing user flows and enabling customizable security experiences.
  • Experience creating and managing multi-tenant SaaS security software products.

descriptionHtml:

The Enterprise Technology Team

The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Finance, Operations, and Security to bring data-driven, secure, compliant, and innovative solutions to life. 

The Staff Product Analyst Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Staff Product Analyst (Workday Payroll, Absence & Time Tracking) to join our People Technology Team. This is a pivotal role dedicated to the functional optimization of Okta's global Workday platform across Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking. You will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of these programs, from strategic discovery and design to global deployment and adoption. You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across People, Payroll, IT, and Finance, ensuring our People Technology suite drives automation, accuracy, and efficiency. If you are passionate about improving the employee experience through thoughtful Workday design, you'll fit right in.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Collaborate on the product vision and multi-year roadmap for Workday Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking, ensuring alignment with global People Technology and Finance team objectives.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic partner to People, Payroll, and Finance leadership, translating complex business needs into clear functional requirements and configuration designs.
  • Functional Configuration and Design: Lead the design and configuration of Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking business processes, calculations, eligibility rules, and pay components that prioritize employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Lifecycle Management: Manage the full lifecycle of payroll, absence, and time tracking configuration, from initial discovery and requirements gathering through testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage Workday reporting and analytics to monitor process performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable recommendations for payroll, absence, and time tracking optimization.
  • Vendor and Platform Management: Oversee relationships with third-party vendors (e.g., ADP) to ensure seamless data flows and adherence to service level agreements.
  • Operational Excellence: Champion continuous improvement by analyzing process and configuration issues, leading testing efforts, and proposing changes that enhance accuracy and reduce manual intervention.
  • Feature Adoption and Training: Drive end-user adoption of new Workday features through comprehensive documentation, user guides, and training programs.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure all payroll, absence, and time tracking configurations strictly adhere to global data privacy requirements and internal security standards.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Workday Expertise: 7+ years configuring Workday Payroll, Absence, and/or Time Tracking, including business process design, calculated fields, and eligibility rules.
  • Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking Domain Knowledge: Deep functional expertise in Workday Payroll (GL, pay components, taxes), Absence, and Time Tracking configuration, along with global HR business processes.
  • Testing and Quality: Proven experience leading tenant configuration testing, including UAT and regression testing, to ensure accurate, reliable releases.
  • Analytical Skills: Advanced capability in building custom reports, dashboards, and hubs to drive data-informed decision-making.
  • Strategic Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
  • Problem Solving: Superior ability to troubleshoot complex functional issues and design scalable configuration solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Agile Methodology: Experience working in an Agile environment, managing backlogs, and delivering value through iterative cycles.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following! 

  • Experience with Workday integrations especially the Global Payroll Connect.
  • Workday Extend experience.
  • Workday Certification in Payroll, Absence, or Time Tracking.

Additional requirements:

  • U.S. soil status - the employee must be on U.S. soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, and be a U.S. person.
  • U.S. person status - the employee must be either a U.S. citizen as defined in 42 U.S. Code § 9102; a natural person who is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3); or a U.S. national (i.e. includes citizens and non-citizens born in outlying possessions such as American Samoa and Swains Island), green card holders, refugees, and asylees. Working on a U.S. visa does NOT qualify as a U.S. person.

This role will own positioning, messaging, launches, field enablement, and lifecycle adoption for a strategic product portfolio at the intersection of identity, endpoint experiences, and security.

Okta Device Access extends identity security to the first moment of the workday: signing in to a computer. It helps organizations strengthen device-login security, simplify onboarding and account experiences, and enable seamless, secure access from device sign-in to the applications employees need. The portfolio supports Windows and macOS environments and complements customers’ existing endpoint-management investments. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically credible product marketer who can translate sophisticated identity and platform capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated market narratives, and scalable commercial programs. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital Growth, and Pricing to bring new capabilities to market and drive durable customer adoption.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end go-to-market and lifecycle marketing strategy for Okta Device Access, including positioning, messaging, launches, field readiness, customer adoption, and expansion.
  • Develop a differentiated narrative for securing device sign-in and enabling seamless, passwordless, phishing-resistant access from device to applications.
  • Translate complex identity, authentication, device-security, and operating-system integration capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, use cases, and practical field plays.
  • Lead cross-functional launch planning and execution, including launch strategy, sales and partner enablement, customer communications, web and content strategy, internal readiness, and post-launch measurement.
  • Build and execute adoption programs that help customers advance phishing-resistant access and FastPass adoption, while identifying and addressing deployment and activation friction. FastPass is Okta’s phishing-resistant, passwordless authenticator for secure access to devices and applications 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insight into product and GTM decisions, shape roadmap communications, and ensure commercialization and packaging changes are customer- and field-ready.
  • Enable Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and partners with the messaging, tools, and programs needed to articulate value and drive successful deployments.
  • Help shape a cohesive device-access story that can extend to adjacent workforce and frontline-worker needs as the portfolio evolves.
  • Define and report on success metrics across adoption, activation, field readiness, pipeline influence, launch performance, and customer outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise product marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity, identity, endpoint management, enterprise software, or a related technical category.
  • Demonstrated experience owning GTM strategy for complex technical products—from positioning and launches through field enablement and sustained customer adoption.
  • Ability to communicate credibly with security, identity, IT, and endpoint-management audiences.
  • Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to make sophisticated technology accessible, differentiated, and commercially compelling.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital, Pricing, and partner teams.
  • Strong analytical orientation, with experience using customer insight and performance data to shape strategy and improve adoption.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience marketing Windows and/or macOS enterprise capabilities.
  • Experience building adoption motions for products where deployment, admin workflows, and end-user change management are meaningful parts of the customer journey.
  • Experience marketing products that integrate with broader endpoint-management or security ecosystems.

We are seeking a seasoned Technical Engineer to serve in a specialized role focused on the quality, integrity, and AI readiness of our technical content. The Technical Content Manager is the definitive expert responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of knowledge assets within their domain. This hands-on role ensures all content—such as KBAs, videos, and other support content is technically accurate, easily readable, and optimized for maximum effectiveness across all self-service channels.

Additionally, this position heavily leverages Okta’s AI platform to innovate how we deliver support. You will build productivity tools, identify opportunities for AI Agents, and validate AI-generated responses (such as those from Okta’s web chat agents) to continuously improve our knowledge delivery, enhance self-service, and drive down case volume. This position requires a commitment to data-driven content decisions, technical tool-building, and a collaborative approach to content validation, ensuring our support content remains a world-class resource.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Technical Content Management & Data-Driven Optimization
  • Content Creation & Maintenance: Actively create, edit, and publish high-quality technical content (e.g., Knowledge Base Articles, video scripts, verified community responses) related to complex product issues and features in their area of expertise.
  • Case Deflection Analysis: Analyze data on top case drivers and identify opportunities for knowledge base articles to assist with customer self-service and reduce cases in these high-volume areas.
  • Accuracy Verification & Auditing: Conduct rigorous technical audits of existing support content to ensure 100% accuracy, alignment with product features, and adherence to content standards.
  • Content Optimization & AI Structuring: Structure and refine content for clarity, search, and LLM visibility. Ensure content is well-formed for efficient consumption by Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI systems.
  • AI Prompt & Citation Optimization: Review AI prompts and validate responses, aggressively improving knowledge base articles as needed to increase AI citation share and accuracy.
  1. AI Tooling & Knowledge Automation
  • AI Tool Development: Design, build, test, and deploy applications or tools that support Knowledge Management (KM) best practices using Okta's AI platform to assist with productivity, repetitive tasks, or analysis. Create all supporting documentation for these tools.
  • AI Agent Ideation: Proactively identify opportunities for AI Agents that can assist with or automate knowledge tasks.
  • AI Quality Validation: Review questions and answers from AI tools, such as our web chat agents. Rate and validate the outputs, providing improved, expertly crafted answers when appropriate to train and enhance the system.
  1. Expertise Maintenance & Cross-Functional Review
  • SME Collaboration & Vetting: Serve as the content expert and collaborator, working closely with other Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Product Managers, and Engineering teams to validate technical details and fill nuanced knowledge gaps.
  • Product Expertise: Proactively engage in product training and documentation review to maintain deep, current knowledge of new features, product roadmaps, and emerging best practices.
  • Best Practice Sharing: Collaborate across the Global Customer Support and broader Customer First organization to share insights on common content deficiencies and best practices for creating robust, usable knowledge.

Required Qualifications

  • Technical Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Technical Support Engineer or equivalent role, demonstrating deep subject matter expertise in one or more Okta product areas. Subject-matter expertise in Okta Administration product areas and an Okta Certified Administrator certification are preferred. 
  • AI & Tooling Proficiency: Experience in using Okta's AI Tools (or similar enterprise AI platforms) to build tools that assist with productivity, automate repetitive tasks, or facilitate data analysis.
  • Content Focus: Proven experience in drafting, editing, or critically reviewing technical documentation or support content (KBAs).
  • Data Literacy: Ability to interpret support metrics, top case drivers, and content usage data to make content decisions and identify areas for improvement.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex technical information into clear, easy-to-read, and precise content.
  • Okta technical support experience would be highly preferred

This position is vital for turning expert-level technical knowledge into a scalable, high-quality asset. You are directly responsible for the reliability of our self-service offerings and the foundational data that powers our future AI support strategy, which significantly impacts both customer success and internal operational efficiency.

The Overview

At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.

In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.

Finer Print

You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design & Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.

You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.

What You Will Do

As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.

  • Own Access Management Research in India: Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).
  • Build an Exclusive User Panel: Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.
  • Pioneer AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.
  • Make Research a "Team Sport": Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.
  • Exercise Methodological Rigor: Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.
  • Drive Global Alignment & Storytelling: Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

  • Technical Research Expertise: Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer-facing domains.
  • Strategic & Autonomous Thinker: Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.
  • AI Tooling & Practice: Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time-to-insight without compromising rigor.
  • Global Collaboration: Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.
  • Systems & Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.
  • Growth Mindset & Empathy: Strong self-awareness, receptiveness to feedback, and passion for solving high-stakes identity and security problems.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of product development experience conducting UX research in enterprise/B2B product environments, OR a Master’s degree/PhD in HCI, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, or related field with 2+ years of experience.
  • Portfolio: A digital portfolio or case study deck demonstrating end to end research ownership, complex technical problem spaces, generative and evaluative methodologies, and measurable business/product impact.
  • Platform Knowledge: Experience researching desktop and mobile applications across macOS, Windows, iOS, or Android environments.

descriptionHtml:

Okta authenticates, authorizes, and provisions millions of users a day. Internally, TDI Infrastructure Engineering runs the platforms that our own engineering and business teams build on — hosted on AWS, increasingly Kubernetes-native, and expanding fast to support AI-driven internal workflows. We're looking for a Senior SRE to help us evolve Site Reliability Engineering from a traditional operations model into a true Platform as a Service (PaaS) organization.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer on our Dublin/EMEA team, you will build and operate the Kubernetes-based platform that hosts internal workflows across the business, with a growing focus on hosting AI-driven workflows reliably in production. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, and work closely with a Staff SRE and the rest of the Dublin team, as well as SRE peers in the US and India.

What you'll be doing

  • Building, operating, and improving our Kubernetes platform — cluster management, networking, security posture, and day-2 operations
  • Developing self-service capabilities, golden paths, and automation that let internal teams onboard and operate workflows with less platform expertise required
  • Supporting the platform's readiness to host AI-driven internal workflows reliably at scale
  • Troubleshooting and resolving production issues, including participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation shared with SRE peers in the US and India, and driving postmortems for incidents you own
  • Contributing to and upholding reliability practices — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks
  • Improving CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, including change and release management
  • Building and maintaining observability and monitoring coverage for the systems you own
  • Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design and code reviews
  • Collaborating with the Staff SRE and Dublin team to align local implementation with the broader global platform strategy

What you'll bring to the role

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production — deployment, networking, security, and troubleshooting
  • Experience operating large-scale internal infrastructure platforms in a public cloud, preferably AWS
  • Solid experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to or interest in building infrastructure that hosts AI/ML or agentic workflows
  • Experience with observability platforms and monitoring tools (Grafana, Splunk, APM, or equivalent)
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment with ambiguity around process and tooling
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across time zones
  • Computer Science degree or related field, or equivalent experience

Extra credit if you have experience in any of the following

  • Exposure to internal developer platform (IDP) concepts or "platform as a product" thinking
  • Hands-on experience with AI agent orchestration, vector databases, model routing, or inference infrastructure
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS plus Azure or GCP)
  • Service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd) or GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD) or equivalent cloud certifications
  • Experience administering an enterprise-scale SCM platform (GitHub, GitLab, or equivalent)
