We operate as trusted partners across the business, driving forward-thinking safety initiatives and modernizing global operations to stay ahead of evolving risks.)

The Principal, Global Security Operations Center Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Global Security & Safety, this role will serve as the lead operational driver and technical subject matter expert for Okta’s global security operations center.

Transitioning from traditional database management to proactive, automated security solutions, this role is responsible for driving the operational deployment, optimization, and day-to-day leveraging of complex physical security technologies. You will autonomously lead global programs with minimal oversight, leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and advanced analytics within our operations to help create a highly efficient, future-proof GSOC environment. This role focuses on high-level operational execution, integration, and performance optimization, with a critical emphasis on identifying and leveraging world-class technologies—both internal platforms and external cutting-edge solutions—to deliver the highest level of protection, responsiveness, and support for Okta globally.

What you'll be doing

  • Strategic GSOC Leadership: Assume full operational responsibility for the Global Security Operations Center, driving the transition from legacy systems and procedures to advanced, AI-integrated security frameworks.
  • AI Integration & Optimization: Architect and deploy artificial intelligence and automation solutions to enhance threat intelligence, triage workflows, and operational efficiency across the GSOC program.
  • Executive Incident Management: Serve as a key operational liaison, delivering high-level communication briefs and strategic incident summaries to executive leadership during critical security events.
  • Vendor and Global Program Management: Provide oversight for multi-regional security operations, managing diverse global vendor teams and driving a unified, performance-driven culture across international markets.
  • Operational Excellence & Compliance: Establish and monitor performance metrics (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ensure all physical security protocols and data logging maintain strict adherence to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance standards.
  • Technological Oversight: Advise and optimize the deployment of critical physical security infrastructure, including advanced access control systems and video analytics, to ensure a hardened global security posture.
  • Policy, SOPs, & Training Exercises: Review high-level global physical security and safety policy documents, translate them into actionable, team-wide standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct robust internal and external training exercises to ensure operational readiness.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as an operational liaison between Workplace Security Operations and key partners during an emergency, including Business Technology, Real Estate, Travel, Legal, and external vendors.
  • System Compliance & Investigations: Serve as the operational lead for complex security investigations. Oversee and ensure compliance for administrative system processes, including onboarding/termination access audits and automated reporting.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Strategic Leadership & Global Operations
    • 8+ years of progressive experience in physical security operations, global systems integration, and GSOC leadership supporting fast paced global business operations in dynamic environments
    • Demonstrated experience leading and managing large, diverse security teams from multiple third-party vendors across different global regions
    • Demonstrated ability to operate with proactive independence, leading global enterprise-wide operational programs with minimal oversight
    • Strong background in vendor strategy, contract optimization, and managing large-scale service providers
    • Excellent project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing and scaling physical security operations programs
  • Technical Expertise & AI Integration
    • Demonstrated experience identifying, adapting, and developing AI use cases and automated tools (such as generative AI or workflow automation platforms) specifically to optimize GSOC team efficiency
    • Proven experience evaluating, deploying, and utilizing AI-driven physical security tools and advanced video analytics within a security environment.
    • Advanced cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational requirements to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Incident Management, Risk & Compliance
    • Excellent executive presence with a track record of communicating clearly and briefing C-suite and VP-level executives during high-pressure, rapid-onset global incidents.
    • Demonstrated experience establishing, monitoring, and reporting on quantitative performance metrics (KPIs) and managing global vendor SLA compliance.
    • Direct experience aligning global GSOC workflows and physical security auditing with international compliance standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
    • Strong analytical experience assessing global geopolitical events, evaluating high-risk travel profiles, and conducting ongoing threat evaluations to safeguard company offices, assets, and employees.
    • Demonstrated ability to review high-level policy documents, draft comprehensive team-wide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and coordinate or facilitate internal and external operational training exercises.
    • Experience with incident alerting and mass notification platforms.
    • Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound, rapid decisions under pressure during critical incidents.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

The Staff DevSecOps Engineer Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Staff DevSecOps Engineer with an issue management focus to be part of Security’s Vulnerability Management team. The team delivers foundational infrastructure vulnerability scanning and reporting capabilities that enable corporate engineering teams to operate securely, reliably, and at scale. 

The Vulnerability Management team safeguards Okta from threats and vulnerabilities that could disrupt our business or erode our customers’ trust. In this role, you will be embedded directly within our service environments, working side-by-side with engineering and operations teams to strengthen Okta’s security posture across infrastructure, cloud, and business systems.

This is a tactical and strategic role; you will build centralized security posture analytics and reporting capabilities that aggregate findings, remediation status, and risk data across Okta's security tools to improve visibility, accountability, and execution. The focus is on automating issue tracking and ownership assignment, identifying and routing unowned findings, partnering with remediation teams to accelerate closure, and developing remediation solutions where none currently exist. Longer term, leverage AI to simplify security posture management, increase trust in the data, automate analysis and prioritization, and provide actionable insights that help the team proactively manage security risk at scale.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical security expertise with the ability to troubleshoot in complex environments and drive measurable improvements across the security posture management lifecycle.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Serve as a security subject matter expert (SME) for solution engineering and architecture reviews regarding the automation of vulnerability scanning and reporting.
  • Collaborate with SRE to manage update pipelines and enforce compliance with baseline standards.
  • Develop agentic automation to scale security posture scanning, reporting, issue remediation, and patch validation.
  • Lead technical efforts to evaluate, design, and implement new in house developed security systems and feature enhancements.
  • Build, maintain, and enhance custom automation and cloud infrastructure using Terraform or similar tools to support team or AI workflows and enforce security controls.
  • Develop integrations with APIs, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and security infrastructure to improve vulnerability detection, response, and remediation.
  • Write and maintain scripts and automations, with an emphasis on Python-based solutions, to streamline security operations. Mastery in Python, Bash, or Go, alongside Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for automated environment provisioning and security guardrails.
  • Establish monitoring and alerting for security posture, misconfigurations, and threats across endpoints, SaaS, and cloud workloads.
  • Proactively identify and remediate security gaps; stay updated on emerging threats, solutions, and tooling across the industry.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or SaaS apps within a large corporate environment.
  • 10+ years of strong coding and scripting experience, with a focus on building automation and custom tooling for security engineering teams. 
  • Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for onboarding security data into Okta’s security data lake.
  • Ability to build and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines to process vulnerability data.
  • Proven track record of automating security controls and workflows using a cloud-first approach.
  • Experience with Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools to orchestrate security infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for security automation and drift management.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical staff, support teams, executive leadership, and external vendors.
  • 2+ years of experience building engineering solutions within highly regulated environments is a plus.
  • Experience with automating commercial or open-source vulnerability and misconfiguration scanners and reporting tools regarding Infrastructure/ IP based Assets, Containers, CSPM and CNAPP. Examples: Qualys, TenableSC, Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Orca, Lacework, Paramify, Atlassian Jira, ServiceNow etc. are a plus.
  • Familiarity with industry standards, frameworks and publications such as CVE, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP and CISA KEV catalog is a plus.

Additional requirements:

  • U.S. soil status - the employee must be on U.S. soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, and be a U.S. person.
  • U.S. person status - the employee must be either a U.S. citizen as defined in 42 U.S. Code § 9102; a natural person who is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3); or a U.S. national (i.e. includes citizens and non-citizens born in outlying possessions such as American Samoa and Swains Island), green card holders, refugees, and asylees. Working on a U.S. visa does NOT qualify as a U.S. person.
  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. TS/SCI clearance with Full Scope Poly Compliance Expertise: Proven experience navigating Federal and DoD compliance frameworks, specifically FedRAMP and Impact Level 6 (IL6)

descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. The Regional Enablement Leader, EMEA

The Regional Enablement Leader, EMEA will spearhead our enablement strategy and execution across the EMEA region. This is a critical people leadership role responsible for acting as the EMEA "Pod Leader." You will partner closely with the SVP of EMEA, the senior director of Sales Ops, and regional senior Sales Leaders to improve sales productivity, capability, and performance.

As the Pod Leader, you will act as the linchpin between global mandates and regional necessities. You will lead a dedicated regional team and orchestrate a wider cross-functional network to ensure that both global CRO priorities and regional SVP strategies are harmonized into one cohesive, high-impact enablement plan.
You will also act as an Enablement Business Partner within the region. The Enablement Business Partner (EBP) team bridges global enablement strategies with field execution. They act as trusted advisors to sales leaders, tailoring programs to regional and segment-specific needs. Focused on collaboration, alignment, and measurable impact, EBPs drive knowledge retention, skill development, and performance improvement to empower our teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Cohesive Strategy Creation & Execution: Act as the strategic owner for the EMEA region by creating and executing both the global enablement strategy (driven by the CRO) and the regional enablement strategy (driven by the SVP of EMEA). You will be responsible for combining these two parallel tracks into one unified, cohesive plan for the field.

  • Team Leadership & Generalist Development: Direct and mentor the EMEA Enablement Pod, fostering a culture of "enablement generalists." While your direct reports will execute global and regional strategies within their specific swim lanes, you will actively coach and deploy them outside of their core scopes (e.g., placing the xDR or onboarding resource on a project assigned to tenured AEs) as regional priorities demand.

  • Agile Resource Allocation: Ensure the Pod executes on the CRO's global priorities as mission-critical. Effectively assess and manage your team’s capacity, taking any remaining discretionary time to build, assign, and execute regionally focused programs that directly support the SVP of EMEA's strategy.

  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the ultimate conductor for regional readiness by orchestrating resources far beyond the remit of your direct reports. Bring together stakeholders from Presales, Partners, Customer First, People/Talent, and Marketing to create a comprehensive, unified regional enablement plan. Ensure visibility into how all resources in the region are working together to drive EMEA's priorities.

  • Voice of the Field (VoF): Play a pivotal role in representing the EMEA field's perspective. Gather insights through close collaboration with all levels of sales leadership and the extended selling team. Channel this feedback to the Global Enablement Team (GET) and other supporting functions to shape future global initiatives.

  • Strategic Alignment with the Field: Build trust-based relationships with sales leaders, managers, and individual contributors. Act as a strategic advisor who diagnoses business challenges, identifies root causes, and recommends enablement solutions that improve sales execution and commercial outcomes.

  • Program Activation & Execution: Maintain accountability for launching global and local enablement initiatives within EMEA. Work closely with program owners to build engagement and adoption strategies, ensuring seamless execution, facilitation, and the tracking of success metrics.

  • Sales and Business Acumen: Maintain deep knowledge of products, use cases, deal progression, and Customer Engagement Models (CEM). Understand the strategic goals, market dynamics, and financial levers of the EMEA business.

What You’ll Bring to the Role & What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or a related field, ideally within the tech or SaaS industry, with a proven track record of developing and delivering tailored enablement programs

  • People Leadership: Experience leading, managing, and developing a team of enablement professionals. A strong desire to build a versatile team of "enablement generalists" who can flex into different projects as business needs dictate.

  • Strategic Agility: Proven ability to synthesize overarching global directives (CRO) with hyper-local, regional requirements (SVP) into a single actionable strategy without dropping the ball on either.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to orchestrate, influence, and align cross-functional leaders (Presales, Partners, Customer First, Marketing) over whom you do not have direct authority.

  • Trusted Advisor: Proven ability to act as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders (SVP/VP level), analyzing data and business challenges to propose targeted enablement solutions.

  • Sales Expertise: Deep understanding of sales execution, including onboarding, sales processes, XDR motions, buyer personas, and challenges. Familiarity with MEDDPICC (or similar methodologies) is highly preferred.

  • Execution & Analytics: Experience designing enablement programs that drive measurable sales performance improvements. Competence in leveraging sales enablement platforms (e.g., Highspot) and the ability to assess program effectiveness through data, focusing on ROI.

  • Communication: Excellent facilitation, executive communication, and storytelling abilities to connect with remote, geographically dispersed teams at all seniority levels.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Infrastructure Management: Administer and optimize our core productivity suite, including Google Workspace, Gemini, Slack, Asana, Smartsheet, and other tools.
  • AI Integration & Strategy: Lead the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of enterprise AI tools (specifically Gemini), ensuring they are integrated safely and effectively into daily workflows.

Okta is seeking a Staff Application Developer – People Technology  to join our Business Solutions Team. In this critical role, you will partner closely with the People Technology leadership and play a key role in our Workday transformation efforts. As part of a cross-functional team, you will collaborate with stakeholders across People, Payroll, IT, Finance, and international offices to optimize and scale our HR systems and processes.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about solving complex business challenges, driving innovation through automation, and delivering a best-in-class user experience.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and technical design of Workday Extend applications, integrations, and supporting technology solutions.
  • Define scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable application architecture, integration architecture, data flows, API strategies, and technical standards.
  • Architect and lead the development of complex Workday Extend applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, Workday APIs, and Extend frameworks.
  • Architect enterprise Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, RaaS, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and Workday Web Services.
  • Evaluate business requirements and determine the appropriate solution across Workday configuration, Extend, integrations, APIs, AI, cloud services, and third-party platforms.
  • Establish architectural patterns and reusable frameworks for Workday Extend applications and integrations to support scalability, extensibility, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Provide technical leadership for the complete application lifecycle, including architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, release management, and production support.
  • Develop solutions that leverage AI and Generative AI to enable intelligent automation, enhanced user experiences, decision support, and innovative business capabilities within the Workday ecosystem.
  • Assess and utilize AWS cloud services where required to support application components, APIs, integrations, data processing, AI capabilities, and enterprise workloads.
  • Define and govern API, integration, security, authentication, authorization, error-handling, monitoring, logging, and performance strategies.
  • Partner with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, functional leads, security teams, cloud teams, and engineering teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise technology standards and business objectives.
  • Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and solution estimations for complex business initiatives.
  • Review and approve technical designs, application architecture, integration patterns, and development approaches to ensure adherence to architectural standards.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability concerns, and opportunities for modernization, and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance when required while leading and mentoring senior developers and engineering teams.
  • Establish development and engineering best practices, including code quality, version control, CI/CD, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Workday technical landscape by evaluating new capabilities across Workday Extend, Workday Integration, Orchestrate, AI/GenAI, AWS, APIs, and emerging technologies.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 8 to 10 years of overall IT/software development experience.

We are looking for a highly strategic Pre-Sales professional whose consultative expertise, emotional intelligence, and enterprise sales acumen are their defining strengths.   • Drive Value-Based Outcomes: Lead the technical evaluation phases of complex B2B SaaS sales cycles. You will proactively overcome objections and drive enterprise deals to technical closure by continuously tying Okta's capabilities back to the customer's core business drivers of breach protection and operational resilience.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Build strong, consultative relationships with strategic customers, establishing yourself as a subject matter expert in Identity Security, modern identity standards (SAML, OIDC, SSF), and Zero Trust Architecture.

What You'll Bring

  • Consultative & Interpersonal Acumen: Top-tier executive communication, presentation, and storytelling abilities. You have experience running value-based sales motions, know how to read a room, build rapport quickly, and influence decision-makers by focusing on revenue, cost, and risk.
  • Technical Agility: A strong technical foundation coupled with a demonstrated ability to learn new enterprise technologies and architectures rapidly.
  • Identity & Cybersecurity Expertise: Broad understanding of the complete Identity Security landscape. You recognize that identity is much more than just SSO and MFA, bringing knowledge of Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management, Threat Protection, modern authentication protocols, and Zero Trust Architecture.

Bonus Skills (Highly Desired)

  • Advanced Identity Governance & Automation: Direct, hands-on experience positioning and selling Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, and identity security automation workflows to large enterprises.

We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box—we are looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences and backgrounds.

Join our team! We are building a world where Identity belongs to you.

Hybrid work - 3 days a week from the office.

Identity Security Pillar

Okta's Identity Security Pillar is at the forefront of defending modern enterprise environments against sophisticated identity-centric attacks. As enterprise attack surfaces expand across clouds, SaaS ecosystems, and hybrid networks, our pillar delivers unified, next-generation security capabilities that protect organizations across the entire threat lifecycle.

Joining our pillar gives you the unique opportunity to build and impact diverse, cutting-edge products across the security domain, including:

  • Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM): Delivering continuous, contextual visibility into complex identity infrastructure, surfacing misconfigurations, eliminating toxic combinations of permissions, and reducing overall attack surfaces.
  • Identity Threat Protection (ITP): ITP delivers real-time, surgical defense against the most sophisticated and rapidly evolving threats. By deeply integrating with existing security infrastructure, ITP relentlessly analyzes user behavior and system data to proactively hunt down and neutralize risks before they impact our customers.
  • Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR): Detecting sophisticated credential compromise, privilege escalation, and lateral movement with speed and automated response capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling our foundational platforms and web applications, with a primary emphasis on backend architecture and distributed services. You will partner closely with distributed teams to deliver robust, high-performance security solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build high-quality backend services while collaborating with frontend developers to ensure seamless integration across the stack.
  • Raise the bar on engineering excellence by improving standard methodologies, producing best-in-class code, documentation, testing, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate with product and R&D engineers to translate product requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues and performance bottlenecks within the backend systems.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve our backend services and overall application performance.
  • Be a mentor to colleagues and help promote knowledge sharing within the team.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining complex, enterprise-grade distributed systems in high-growth environments.
  • Backend Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing backend services using Node.js and modern TypeScript.
  • Frontend Knowledge: Proven working familiarity with modern frontend frameworks, specifically React, enabling seamless collaboration and full-stack ownership.
  • Architectural Mastery: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, asynchronous event-driven design, and data persistence patterns.
  • Database & Storage Systems: Practical experience working with relational databases as well as NoSQL/caching stores.
  • System Principles: Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and scalable software design patterns.
  • Collaboration & Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with strong communication abilities to collaborate across distributed, global engineering teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Extra Credit: If You Have Experience In

  • Frameworks such as NestJS or similar enterprise-grade Node.js server frameworks.
  • Modern cloud platforms (particularly AWS) and container orchestration.
  • Identity and security domains (IAM, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, posture management, threat detection, or cloud security).

descriptionHtml:

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. The Global Pricing Operations Team

The Pricing Operations team works in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and dynamic environment with many moving pieces and evolving business needs. The team partners with Pricing Strategy Managers, Product Managers, Technology, Data & Intelligence,  and various GTM teams to ensure Okta is operationally ready to bring new product pricing, buying programs, and strategic monetization initiatives to market. 

The Pricing Operations Principal Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Pricing Operations Principal to lead initiatives that transform Okta's pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution. A successful person in this role will be a strong collaborator, intensely curious, and supremely organized. They are known for connecting the dots, simplifying complexities, communicating clearly and proactively, and driving highly collaborative efforts to completion, even when the path forward isn't perfectly defined. 

In this role, you will serve as an operational leader for new pricing launches and a strategic buying-program implementation, establishing the integrated roadmap, operating cadence, decision-making framework, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications required to bring these initiatives from concept through launch and sustained adoption. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional leaders to make complex tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to sell, quote, contract, provision, bill, recognize revenue, support, and renew under the new model.

As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to transform pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution
  • Lead the operational implementation of buying programs that will affect how Okta packages, sells, measures, and supports its offerings, driving cross-functional alignment from design through launch and adoption.
  • Collaborate closely with several functions across the company, including Pricing Strategy, Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Finance, GTM, and Technology, Data & Intelligence, to evaluate the operational impact of pricing initiatives, develop operational readiness plans, and execute launches
  • Navigate ambiguity and fast-moving strategy decisions with confidence, helping the team align quickly and move forward effectively
  • Continuously assess and re-prioritize workstreams as business needs evolve, maintaining clarity and momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Drive strategic projects that use AI and other technology tools to optimize and automate pricing processes, strengthen operational standards, and improve cross-functional engagement frameworks.
  • Develop business requirements for Technology, Data & Intelligence to build new SKUs in Okta's business systems to support quoting, invoicing, revenue recognition, reporting, and improved transaction processes for Okta's sales teams
  • Proactively synthesize and communicate status updates, risks, and blockers to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders for pricing launches — not just when asked, but as a consistent habit
  • Partner with GTM teams to assess enablement needs and develop, deliver, and optimize pricing enablement, training, and field communications for new launches, strategic initiatives, and ongoing pricing changes.
  • Serve as SME on pricing, product configuration, and go-to-market processes
  • Actively contribute to team culture by seeking and incorporating feedback, sharing learnings, and helping raise the bar for how the Pricing Operations function operates

What you'll bring to the role

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in pricing operations, business operations, strategic program management, revenue operations, quote-to-cash, commercial operations, Deal Desk, or a related field. This may include experience gained in-house or through management, operations, or implementation consulting.
  • At least 5 years leading complex, cross-functional programs or major operational changes, such as implementing a commercial program, buying model, pricing initiative, or related strategic transformation. Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.
  • Experience working with Pricing, Product, Product Marketing, GTM, Finance, Legal, and Technology teams to translate strategy into operational plans, system requirements, enablement, and launch execution.
  • Experience implementing a commercial program, buying program, pricing initiative, or other operational change that affects multiple stages of the customer lifecycle, including quoting, contracting, billing, provisioning, reporting, renewals, or customer support.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, including system builds involving quotable SKUs, product configuration, custom fields, validation rules, alert rules, and other quote-to-cash capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration, along with experience using AI tools to improve processes and automate workflows.
  • Experience working with or alongside Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, GTM Strategy & Operations, Sales Operations, or similar teams, with a strong understanding of how pricing and operational decisions affect selling, quoting, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, and customer support.
  • A track record of bringing structure to complex and ambiguous work, influencing without authority, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities, surfacing risks early, and driving decisions through launch and adoption.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, along with a proactive, organized, collaborative, and results-oriented approach.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience working in a high-growth or evolving environment where you have built trusted cross-functional relationships, brought structure to ambiguous and complex initiatives, continuously improved processes and ways of working, and used AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

This role is ideal for a senior operator who can turn complex pricing and buying program initiatives into clear plans, align diverse teams, and drive execution from concept through launch and adoption. You will help build durable capabilities that support future pricing and go-to-market transformations at Okta.

Title of Job: Senior Product Acceleration Specialist - Auth0
Reports to: Director, Product Acceleration

Job Purpose

As a Senior Product Acceleration Specialist for Auth0, you will play a critical role in driving customer success, deep product adoption, and long-term retention across Okta’s most strategic Global 2000 (G2K) enterprise accounts. In this highly technical, developer-centric role, you will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise engineering, architecture, security, and application teams, helping them deploy complex, low-friction, high-volume Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions on the Auth0 platform. 

Leveraging your deep Auth0 domain knowledge, you will guide customers through their deployment journeys by supporting key architectural decisions, driving optimal platform usage, and troubleshooting complex technical issues. Operating at the intersection of post-sales support, developer enablement, and product innovation, your core focus will include deploying modern front-end frameworks alongside validating New Product Introductions (NPIs). In doing so, you will act as the essential feedback bridge between G2K engineering teams and Auth0’s Product Management.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Post-Sales Architectural Advisory & Troubleshooting: Partner directly with G2K Enterprise Customers to guide complex implementation patterns, navigate key architectural decisions, and resolve complex configuration challenges to maximize platform capabilities.
  • Pre-Sales & NPI Launch Support: Partner with Sales Engineering and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams during the rollout of New Product Introductions (NPIs). Develop high-impact Proof of Concepts (PoCs), early-adopter demonstrations, and technical enablement assets to help secure technical wins and drive initial pipeline for emerging Auth0 capabilities within G2K accounts.
  • Developer Enablement & Prototyping: Assist customer development teams by providing architectural guidance on custom Auth0 Actions, SDK implementation blueprints, and modern full-stack application patterns (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Mobile).
  • Product & NPI Feedback Loop: Act as a technical liaison between G2K Enterprise Customers and Auth0 Product Management to identify feature gaps, test early-stage NPIs, and drive product roadmap enhancements based on real-world enterprise needs.
  • Field & Customer Mentorship: Create reusable code samples, technical documentation, and enablement guides to train G2K teams (Professional Services, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Partners) and customer developers on advanced Auth0 capabilities.
  • AI Tooling & Automation: Leverage AI tools and LLM workflows to accelerate code generation, SDK debugging, technical documentation, and complex implementation analysis.
  • Multi-Project Execution: Manage multiple concurrent technical engagements effectively while prioritizing tasks to ensure high customer satisfaction, which includes providing a rapid, hands-on response to high-priority customer escalations and fast-moving GTM activities.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

  • Experience: 6+ years in a customer-facing technical field role within a Go-To-Market (GTM) organization (e.g., Pre-Sales/Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or Senior Support) delivering identity or SaaS solutions to enterprise accounts.
  • Auth0 & CIAM Depth: Expert-level understanding of the Auth0 platform and modern Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) patterns, including low-friction authentication, high-volume user management, and extensibility via custom Auth0 Actions.
  • Full-Stack Development Skills: Proven experience reading, writing, and debugging full-stack application code using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, and modern Mobile SDKs.
  • Identity Protocols & Security: Deep understanding of identity federation, access control frameworks, and core protocols including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.
  • Identity Security & Threat Defense: In-depth knowledge of the CIAM threat landscape, with a proven ability to design and scale resilient authentication flows that mitigate both traditional identity attacks (credential stuffing, account takeover, automated bot attacks, etc.) and emerging next-generation threats (AI-driven social engineering, LLM-based phishing, and automated fraud attacks, etc.)
  • G2K Enterprise Experience: Demonstrated history of navigating complex, large-scale IT landscapes, web technologies, and cloud architectures for G2K customers.
  • Communication & Advisory: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical/developer concepts to non-technical stakeholders and strategically guide senior engineering leaders.
  • Education: A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required.

descriptionHtml:

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta for AI Agents Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agentic Identity—including pioneer work with securing AI Agents and support for protocols like MCP. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

About the role

In this role, you will join the Agent Access Policies sub-team within Okta Secures AI as a Staff Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to advance Okta's authorization capabilities. By replacing static, rule-based systems with dynamic AI security mechanisms, you will deliver real-time threat inspection, agent intent evaluation, and behavioral analysis—ensuring autonomous AI agents operate safely within specified bounds.

Your core mission will be architecting and driving features for our unified control plane to establish the premier Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. In doing so, you will help execute our guiding principle: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

What you’ll be doing 

  • Implement intent-based enforcement to verify agent runtime requests match their intended purpose, requiring key capabilities.
  • Apply LLM reasoning and prompt parsing to interpret prompts, tool payloads, and intent in real time.
  • Integrate low-latency inference or semantic evaluation engines directly into the API gateway request path.
  • Use embeddings, vector search, or zero-shot classification to score alignment between agent intent and executed actions.
  • Design confidence-scored decision engines that feed semantic verification results into policy frameworks (e.g., Cedar).
  • Establish evaluation benchmarks, prompt injection defenses, and guardrails to prevent bypasses or false positives.
  • Architect scalable ML and Generative AI systems integrating retrieval, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Optimize prompting, context retrieval, and RAG workflows for accuracy, safety, and efficiency in Claude-based systems.
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure model quality, correctness, groundedness, and safety in production.
  • Implement schema validation, structured output enforcement, and guardrails to ensure reliable, compliant AI outputs.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of software development experience, with strong programming expertise in Python (and familiarity with Go or Typescript a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with applied machine learning, from feature engineering to training and fine-tuning models.
  • Hands-on experience with modern Generative AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and knowledge-base workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with LiteLLM, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, or other related AI agent frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks (FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark ML) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, etc.).
  • Experience defining evaluation metrics, pipelines, and feedback loops for ML/GenAI systems.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive greenfield initiatives forward, navigate unknowns, and iterate quickly and frequently.
  • Experience building tools or infrastructure for AI/ML applications, with a deep understanding of the developer lifecycle in an AI-native world.   
  • Education:Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field                                                                                            

Extra credit

  • Experience integrating AI-driven systems with identity, authentication, or security products.
  • Exposure to ethical AI, model risk, or compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with evaluation datasets, synthetic data generation, or LLM-as-a-judge methods.

descriptionHtml:

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Position Overview

At Okta, we are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and analytical Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Americas Payroll team. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing accurate, compliant, and timely semi-monthly payroll operations across multi-state US jurisdictions for over 5,000+ employees, with opportunities to support broader AMER entities (e.g., Canada, Argentina, Mexico and Uruguay).

As a subject matter expert in payroll processing, multi-state tax compliance, and benefit/equity reconciliations, you will drive operational excellence, implement workflow automations, and deliver white-glove support to our growing employee base.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • End-to-End Payroll Operations: Own and execute complex bi-weekly multi-state US payroll cycles, ensuring accurate calculations for base salary, variable compensation (sales commissions, bonuses), retro adjustments, and termination payouts.
  • Equity & Off-Cycle Administration: Partner closely with Stock Administration and Accounting to process and reconcile equity-related transactions (RSUs, ESPP, NQSOs) and manage off-cycle payroll runs.
  • Benefits, Deductions & Garnishments: Oversee compliance and execution of specialized deductions, including 401(k) contributions/match audits, FSA/HSA, wage garnishments, and taxable fringe benefits.
  • Tax & Statutory Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations. Manage multi-state tax setups, resolve tax agency notices, and support year-end W-2 reconciliation and reporting.
  • Internal Controls & Audits: Execute rigorous pre- and post-payroll audit procedures in compliance with SOX controls, internal accounting policies, and external financial audit requirements.
  • Process Automation & Efficiency: Identify opportunities to optimize workflows; develop and maintain automated reporting and reconciliation models using advanced Excel and data tools (e.g., Alteryx, Workday EIBs).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Support: Serve as a Tier-2 escalation point for employee inquiries submitted via ServiceNow. Collaborate cross-functionally with People Operations, Total Rewards, HR Business Partners, and Corporate Accounting.

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications & Experience)

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive, end-to-end multi-state US payroll experience, ideally within a high-growth SaaS, tech, or large public enterprise environment.
  • Technical & System Expertise:
    • Advanced proficiency with Workday Payroll and Workday HCM.
    • Deep experience with payroll vendor reporting tools, ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow), and time-tracking systems.
    • Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested logic, pivot tables). Experience with Alteryx or other automation tools is a strong plus.
  • Payroll & Tax Knowledge: In-depth understanding of US labor laws, FLSA classifications, multi-state withholding, reciprocal agreements, and payroll accounting principles (GL mapping, accruals, account reconciliations).
  • Problem Solving & Autonomy: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to independently investigate payroll discrepancies, reconcile large datasets, and handle ambiguous scenarios.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to clearly explain complex compensation and tax matters to employees and leadership.
  • Certifications: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or equivalent payroll accreditation is preferred.

Why Join Okta’s Americas Payroll Team?

  • Be part of a collaborative, high-impact finance and accounting organization that values innovation, automation, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy competitive total compensation, comprehensive health and retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching and ESPP), and flexible remote work flexibility.

Staff Software Engineer (Federal)

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Identity Governance Team

Okta Identity Governance (OIG) is Okta's Identity Governance and Administration solution, responsible for some of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how people request access, how approvers grant it, how entitlements are enforced, and how organizations prove to auditors that only the right people have the right access.

OIG is the leading contributor to Okta's new product bookings, and it runs inside some of the largest enterprises in the world — the kind of accounts where a single tenant carries hundreds of thousands of identities across thousands of applications.

OIG currently supports high-compliance public sector workloads and plans to expand our footprint to support the most secure, highly classified environments in government.

The Staff Software Engineer (Federal) Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the OIG (Federal) team, your mission is to adapt the OIG product to the needs of the government customers. 

In this role, you will actively design, build, and maintain both robust backend services and intuitive frontend interfaces. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every aspect of the product.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain cloud and on-premises infrastructure across high-compliance security baselines.
  • Support operations transitioning into disconnected, air-gapped, and top-secret defense environments.
  • Maintain strict security controls, audit readiness, and continuous monitoring for classified networks.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to ensure software deployments meet stringent governmental security standards.
  • Proactively identify and prioritize tech debt; drive improvements in areas beyond feature work - CI/CD, observability, documentation, reliability, and support processes.
  • Partner with Product and Design to understand and own the desired customer outcome, not just the technical deliverable.
  • Actively invest in the growth of peer engineers, taking responsibility for raising the technical bar of the team as a whole.

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen. Candidate must possess an active clearance or have the ability to obtain and maintain a high-level government security clearance (e.g., Secret / Top Secret / SCI) based on mission requirements.
  • 8+ years in software engineering, shipping enterprise cloud software
  • Hands-on depth in coding at scale using: Java, Python, or TypeScript, plus API (REST, gRPC) and UI automation (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent)
  • Experience with CI/CD (CircleCI or equivalent), containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and a major cloud platform
  • Operates well beyond basic AI tool usage - understands how to apply AI meaningfully across the full software development lifecycle, can evaluate and adopt new AI tooling with good judgment, and is able to establish practices and bring a team along.
  • Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies - including the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with lasting org-wide impact.
  • Solid understanding of web authentication and authorization fundamentals - how auth flows work, and best practices for securing sensitive user data.             
  • Architectural expertise: Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies, including making decisions with lasting, org-wide impact.
  • Backend proficiency: Deep expertise in building reliable, secure, enterprise-grade software in Java or another type-safe language.
  • Frontend flexibility: High proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with true fullstack range, including the ability to ship robust frontends.   

Security Clearance: Active U.S. TS/SCI clearance with Full Scope Poly Compliance Expertise: Proven experience navigating Federal and DoD compliance frameworks, specifically FedRAMP and Impact Level 6 (IL6)                                            

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • Federal Infrastructure Expertise: Hands-on experience building, scaling, and troubleshooting infrastructure in restricted environments (e.g., FedRAMP Medium/High, DoD Impact Levels, or air-gapped systems).
  • Network & Security Isolation: Solid understanding of air-gap architectures, strict access controls, zero-trust frameworks, and data diode/secure transfer mechanisms.
  • Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) — access requests, certifications, entitlement management, separation of duties, or role modeling (Okta, SailPoint, Saviynt, One Identity, Oracle, or in-house)
  • Identity and Access Management more broadly: SSO, SCIM provisioning, directory integration, or privileged access
  • Work experience in a compliance context — SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP — including audit evidence validation

Additional requirements:

  • U.S. soil status - the employee must be on U.S. soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101
  • U.S. Security Clearance status - the employee must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) to the extent required by U.S. Government contracts.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agent Gateway
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Agent Gateway Team

The Agent Gateway team owns the identity-aware infrastructure that connects enterprise AI agents to the tools, data, and services their organizations authorize. Every call from Claude, Agentforce, Codex, and internal/homegrown agents to a resource flows through us. We enforce authorization, isolate credentials, mint the right token per target, and produce the audit trails that security teams rely on.

We are early in a rapidly evolving space. The standards for agent identity (MCP, OAuth token exchange, DCR) are being built under our feet. Our roadmap includes hardening the data plane for on-premises customer deployments, extending policy semantics beyond tool-level allowlists, adding native support for Agent-to-Agent brokered delegation, and scaling to tenants with thousands of virtual MCP servers.

The Senior Software Engineer Opportunity

Okta is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the Agent Gateway. You will own features and components across the data and control planes, turning technical designs and product requirements into reliable production systems. Working alongside staff engineers, you will implement token exchange, request routing, credential resolution, and policy evaluation as agent identity specifications evolve.

This is a hands-on software development role at the intersection of product, security, and infrastructure. You will ship services that handle agentic traffic reliably and performantly at scale.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and Ship: Own the implementation of gateway features end-to-end — from virtual MCP server aggregation to token exchange and policy evaluation — with tests, observability, and operational readiness built in.
  • Work in the Runtime Path: Write code that handles credentials, tokens, tenant isolation, and audit logging with care. The gateway sits in the critical path for customer agent traffic, so correctness and reliability matter on every change.
  • Implement the Protocols: Read and implement MCP, OAuth token exchange, and agent identity specifications, and feed production lessons back into designs and reference implementations.
  • Ship With Agentic Tooling: Use Claude, Claude Code, and MCP-connected agents as everyday parts of your workflow across design, code generation, code review, and operations.
  • Contribute to Quality: Participate in code review, testing, incident response, and our design-doc culture, and help raise the team's engineering bar.

What You'll Bring to the Role

  • Experience: 4+ years building production backend systems, ideally distributed and highly available.
  • Technical Depth: Proficiency shipping production services in Java and/or Go.
  • Domain Knowledge: Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, and comfort reading and implementing spec-driven code. Familiarity with RFC 8693 token exchange is a plus.
  • Operational Sense: Hands-on experience with service rollouts, feature flags, observability, and incident response.
  • Agentic Fluency: Working familiarity with agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP servers, AI-assisted code review), with a point of view on where they accelerate work.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate across a data plane service and a larger identity control plane.

Extra Credit

  • Experience building or integrating with an MCP server, an agent framework, or an LLM-facing gateway.
  • Prior work on multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Exposure to identity, authorization, or edge-of-network services.
  • Active participation in standards work in the agent identity space (MCP, OAuth, GNAP, DCR).
  • Full-stack or frontend experience for the gateway's admin and configuration surfaces.

The Okta Identity Governance Team

Okta Identity Governance (OIG) is Okta's Identity Governance and Administration solution, responsible for some of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how people request access, how approvers grant it, how entitlements are enforced, and how organizations prove to auditors that only the right people have the right access.

OIG is the leading contributor to Okta's new product bookings, and it runs inside some of the largest enterprises in the world — the kind of accounts where a single tenant carries hundreds of thousands of identities across thousands of applications.

Quality here is a compliance bar, not just a user experience one. When a governance product has a defect, a company can stay over-provisioned on access it believes it revoked, or hand an auditor evidence that isn't true.

The Senior Engineering Manager, SDET Opportunity

As Senior Engineering Manager, SDET, you'll own the quality strategy for OIG and lead the quality engineers and SDETs behind it — 10 scrum teams, with engineers in Canada, the US, and India. You'll set how we test governance at enterprise scale — long-running certification campaigns, tenants with millions of entitlements, dozens of third-party connectors, and audit records that must be provably correct.

You'll run multiple workstreams at once, delegate tactical decisions while staying close enough to dive in, and hold a quality position with engineering and product peers as a partner rather than a gatekeeper.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the quality strategy for OIG — test approach, coverage model, automation architecture, environments, and release readiness — aligned to the pillar's goals
  • Lead, grow, and retain a distributed team of quality engineers and SDETs; own team calibration and promotion planning, and drive recruiting as hiring manager
  • Coach engineers on growth with timely, actionable feedback, and delegate without creating bottlenecks or hero culture
  • Drive automation strategy across API, integration, and UI layers, converting manual regression into deterministic CI/CD gates
  • Own the quality signal — escaped defects, coverage, flaky rate, time-to-detect — and use it to drive release decisions
  • Lead scale and data-integrity testing for large-tenant campaigns, bulk entitlement operations, and high-volume imports
  • Embed quality engineers into architecture and design reviews so testability and risk analysis shape the product early
  • Track your team's investment mix, manage expectations across workstreams, and keep the team healthy and out of burnout
  • Partner with engineering, product, design, docs, and support; turn escaped defects and RCAs into durable automated coverage

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • 10+ years in quality or test engineering, or software engineering with a quality focus, shipping enterprise cloud software
  • 4+ years managing engineers, including distributed teams and more than one workstream at a time
  • A track record of owning quality strategy for a product area, not just executing test plans
  • Hands-on depth in test automation at scale: Java, Python, or TypeScript, plus API (REST, gRPC) and UI automation (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent)
  • Experience with CI/CD (CircleCI or equivalent), containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and a major cloud platform
  • Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS, including asynchronous, event-driven systems and data reconciliation between systems
  • Comfort making trade-off and risk calls against real constraints, and communicating them clearly
  • A record of growing people, including promotions you've built the case for
  • Experience recruiting, mentoring, and retaining engineers

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) — access requests, certifications, entitlement management, separation of duties, or role modeling (Okta, SailPoint, Saviynt, One Identity, Oracle, or in-house)

  • Testing in a compliance context — SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP — including audit evidence validation
  • Performance, scale, or resilience engineering for data-heavy enterprise workloads
  • Managing managers or tech leads

title: Senior Product Manager, Okta Customer Identity
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The role

Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. Okta Customer Identity (OCI) is the identity platform behind that promise for the applications our customers build for their own customers: the login, MFA, and account management layer for millions of end users across B2B, B2B2C and B2C products. OCI sits alongside Okta Workforce Identity (OWI) as one of the two halves of the Okta platform.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to grow OCI's footprint inside our existing enterprise base and to incubate the next generation of platform capabilities. This is a builder's role. You'll spend a good chunk of your time in true zero-to-one territory: sizing a raw opportunity, proving it out with a design partner or two, and turning it into a capability that ships and gets adopted. You'll spend the rest of it as the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, and go-to-market, making sure those bets land in the field.

What you will own

  • New Capability Incubation: Own the pipeline of zero-to-one bets on the Okta’s Okta Customer Identity platform, from a rough problem statement through a validated design and a shipped v1. You'll decide what's worth building before anyone asks engineering to build it.
  • Platform Growth: Drive the product side of Okta Customer Identity platform expansion into our existing enterprise base. You'll turn a hypothesis about why they haven't adopted the Okta Customer Identity platform into product changes that remove the reason.
  • Cross-functional Delivery: Be the person engineering, design, research, and go-to-market call when a new Okta Customer Identity platform capability needs a decision. You'll write the specs, run the reviews, and keep a dozen loosely connected workstreams moving toward the same launch.

A day in the life

Your day splits between zero-to-one thinking and shipping discipline. You might start the morning studying churn or expansion data for a segment we don't serve well yet, trying to figure out whether the gap is a feature gap or a positioning gap. An hour later you're on a call with a design partner customer, walking through a rough prototype and taking notes on what confused them.

By midday you're in execution mode: reviewing a spec with your engineering lead, debating whether a capability needs its own data model or can extend an existing one, and pushing back on scope that's grown past what the opportunity actually justifies. You write plainly. Your specs read like an explanation to a smart colleague, not a wish list.

In the afternoon you sync with go-to-market and your PMM partner on how a capability in progress should be positioned once it ships, and you flag anything that changes the pitch. You close the day presenting to a customer or prospect, walking them through what's shipped and what's coming on the roadmap. 

Responsibilities

  • Identify, size, and validate new zero-to-one opportunities on the Okta Customer Identity platform, using customer conversations, usage data, and market signals rather than internal opinion alone.
  • Define and execute a roadmap that balances new capability bets against platform reliability, security hardening, and performance
  • Write clear, detailed specs and requirements that give engineering and design unambiguous direction, especially in areas with no existing playbook.
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing to turn a shipped capability into an adopted one, including understanding why customers who should adopt haven't.
  • Track the CIAM market and competitive moves from Auth0, Microsoft, and Ping, and use that context to sharpen where the Okta Customer Identity platform should and shouldn't compete.
  • Be the go-to expert for your area of the Okta Customer Identity platform roadmap in front of customers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

Required

  • 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or identity and access management, with at least one zero-to-one launch you can speak to end to end.
  • A track record of building and executing a strategy that spans multiple teams, and delivering on it, not just presenting it.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a spec an engineer can build from and a one-pager an executive can act on, without changing the substance between the two.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills. You can build a credible plan from incomplete or conflicting inputs, and explain the assumptions behind it.
  • BS in Computer Science, Business, or an equivalent background, with the ability to hold your own in a design review with engineering and architecture.

Preferred

  • Experience with Customer Identity and Access Management 
  • Experience partnering with sales or customer success on an attach or expansion motion, not just a net-new sales motion.
  • Public speaking experience, ideally in front of customers or at industry events.
  • MBA or equivalent graduate business degree.

Top 3 qualities we are hiring for

  • Zero-to-one conviction: You've taken a fuzzy opportunity from "should we even do this?" to a shipped, adopted capability, without a playbook telling you how. You know the difference between not validated yet and not going to work, and you don't confuse the two.
  • Decisive action in the dark: You rarely have perfect data or complete requirements. You confidently make high-stakes calls using a mix of telemetry, customer anecdotes, and sharp product intuition. You explicitly name your assumptions, move fast, and revise them in public without ego when new information arrives.
  • Unquestioned influence: You lead without relying on a reporting structure. You naturally align engineering, design, GTM, and the field behind your understanding of the customer. You are the definitive, credible voice of the product in CISO boardrooms and internal executive reviews.

**You must attend in person orientation physically in the Toronto office on the first Tuesday of employment.
**You must go physically into the Toronto office 2 days a week.

Based in our Dublin, Ireland office and reporting directly to the Director of Global Security & Safety, the Global Health & Safety Manager will own the design, execution, governance, and continuous enhancement of Okta’s global health, safety, and occupational wellness framework.

While anchored in Dublin, this is a broad, truly global leadership role. Because Okta operates dynamic, distributed workplaces across multiple international jurisdictions, the Global Health & Safety Manager will scale operations by directing an extensive network of specialized third-party vendors, global EHS consultants, and local practitioners. In addition to overarching workplace safety, this leader serves as the global program owner for Okta’s Workers’ Compensation and Occupational Injury/Illness Claims Management.

Key Responsibilities

1. 3rd-Party Vendor Management & Global Partner Ecosystem

  • Serve as the principal manager and strategic owner of Okta’s global health and safety vendor ecosystem, including multinational EHS environmental/safety consulting firms, localized safety practitioners, and specialized service partners.
  • Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and service level agreements (SLAs) for external EHS partners supporting regional risk assessments, statutory testing, and compliance filings.
  • Manage vendor procurement, contract evaluations, invoicing, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to ensure cost-efficiency, technical rigor, and consistent service delivery across all global locations.
  • Direct external partners in conducting localized site inspections, air quality monitoring, industrial hygiene assessments, and acoustic/lighting studies.

2. Global Workers' Compensation & Claims Management

  • Serve as the single point of contact and global program manager for Okta’s Workers’ Compensation, Employers' Liability, and occupational injury/illness programs across all global jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate closely with People Operations (HR), Risk Management/Treasury, legal counsel, insurance brokers, and Third-Party Claims Administrators (TPAs) to oversee claim lifecycles, reserve tracking, and settlements.
  • Implement and manage a global Return-to-Work (RTW) and modified-duty framework to support injured or ill employees and safely reduce lost time.
  • Conduct regular claims audits, review carrier loss-run reports, identify global workplace injury trends, and execute root-cause mitigation programs.
  • Ensure regulatory reporting compliance across regions (e.g., Irish Health and Safety Authority [HSA] statutory notifications, US OSHA 300 logs, and relevant EMEA/APAC incident reporting requirements).

3. Global Health & Safety Governance & Statutory Compliance

  • Formulate, maintain, and enforce Okta’s global Health & Safety standard operating procedures (SOPs), workplace safety manuals, and corporate safety policies across all regional hubs.
  • Monitor multi-jurisdictional compliance across all regions (e.g., Irish Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act, EU Workplace Directives, UK HSE regulations, US OSHA standards, and APAC regional health codes), leveraging specialized regional legal and consulting partners where necessary.
  • Oversee site-level risk assessments (General Risk Assessments, Fire Risk Assessments, Display Screen Equipment/DSE assessments) and track all corrective actions to closure.
  • Act as Okta’s primary liaison for statutory safety authorities, labor inspectorates, municipal fire services, and external compliance auditors worldwide.

4. Global Ergonomics & Preventive Wellness

  • Direct Okta’s Global Ergonomics Program across both physical corporate offices and our distributed, remote-first workforce.
  • Partner with external ergonomic evaluation platforms, specialized ergonomic physical therapists/evaluators, and internal workplace experience teams to review complex cases and reasonable accommodation requests.
  • Oversee the ergonomic evaluation workflow, self-assessment software adoption, and equipment reimbursement guidelines in alignment with corporate policy and regional procurement structures.

5. Emergency Preparedness, GSOC Coordination & Safety Culture

  • Lead incident investigation workflows for global safety incidents, significant near-misses, and occupational health concerns; determine root causes and institute corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Partner with Okta's Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Physical Security, and Workplace Experience teams to ensure rapid incident escalation and crisis coordination.
  • Standardize life safety programs globally, including local Emergency Wardens, First Aiders, evacuation drills, automated external defibrillator (AED) maintenance, and emergency supply readiness.
  • Define, track, and report on global safety metrics (such as Lost Time Injury Frequency Rates [LTIFR], Total Recordable Incident Rates [TRIR], ergonomics SLA closures, and vendor performance).

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive professional experience leading environmental health, safety, and occupational wellness programs within multinational enterprise or fast-paced technology environments.
  • Global Scope: Demonstrated experience managing health and safety programs across multi-site global portfolios spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC.
  • Vendor & Partner Management: Proven track record of managing global EHS third-party vendors, specialized consulting firms, and outsourced safety service providers to scale global coverage.
  • Workers' Compensation & Claims: Strong, direct experience managing global or multi-regional workers' compensation programs, employer liability claims, TPAs, and structured Return-to-Work (RTW) processes.
  • Regulatory Acumen: Solid understanding of Irish Health and Safety Authority (HSA) statutory requirements and EU Health & Safety Directives, paired with the capability to oversee international compliance frameworks (e.g., US OSHA).
  • Certifications & Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Risk Management, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Recognized professional health and safety certification (e.g., NEBOSH Diploma/Certificate, GradIOSH / CMIOSH, CSP, or recognized equivalent).
  • Collaboration & Influence: Proven ability to partner effectively across People/HR, Workplace/Real Estate, Physical Security/GSOC, Legal, and executive leadership.

Preferred:

  • Experience designing and scaling remote/hybrid ergonomic programs and digital ergonomics assessment platforms.
  • Experience integrating health and safety workflows with 24/7 Global Security Operations Centers (GSOC) and enterprise crisis management platforms.
  • Experience managing casualty insurance broker reviews and global risk management underwriting surveys.

Location & Working Arrangement

  • Primary Office: Dublin, Ireland.
  • Work Model: Hybrid (combining scheduled on-site collaboration at our Dublin office with remote flexibility, while accommodating global time zone collaboration across EMEA, AMER, and APAC).
  • Travel: Occasional international and regional travel (approx. 10–15%) to regional hubs, major global offices, and partner sites as operational needs dictate.
