Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

About Okta’s Enterprise Access Team

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

The Enterprise Access team drives billions of authentications every month. The team builds and supports single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, and threat protection technologies. Our Enterprise Access service runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform with 99.99% availability.

About the role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer for the Federated Authentication team. Operating under the larger Enterprise Access pillar, the Federated Authentication team is responsible for building out the login, user onboarding and recovery end user experience for the Okta Identity Engine leveraging security standards, this platform provides the core orchestration building blocks to create a world class login experience.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive the technical execution and architecture and help define the long-term strategy for the federated authentication platform, ensuring it meets enterprise-grade standards for security, scalability, and performance.
  • Lead the design and implementation of core platform features and foundational framework components, making decisions that enable extensibility for other engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Design, and other Principal Engineers to shape the product roadmap and translate complex business requirements into a sustainable technical strategy.
  • Spearhead the resolution of the most complex technical challenges, including performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and architectural limitations.
  • Champion technical excellence and innovation, identifying and advocating for new technologies and approaches that advance Okta's identity platform.
  • Write clean, modular, well-tested, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 8+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years focused on designing and building complex, enterprise-grade web applications.
  • Demonstrated experience as a technical leader, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, high-impact software projects.
  • Proficient in at least one Object-Oriented language (i.e. Java, C#).
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity and make high-judgment technical decisions.
  • Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple teams.

Technical Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Object-Oriented Languages (i.e. Java , C#)
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and backend architecture such as caching layers, event-driven architectures, and distributed data stores.
  • Knowledge of IAM protocols (e.g., OAuth, OIDC, SAML) and identity management concepts is a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and secure coding practice is a strong plus

Education and Training:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years of experience designing and building enterprise grade software

descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Role

As the Director of Partner Product Marketing and Alliances, you will lead the global strategy and execution for all product marketing functions related to partners and drive joint demand with our key Alliances partners. Reporting to the VP of Americas Field and Global Partner Marketing, you will lead a high-impact team working closely with partner leaders across the organization, including Technical Alliances, Partner Sales, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Regional Marketing leadership in AMER, EMEA, and APJ.

You will own product marketing strategy across our partner ecosystem—optimizing Okta's strategic relationships with Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), and Solution Providers (VARs/resellers). Your mission is to accelerate partner-influenced pipeline and revenue by developing compelling "better together" messaging, go-to-market content, sales enablement materials, and joint co-marketing plans. The qualified candidate will have a deep understanding of Agentic AI with a shared vision of how Okta’s platform can integrate with third parties to help enterprise customers safely leverage the power of AI.

Key Responsibilities

Global Tech Alliance Strategy

  • Strategic Roadmap: Own and drive the overarching global partner marketing strategy for Okta Tech Alliance partners.
  • Thought Leadership: Position Okta as an industry thought leader delivering on the promise of a secure agentic enterprise.
  • Pipeline Development: Grow the global partner demand generation function to increase partner-influenced opportunity creation through strategic Tech Alliance partnerships.
  • GTM & Sales Enablement Content: Create high-impact go-to-market content and sales enablement assets to optimize Okta's relationships across ISVs, CSPs, GSIs, and Solution Providers (VARs/resellers).
  • Joint Value Propositions: Establish overall "better together" partner messaging, value propositions, and integration narratives across product lines and partner types.
  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Lead joint GTM activities with ISVs leveraging multi-vendor cybersecurity solutions that meet complex customer identity security needs, including AI agents, human and non-human identities (NHIs).

Team Leadership & Financial Stewardship

  • People Management: Mentor and grow a team of top product marketing and partner marketing talent, fostering a high-performing and motivated environment.
  • Budget & ROI: Oversee the strategic allocation and management of a global budget, ensuring effective utilization and reporting on key metrics and program ROI.
  • Operational Excellence: Partner with marketing operations to establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of global programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Internal Alignment: Partner closely with Technical Alliances, Partner Sales, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Regional Marketing leaders across AMER, EMEA, and APJ to align GTM strategies and demand generation.
  • Partner Relations: Create and maintain strong relationships with marketing leaders at our most critical global ISV partners.
  • Strategic Events: Collaborate with Field Marketing and Strategic Events to deliver powerful “better together” messaging at summits, conferences, events and webinars.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in product marketing within the SaaS industry, with a focus on technology partnerships, global strategy and execution.
  • Ecosystem Expertise: Broad domain expertise across SaaS cybersecurity GTM motions involving ISVs, CSPs, GSIs, and Solution Providers/VARs.
  • Story-telling: Strong writing and editing skills with experience articulating complex use cases that can be understood across multiple formats (presentations, white papers, video, demos, web copy, etc).
  • Leadership: Proven track record of building, motivating, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and marketing funnel insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Okta’s Core Leadership Competencies 

  • Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.
  • Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Builds Effective Teams: Building strong teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.
  • Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness (EQ): Using feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

In addition, this leader will work with the broader business planning team including P&P, Business Value and Compete along with IT to support successful rollout of new offers and programs to market.

As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success. A successful leader in this role will have a combination of skills across deal strategy & management, customer negotiations, business value positioning, deal analytics, program management, communication, influencing and collaboration.

Core responsibilities will include:

  • Drive deals management strategies that will help Okta scale to $4B+ in revenue
  • Work closely with leaders in the GTM teams to craft deal proposals, evaluate and apply new buying programs, business models and monetization strategies 
  • Gather GTM team feedback on deal quality and velocity improvement proposals
  • Provide well-reasoned deal structuring guidelines and optimization recommendations GTM leaders across the organization and the executive team.
  • Govern commercial terms and non-standard approvals
  • Define and evaluate Key Performance Indicators to track impact of deal strategies and guidelines
  • Support customer facing discussions where appropriate, to help sales win business.
  • SME support for deal enablement and training content for the sales team to help best position deal commercial terms and conditions with customers.
  • Provide targeted in-deal support to the sales team to assist in strategic precedent setting opportunities.
  • Provide leadership to further scale and optimize the team, setting priorities to maximize impact

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Business or an equivalent; MBA preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience (preferably 4) in a deal strategy leadership role. May consider candidates with deal experience and a combination of the following areas: strategy consulting, strategic finance or corporate strategy, ideally at a SaaS or enterprise software company to equal 4 years.
  • 2 years of direct people management/team management experience.
  • Ability to quickly grasp new product and business model concepts, consistently apply critical and structured thinking to new areas.
  • Action-oriented to solve problems and get a lot done in short timeframes.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience driving complex, cross-functional execution.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills across all levels of an organization. 
Okta’s Top 5 Core Leadership Competencies are part of the deeply ingrained principles that guide all of our company’s actions. They also align strongly to our cultural cornerstones, our Okta values: love our customers, empower our people, never stop innovating, act with integrity, and maintain transparency. It’s our expectation that our managers and leaders embody these core competencies:

We believe the best work happens when we combine flexibility with in-person collaboration. This role follows a hybrid model (2 days in-office or on client site, 3 days remote) based out of our local hub. You’ll have dedicated days to connect, brainstorm, and build with the team on-site, alongside the flexibility to work from home.

Focused on enabling productivity and aligning technology with business goals, TDI plays a vital role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic growth.

The Senior Software Engineer Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team in TDI and help scale our internal business solutions with a sharp focus on security, reliability, scalability, and intelligent automation.

You will be responsible for designing and developing customizations, configurations, integrations, and AI-powered solutions required to meet the company’s strategic business objectives. Reporting to the Manager of Marketing, TDI, this role provides end-to-end technical services including design, configuration, development, testing, and automation while delivering high-quality, secure, and future-ready solutions.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and implement secure, scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and platform configuration tools.

  • Develop and deploy serverless solutions using Amazon Web Services Lambda and cloud-native services to extend Salesforce capabilities.

  • Develop Salesforce features across multiple clouds (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud Console, Experience Cloud).
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle from discovery to deployment with proper documentation.
  • Create and execute unit, integration, functional, and automation test cases to ensure solution quality.
  • Support production deployments and perform root-cause analysis of issues.
  • Mentor other engineers to help them grow and improve their skills.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience using Apex, Process Automation tools, and Lightning Web Components.
  • 5+ years of software development experience using Java, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with Salesforce products such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Communities with an in-depth understanding of best practices, coding, and declarative frameworks.
  • Strong Python development experience for automation, integrations, and AI/ML workflows.
  • Experience designing cloud-native solutions using Amazon Web Services services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, or serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Amazon Bedrock.
  • Familiarity with source control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to manage and deliver full lifecycle Salesforce projects independently.
  • Deep understanding of developing secure solutions that protect sensitive data.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

And Extra Credit if You Have Experience in Any of the Following!

  • Salesforce certifications
  • Experience with Einstein Bots, predictive analytics, Agentforce, or other AI-powered Salesforce tools.
  • Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD practices for Salesforce.
  • Experience building multi-agent orchestration or workflow automation platforms.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI governance practices.
  • Experience improving marketing workflows and automation in marketing environments.
  • Background in high-growth, fast-paced technology companies.

Position Description:

You will proactively construct and own an AI-forward research roadmap for key product pillars at Okta, operating at the intersection of Identity, Security, and Artificial Intelligence. As a Staff-level individual contributor, you will drive both qualitative and quantitative methodologies to define user experiences for non-deterministic AI agents, automated workflows, and enterprise platforms. Additionally, you leverage agentic tools and AI workflows internally to scale qualitative coding, synthesis, and research operations across the organization.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Drive Product-shaping Research: Lead foundational and evaluative research to inform strategic and tactical product decisions.
  • Execute Balanced Mixed-Methods: Drive qualitative depth (contextual inquiry, cognitive walkthroughs) and quantitative rigor (large-scale surveys, behavioral telemetry, statistical modeling) to evaluate AI products.

  • Lead Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Facilitate research to drive cross-discipline clarity, executive alignment, and decision-making across complex security and admin workflows.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Bring stakeholders together across multiple teams to scope problems and collaborate on research in ways that nurture a culture of curiosity and learning.

  • AI Tool Practitioner: Active daily practitioner of AI tools and prompt workflows to streamline research processes and execution, including but not limited to synthesis, structuring unstructured data, and scaling insight delivery.
  • Domain Experience: Experience with products made for developers, administrators, or other technical audiences; experience working on security products is a strong plus.

  • Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Data Science, Social Sciences, or equivalent industry experience.

Nice-to-Have  (Not required, but a plus):

  • Advanced Quantitative Toolkit: SQL, R or Python, Cluster Analysis, Advanced Statistical Modeling, A/B Testing.

descriptionHtml:

The Opportunity: Okta Access Gateway (OAG)

Enterprises run on a mix of modern cloud services and mission-critical on-premises systems (such as Oracle E-Business Suite, SAP, PeopleSoft, and custom legacy web apps). Okta Access Gateway (OAG) solves the enterprise hybrid cloud challenge by extending Okta’s cloud identity, Adaptive MFA, and Zero Trust security policies to on-premises and legacy applications without requiring custom code changes or traditional VPNs.

As the Engineering Manager for Okta Access Gateway in Toronto, you will lead and grow a team of software engineers building the next generation of our hybrid access and gateway infrastructure. You will partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, Security, and Quality teams to deliver high-throughput, mission-critical security software deployed across multi-cloud and enterprise datacenters globally.

What You’ll Do

People Leadership & Team Growth

  • Lead, mentor, and empower an engineering team, fostering an inclusive, high-performance, and psychologically safe engineering culture.
  • Drive career progression, goal setting, regular 1:1s, and continuous feedback to help engineers grow their technical and leadership skills.
  • Attract, interview, and hire diverse engineering talent to scale Okta’s engineering presence in Toronto.

Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end execution and delivery of key product roadmap initiatives, balancing feature velocity, technical debt, and software quality.
  • Establish predictable agile delivery cadences (Scrum/Kanban), driving accurate scope estimation, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion operational rigor, security standards, high availability, and performance benchmarking for customer-deployed gateway appliances.

Technical Strategy & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Technical Architects, and UX designers to define technical roadmaps and product requirements.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, system design proposals, and threat modeling without micromanaging day-to-day code implementation.
  • Guide the team in modernizing gateway capabilities, containerization, deployment automation, and seamless integration with the core Okta Identity Cloud.

What You’ll Bring

  • Engineering Leadership: 2+ years of experience formally managing software engineering teams (or 4+ years as a hands-on Lead / Staff Engineer leading complex, multi-engineer projects to delivery).
  • Technical Background: 8+ years of total software engineering experience designing and operating enterprise-scale distributed systems or infrastructure products.
  • Enterprise Stack Experience: Strong background in server-side technologies (e.g., Java / Spring Boot, Go, or C/C++) and distributed systems concepts (concurrency, caching, high throughput, and asynchronous processing).
  • Security & Networking Acumen: Solid understanding of network architecture, TLS/SSL, reverse proxies/gateways, HTTP headers, DNS, and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Product Analyst to join the TDI team and help scale our internal systems with a focus on security and reliability. You will leverage your deep knowledge of CPQ and Sales Cloud, covering everything from provisioning to case management, to partner with GTM teams and uncover data-driven efficiencies. descriptionHtml:

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Overview 

At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you’ll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we’re researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta’s portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

The Finer Print 

You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research & Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

In this role, you have the opportunity to:

  • Lead a holistic, human-centered approach to design.
  • Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long-term strategy for your product area.
  • Design and facilitate co-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
  • Craft user-centered artifacts and end-to-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
  • Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
  • Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
  • Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
  • Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team-level and design practice and process improvements.
  • Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
  • Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
  • Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
  • Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
  • Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You have experience leading cross-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
  • You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
  • You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day-to-day design workflow.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
  • You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
  • You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
  • You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
  • You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation.
  • You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
  • Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
  • You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
  • Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
  • Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
  • Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
  • Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)

The Global Pricing Operations Team

The Pricing Operations team works in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and dynamic environment with many moving pieces and evolving business needs. The team partners with Pricing Strategy Managers, Product Managers, Technology, Data & Intelligence,  and various GTM teams to ensure Okta is operationally ready to bring new product pricing, buying programs, and strategic monetization initiatives to market. 

The Pricing Operations Principal Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Pricing Operations Principal to lead initiatives that transform Okta's pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution. A successful person in this role will be a strong collaborator, intensely curious, and supremely organized. They are known for connecting the dots, simplifying complexities, communicating clearly and proactively, and driving highly collaborative efforts to completion, even when the path forward isn't perfectly defined. 

In this role, you will serve as an operational leader for new pricing launches and a strategic buying-program implementation, establishing the integrated roadmap, operating cadence, decision-making framework, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications required to bring these initiatives from concept through launch and sustained adoption. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional leaders to make complex tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to sell, quote, contract, provision, bill, recognize revenue, support, and renew under the new model.

As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to transform pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution
  • Lead the operational implementation of buying programs that will affect how Okta packages, sells, measures, and supports its offerings, driving cross-functional alignment from design through launch and adoption.
  • Collaborate closely with several functions across the company, including Pricing Strategy, Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Finance, GTM, and Technology, Data & Intelligence, to evaluate the operational impact of pricing initiatives, develop operational readiness plans, and execute launches
  • Navigate ambiguity and fast-moving strategy decisions with confidence, helping the team align quickly and move forward effectively
  • Continuously assess and re-prioritize workstreams as business needs evolve, maintaining clarity and momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Drive strategic projects that use AI and other technology tools to optimize and automate pricing processes, strengthen operational standards, and improve cross-functional engagement frameworks.
  • Develop business requirements for Technology, Data & Intelligence to build new SKUs in Okta's business systems to support quoting, invoicing, revenue recognition, reporting, and improved transaction processes for Okta's sales teams
  • Proactively synthesize and communicate status updates, risks, and blockers to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders for pricing launches — not just when asked, but as a consistent habit
  • Partner with GTM teams to assess enablement needs and develop, deliver, and optimize pricing enablement, training, and field communications for new launches, strategic initiatives, and ongoing pricing changes.
  • Serve as SME on pricing, product configuration, and go-to-market processes
  • Actively contribute to team culture by seeking and incorporating feedback, sharing learnings, and helping raise the bar for how the Pricing Operations function operates

What you'll bring to the role

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in pricing operations, business operations, strategic program management, revenue operations, quote-to-cash, commercial operations, Deal Desk, or a related field. This may include experience gained in-house or through management, operations, or implementation consulting.
  • At least 5 years leading complex, cross-functional programs or major operational changes, such as implementing a commercial program, buying model, pricing initiative, or related strategic transformation. Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.
  • Experience working with Pricing, Product, Product Marketing, GTM, Finance, Legal, and Technology teams to translate strategy into operational plans, system requirements, enablement, and launch execution.
  • Experience implementing a commercial program, buying program, pricing initiative, or other operational change that affects multiple stages of the customer lifecycle, including quoting, contracting, billing, provisioning, reporting, renewals, or customer support.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, including system builds involving quotable SKUs, product configuration, custom fields, validation rules, alert rules, and other quote-to-cash capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration, along with experience using AI tools to improve processes and automate workflows.
  • Experience working with or alongside Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, GTM Strategy & Operations, Sales Operations, or similar teams, with a strong understanding of how pricing and operational decisions affect selling, quoting, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, and customer support.
  • A track record of bringing structure to complex and ambiguous work, influencing without authority, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities, surfacing risks early, and driving decisions through launch and adoption.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, along with a proactive, organized, collaborative, and results-oriented approach.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience working in a high-growth or evolving environment where you have built trusted cross-functional relationships, brought structure to ambiguous and complex initiatives, continuously improved processes and ways of working, and used AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

This role is ideal for a senior operator who can turn complex pricing and buying program initiatives into clear plans, align diverse teams, and drive execution from concept through launch and adoption. You will help build durable capabilities that support future pricing and go-to-market transformations at Okta.

descriptionHtml:

Okta's Strategic Sourcing and Procurement (SS&P) team is looking for an experienced Category Manager (Technology Sourcing) to to join our energetic Strategic Sourcing team to support and be part of Okta's continued growth.  You will lead sourcing activities for our Technology spend globally. This includes leading complex, high-value sourcing projects and contract negotiations for IT service and product categories such as Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, and other direct or indirect technology requirements on a local or global scale.

In this role, you will be a trusted, senior partner to our Technology stakeholders — owning the sourcing strategy for some of SS&P's most complex and highest-impact categories, leading high-stakes negotiations, and driving cost-saving initiatives while maintaining service quality and mitigating risk. You will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior Category Managers and serve as an escalation point for Tactical Sourcing on technology-related matters.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and collaborative individual who works well in a fast-paced environment and can operate with a high degree of autonomy. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology. 

This is a hybrid role (2 days a week in office) and must be based in either Bellevue, WA, or the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Category Strategy & Planning:  Develop and lead sourcing strategies for Technology categories (Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, AI, and related technology requirements), working closely with senior stakeholders to understand long-term needs and deliver measurable value. Gather business and technical requirements to produce documentation supporting RFx events, and develop internal presentations and business cases to secure management approval for multi-year supplier agreements.
  • Sourcing & Project Management: Lead and support all aspects of the strategic sourcing process end-to-end — RFx events, supplier evaluations, and day-to-day commercial contract negotiations — for the most complex, high-value technology sourcing initiatives. 
  • Contract Negotiation: Lead commercial term negotiations for project-level agreements and partner with Legal on Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and related exhibits, applying strong negotiation and legal acumen to secure favorable terms on high-stakes, high-dollar technology contracts. 
  • Cost Optimization & Risk Management: Use industry expertise to identify and lead cost optimization initiatives across the largest or most strategic Technology categories, where outcomes carry cross-functional or company-wide impact. Provide economic analysis of supplier proposals for high-dollar or high-risk expenditures, and identify and mitigate the associated internal and external risks. descriptionHtml:

Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack

Position Description:

We are seeking an experienced Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications — from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems . As a Staff Engineer, you will set technical direction across multiple integrations and the shared frameworks they depend on, resolve the hardest cross-app reliability and architecture problems — rate limiting at scale, backward compatibility — and raise the engineering bar for the team. This is a backend-intensive role centered on distributed systems, API client architecture, and operational excellence at scale. Day-to-day frontend involvement is still light relative to backend work, but you'll need decent React and JSP experience to guide and occasionally hand-build the new feature requests.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

- Technical Leadership: Independently drive the design and execution of complex, ambiguous initiatives spanning multiple app integrations or shared frameworks used across dozens of connectors.
- Architecture & Design: Lead technical design discussions for new integration patterns and shared abstractions; identify opportunities to consolidate duplicated per-app logic (REST/SOAP clients, exception handling, OAuth utilities) into reusable frameworks, reducing long-term maintenance burden across the integration portfolio.
- Scale & Reliability: Solve systemic reliability problems — rate-limit handling, pagination/throttling abstractions, multi-tenant and compliance-variant support — that affect many integrations simultaneously, not just a single app.
- Operational Excellence: Act as a guardian-level responder for integration-pipeline incidents; drive root-cause analysis and remediation for systemic issues; lead operational improvement projects (observability, alerting, on-call runbooks) across the team's full integration portfolio.
- Technical Risk Management: Identify and mitigate technical risk in the team's roadmap — vendor API deprecations, backward-compatibility obligations across dozens of live integrations, and legacy protocol support .
- Cross-Functional Ownership: Partner with PMs, support, security, and other engineering teams to prioritize, influence product direction for the integration catalog, and own outcomes beyond code — including research and recommendations on build-vs-buy or deprecation decisions.
- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Set the bar for code review, testing rigor (unit, API/mock-server, and nightly functional tests against third-party endpoints), and documentation across the team.
- Mentorship & Team Growth: Mentor engineers at all levels, unblock teammates on complex integration and distributed-systems problems, and contribute meaningfully to hiring and interview loops.
- Engineering Culture: Champion engineering best practices internally

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

- Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating reliable, production-grade backend systems at scale.
- Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; demonstrated ability to design systems or shared libraries consumed by multiple teams.
- Distributed Systems at Scale: Deep experience with asynchronous job processing, event-driven architectures, and designing resilient systems (retry/backoff, rate limiting, circuit breakers) that tolerate dozens of heterogeneous, unreliable third-party dependencies.
- Data Management: Strong command of relational databases (MySQL) and caching strategies (Redis or similar) at scale.
- API & Framework Design: Experience designing shared libraries/frameworks consumed by multiple teams (e.g., provisioning adapters, client-session abstractions) — not just single-service APIs.
- Operational Leadership: Track record of driving incident response, RCAs, and systemic reliability improvements for production systems with many integration points.
- Problem Solving & Ownership: Comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-cutting technical problems and driving them to resolution with minimal supervision.
- Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP well enough to review/guide frontend changes and step in to build features

Nice to Haves:

- Deep experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP) across many simultaneous integrations.
- Integration & Auth Protocols: Strong working knowledge of REST/SOAP integration patterns and authentication/federation standards (OAuth2, SAML, WS-Federation), including supporting legacy protocols alongside modern ones.
- Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS architectures and/or specialized compliance environments (FedRAMP/GCC-High).
- Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for large-scale asynchronous processing.
- A track record of leading architectural consolidation efforts (reducing duplicated per-integration code into shared frameworks).

Education:
B.E./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Engineering Manager, Governance Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Identity Governance Team

Okta Identity Governance (OIG) is Okta's Identity Governance and Administration solution, responsible for some of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how people request access, how approvers grant it, how entitlements are enforced, and how organizations prove to auditors that only the right people have the right access.

OIG is the leading contributor to Okta's new product bookings, and it runs inside some of the largest enterprises in the world — the kind of accounts where a single tenant carries hundreds of thousands of identities across thousands of applications.

OIG currently supports some AI/ML based features and plans major expansion into the Agentic use cases.

The Engineering Manager (Governance Intelligence) Opportunity

As a manager on the OIG (Governance Intelligence) team, your mission is to adapt the OIG product to the needs of the government customers. 

In this role, you will actively design, build, and maintain both robust backend services and intuitive frontend interfaces. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every aspect of the product.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead and grow a team of ML experts and other engineers to deliver key Intelligence features for the OIG product - powered by machine learning, large language models, and agentic AI systems. 
  • Establish rigor around AI evaluation: designing “evals” frameworks, measuring factuality, relevance, and task completion, and setting quality gates before production rollout
  • Own the end-to-end AI product lifecycle: from problem framing and data curation through model training, A/B testing, deployment, and continuous improvement based on production signals. 
  • Manage the process to Architect, deploy, and maintain cloud and on-premises infrastructure across high-compliance security baselines.
  • Support operations transitioning into federal environments. Collaborate with other engineering teams to ensure software deployments meet stringent governmental security standards.
  • Proactively identify and prioritize tech debt; drive improvements in areas beyond feature work - CI/CD, observability, documentation, reliability, and support processes.
  • Partner with Product and Design to understand and own the desired customer outcome, not just the technical deliverable.
  • Actively invest in the growth of reporting engineers, taking responsibility for raising the technical bar of the team as a whole.

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ in a management role, shipping enterprise cloud software.
  • Hands-on depth in coding at scale using: Java, Python, or TypeScript, plus API (REST, gRPC) and UI automation (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent)
  • Experience with CI/CD (CircleCI or equivalent), containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and a major cloud platform
  • Operates well beyond basic AI tool usage - understands how to apply AI meaningfully across the full software development lifecycle, can evaluate and adopt new AI tooling with good judgment, and is able to establish practices and bring a team along.
  • Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies - including the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with lasting org-wide impact.
  • Solid understanding of web authentication and authorization fundamentals - how auth flows work, and best practices for securing sensitive user data.             
  • Architectural expertise: Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies, including making decisions with lasting, org-wide impact.
  • Backend proficiency: Deep expertise in building reliable, secure, enterprise-grade software in Java or another type-safe language.
  • Frontend flexibility: High proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with true fullstack range, including the ability to ship robust frontends.                                                                                                                    

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • AI Infrastructure Expertise: Hands-on experience building, scaling, and troubleshooting AWS/GCP based AI infra.
  • Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) — access requests, certifications, entitlement management, separation of duties, or role modeling (Okta, SailPoint, Saviynt, One Identity, Oracle, or in-house)
  • Identity and Access Management more broadly: SSO, SCIM provisioning, directory integration, or privileged access

descriptionHtml:

Device Identity and Access Organization

The Device Identity and Access organization is at the forefront of Okta’s Zero Trust vision. As a foundational pillar within Okta Research and Development (ORD), our mission is to transform the device itself into a secure, trusted, and effortless identity factor. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world.

Our organization is composed of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user.

Opportunity

We seek a highly impactful and influential Software Engineer to join our macOS engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in macOS (or iOS) client software development to architect, build, and scale the critical macOS software and services at the heart of our security and identity platform. This is a high-visibility, hands-on opportunity to define the architectural vision, pioneer new capabilities, and drive the technical strategy to solve complex, company-wide challenges and shape the future of Okta's device identity ecosystem. You will act as a key technical leader—a player-coach and force multiplier—by setting the technical standard, mentoring and coaching engineers, and partnering with engineering leadership and product management to translate strategic business objectives into actionable, scalable technical roadmaps. This role requires an engineer who believes in designing for high performance, secure by design, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and an iterative process to build high-quality enterprise software.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering Directors, and Principal Architects to translate strategic business objectives into technical roadmaps.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and QA to ensure the seamless delivery of our most critical engineering initiatives.
  • Lead the design and implementation of new features and services taking ownership from conception to deployment.
  • Act as a force multiplier across multiple teams, mentoring Staff and Senior engineers, guiding technical design reviews, and raising the engineering bar across the entire pillar.
  • Raise the technical bar through rigorous code standards, comprehensive automated testing, and modernized CI/CD pipelines, while championing engineering best practices and architectural standards.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation and foster a culture of knowledge sharing within the team and the broader organization.
  • Work within an environment that leverages AI-native engineering practices, utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery.
  • Spearhead technical innovation, identifying emerging industry trends (such as advanced device security or AI-native development paradigms) and prototyping solutions to keep Okta ahead of the curve.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and building macOS (or iOS) features using Swift.
  • Deep expertise with macOS (or iOS) software environments, including design and performance optimization, security considerations.
  • Proven expertise in advanced debugging and performance optimization using Xcode, LLDB, and Instruments to resolve complex memory issues and concurrency bugs.
  • Experience in fast-paced agile environments, with a strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence technical direction.
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle.
  • Cross-Platform context with strong conceptual understanding of macOS (or iOS) security features.

Nice-to-haves

  • Security Domain Expertise such as Cryptography, endpoint security concepts (e.g., Secure Enclave, Device Management/MDM protocols, and endpoint detection).
  • Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (e.g., FIDO, OIDC/OAuth, or similar modern authentication frameworks).
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

As a Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing, you will establish operational objectives, policies, and work plans for the Technology category function, and will delegate and oversee execution across your team. You will drive the strategy and success of the most complex, highest-value Technology sourcing initiatives — often working through ambiguous, undefined problems that lack established precedent — while ensuring alignment with company-wide objectives. You will be accountable for your team's budget and its impact on the broader business segment, and will be expected to advise SS&P and cross-functional leadership on moderately-to-highly complex Technology sourcing matters.

You will need to work closely with senior stakeholders internally and across the Technology organization to build long-term category strategy and execute tactical short-term actions aligned with strategic objectives, while strengthening existing supplier partnerships and building new ones in line with that strategy.

You will be responsible for creating and enforcing policies to drive the Technology category strategy, developing your team's capabilities, and optimizing sourcing resources to deliver improved operational efficiency and value to the business. This role will report to the Director of Sourcing & Procurement.

This hybrid office role, 2 days a week in office, requires being based in either Bellevue, WA, or the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement Sourcing Strategy: Lead the execution of strategic sourcing strategies for Technology categories (Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, AI) to optimize procurement in line with company objectives, including cost reduction, risk mitigation, and driving efficiency.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop 3–5 year rolling category strategies for Technology spend by working closely with Technology stakeholders to understand long-term needs and translate those insights into operational sourcing strategy.
  • Process & Governance: Develop, implement, and oversee KPIs for Technology sourcing activities; help strengthen and operationalize SS&P processes and policies, establishing a governance model to drive performance, mitigate risk, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Cost Optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives through strategic sourcing decisions, process improvements, and high-stakes supplier negotiations. Develop and track KPIs to measure savings and supplier performance.
  • Contract Negotiation & Risk Management: Lead the most complex contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms, pricing, and SLAs. Identify and mitigate internal and external risks associated with Technology purchase transactions, including risks arising from tech contract law and commercial terms.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy, and the Technology organization to align sourcing strategies with organizational needs, ensuring policies and procedures are followed and met.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Category Managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability. Assign and monitor individual and team goals, driving accountability for performance.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key Technology suppliers, ensuring they meet performance expectations and contractual agreements. Act as the primary point of contact for critical supplier issues.
  • Market Analysis & Supplier Selection: Conduct market research and competitive analysis on Technology categories to identify potential suppliers, assess market trends, and lead supplier selection processes.
  • M&A Support: Drive M&A activity from a Strategic Sourcing perspective, including contract novation and consolidation of Technology agreements.
  • Stakeholder Reporting & Communication: Regularly update senior leadership on Technology sourcing strategy progress, savings, supplier performance, and market trends, presenting insights in an executive format.
  • Compliance & Ethical Sourcing: Ensure all Technology sourcing activities adhere to ethical standards, legal requirements, and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, with a proven track record in a leadership role, and deep experience in Technology sourcing (Infrastructure, SaaS, Telecom, IaaS, AI, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of strategic sourcing methodologies, contract negotiations, supplier management, and cost optimization techniques, including deep understanding of tech contract law and commercial terms.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and executive leadership.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions on ambiguous, undefined problems.
  • Experience with procurement software and tools, as well as advanced Excel skills (Coupa, Workday Strategic Sourcing/Scout, SAP, Oracle, Ariba, etc.).

  • Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPSM, or CPIM.
  • Experience in the SaaS industry leading a sourcing function.
  • Prior managerial/leadership experience with direct reports.

The Opportunity

The Global Demand Center is building a signal-led demand engine — one that uses account, audience, behavioral, intent, and market signals to identify where we should focus and how we should activate. The GrowthX team, within the Global Demand Center, is taking the lead on this initiative and looking for a new Demand Signals Specialist. 

The Demand Signals Specialist will help turn signal-led strategy into accurate, actionable audiences that can be used across campaigns, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation channels.

This role is focused on audience build, enrichment, segmentation, QA, and activation readiness. They will work across teams to understand unique intent and fit signals to create impactful audiences for GrowthX programs. The ideal candidate is early in their career but technically curious, detail-oriented, comfortable working across modern GTM platforms, and excited to help build the audience foundation for a more dynamic demand model.

What You’ll Do

Build account and contact audiences

Build account, contact, and buying-group audiences based on direction from GrowthX strategy leads, campaign teams, field marketing, and journey teams.

Use tools such as Clay and Common Room to support audience creation, enrichment, segmentation, contact discovery, buying-group identification, and account research.

Apply required filters, exclusions, segmentation logic, region/segment views, product focus, persona criteria, suppression rules, and activation requirements.

Support both planned campaign audiences and signal-triggered growth motions.

Prepare audiences for activation

Package audience outputs for use by campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, digital activation, and xDR teams.

Communicate audience size, coverage, regional breakdowns, segment views, exclusions, data gaps, intent, and activation readiness.

Help ensure audiences are structured in a way that can be used downstream in systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, and other campaign or activation platforms.

Own audience QA and data quality checks

Review audience builds for accuracy, duplication, completeness, field quality, enrichment quality, persona/title fit, suppression logic, region/segment accuracy, and alignment to stated criteria.

Flag issues, gaps, or unexpected findings to GrowthX strategy leads and stakeholders.

Recommend adjustments when audience size, coverage, quality, or data availability may limit activation.

Document audience logic and QA findings so teams understand what was included, excluded, and why.

Partner cross-functionally

Work closely with GrowthX leaders, campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation teams to support audience needs.

Clarify build requirements, timelines, audience logic, data sources, and handoff expectations.

Support a more consistent audience operating model across Okta or Auth0 platform priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

1–3+ years of experience in marketing operations, growth operations, campaign operations, audience operations, demand generation, sales operations, data operations, or a related field.

Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, lists, filters, segmentation logic, and QA processes.

Experience or strong familiarity with B2B marketing and sales systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Clay, Common Room, or comparable GTM platforms.

Comfort working with account and contact data, including enrichment, deduplication, segmentation, exclusions, and audience handoffs.

Ability to communicate audience size, coverage, data gaps, and QA findings clearly to stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple audience requests, timelines, and handoffs.

Curiosity about AI, signal-led demand generation, data enrichment, and modern GTM technology.

Ability to work cross-functionally with campaign, field, journey, marketing automation, and growth teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or supporting B2B account/contact audiences.

Experience with Clay, Common Room, Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, or similar platforms.

Basic understanding of B2B buyer personas, buying groups, account segmentation, lifecycle stages, and campaign activation needs.

Experience using formulas, logic, filters, or workflow tools to organize and manipulate data.

Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, developer platforms, or enterprise technology.

title: Staff Software Engineer, OIN
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the OIN Team

The Okta Integration Network (OIN) is the platform that lets Okta customers discover, connect, and manage third-party applications and identity providers — from single sign-on and provisioning to newer, higher-order integration patterns as the ecosystem of connected software (including AI agents) continues to grow. It's core infrastructure: the workflows OIN powers run continuously for a very large share of Okta's customer base.

Our team builds and operates all of OIN — from the foundational data model, APIs, and security posture every integration in the network is built on, to the tools partners and customers use to build, test, and ship integrations, to the systems that power what those integrations can actually do once connected. In practice that spans connector metadata and provisioning primitives, partner-facing tooling, and the infrastructure work that keeps a very large, long-lived system fast, secure, and easy to extend as the network grows.

We're actively expanding OIN's scope beyond its original SSO-and-provisioning core — including new integration patterns as AI agents and machine-to-machine access become part of the identity landscape, and a lower-friction path for partners to bring new integrations into the network. You'd be joining at a point where the platform's scope is visibly widening, working closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it.

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the OIN team, you'll be a technical leader for a platform a very large share of Okta's customers depend on every day. You'll independently own complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end — from technical scoping through design, delivery, and production operation — partnering closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it. You'll also be expected to raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, not just deliver your own code.

We're looking for self-motivated engineers who think from first principles, take pride in high-quality software, and are genuinely kind and collaborative to work with.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery and technical scoping for new requirements, turning ambiguous product asks into a concrete architecture, phased delivery plans, and credible estimates, in close partnership with product, architecture, and design.
  • Design and evolve the APIs, data models, and security posture that OIN's integrations depend on, with an eye toward backward compatibility and long-term extensibility.
  • Drive technical decisions across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies, aligning stakeholders across engineering, product, and other parts of the business when the "right answer" isn't obvious yet.
  • Modernize and evolve a large, long-lived production system incrementally without disrupting the customers and integrations that depend on it every day.
  • Maintain a high bar for security, testing, and code quality, including vulnerability remediation and threat-aware design, while keeping a real sense of urgency on customer-impacting work.
  • Own the production health of the systems you build by writing root-cause analyses when things break, driving follow-through on the fixes, and building the observability that prevents repeat incidents.
  • Champion AI-native engineering practices by using AI coding assistants and AI-augmented workflows as a core part of how you design, build, review, and ship software, and helping the team adopt them well.
  • Mentor and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, and represent the team's technical point of view in cross-functional forums.

What you'll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a demonstrated history of technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Deep proficiency in Java (our primary backend language) or a comparable strongly-typed backend language/framework, with the judgment to know when and how to modernize a large, long-lived codebase without disrupting the customers depending on it.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating complex, large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including caching, asynchronous processing, and data migrations at scale.
  • Real depth in identity and access protocols (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, and/or SCIM) and the security instincts that come from having built systems that other companies' software authenticates against.
  • Experience designing and evolving APIs and integration frameworks that external developers or partners build on, not just internal consumers. You think about backward compatibility, versioning, and developer experience as first-class concerns.
  • Comfortable driving technical direction across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies. You can align product, architecture, and other engineering teams around a plan when the "right answer" isn't obvious yet.
  • A security- and compliance-aware mindset — comfortable working on systems where correctness failures have real customer or compliance consequences, not just availability ones.
  • Applies AI tools thoughtfully across the development lifecycle, from code generation to review to testing, and can help a team adopt them well, not just use them personally.
  • Excellent written communication — you bring structure to ambiguous problems and drive them to closure using first principles, in writing that others can act on without you in the room.

Extra credit

  • Experience integrating with large, specialized third-party enterprise systems that carry their own strict compliance or data-handling requirements.
  • Experience running or contributing to a self-serve developer platform or partner/ISV ecosystem.
  • Front-end proficiency (React or similar) is a big positive.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

As a Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing, you will establish operational objectives, policies, and work plans for the Technology category function, and will delegate and oversee execution across your team. You will drive the strategy and success of the most complex, highest-value Technology sourcing initiatives — often working through ambiguous, undefined problems that lack established precedent — while ensuring alignment with company-wide objectives. You will be accountable for your team's budget and its impact on the broader business segment, and will be expected to advise SS&P and cross-functional leadership on moderately-to-highly complex Technology sourcing matters.

You will need to work closely with senior stakeholders internally and across the Technology organization to build long-term category strategy and execute tactical short-term actions aligned with strategic objectives, while strengthening existing supplier partnerships and building new ones in line with that strategy.

You will be responsible for creating and enforcing policies to drive the Technology category strategy, developing your team's capabilities, and optimizing sourcing resources to deliver improved operational efficiency and value to the business. This role will report to the Director of Sourcing & Procurement.

This hybrid office role, 2 days a week in office, requires being based in either Bellevue, WA, or the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement Sourcing Strategy: Lead the execution of strategic sourcing strategies for Technology categories (Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, AI) to optimize procurement in line with company objectives, including cost reduction, risk mitigation, and driving efficiency.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop 3–5 year rolling category strategies for Technology spend by working closely with Technology stakeholders to understand long-term needs and translate those insights into operational sourcing strategy.
  • Process & Governance: Develop, implement, and oversee KPIs for Technology sourcing activities; help strengthen and operationalize SS&P processes and policies, establishing a governance model to drive performance, mitigate risk, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Cost Optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives through strategic sourcing decisions, process improvements, and high-stakes supplier negotiations. Develop and track KPIs to measure savings and supplier performance.
  • Contract Negotiation & Risk Management: Lead the most complex contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms, pricing, and SLAs. Identify and mitigate internal and external risks associated with Technology purchase transactions, including risks arising from tech contract law and commercial terms.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy, and the Technology organization to align sourcing strategies with organizational needs, ensuring policies and procedures are followed and met.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Category Managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability. Assign and monitor individual and team goals, driving accountability for performance.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key Technology suppliers, ensuring they meet performance expectations and contractual agreements. Act as the primary point of contact for critical supplier issues.
  • Market Analysis & Supplier Selection: Conduct market research and competitive analysis on Technology categories to identify potential suppliers, assess market trends, and lead supplier selection processes.
  • M&A Support: Drive M&A activity from a Strategic Sourcing perspective, including contract novation and consolidation of Technology agreements.
  • Stakeholder Reporting & Communication: Regularly update senior leadership on Technology sourcing strategy progress, savings, supplier performance, and market trends, presenting insights in an executive format.
  • Compliance & Ethical Sourcing: Ensure all Technology sourcing activities adhere to ethical standards, legal requirements, and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, with a proven track record in a leadership role, and deep experience in Technology sourcing (Infrastructure, SaaS, Telecom, IaaS, AI, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of strategic sourcing methodologies, contract negotiations, supplier management, and cost optimization techniques, including deep understanding of tech contract law and commercial terms.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and executive leadership.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions on ambiguous, undefined problems.
  • Experience with procurement software and tools, as well as advanced Excel skills (Coupa, Workday Strategic Sourcing/Scout, SAP, Oracle, Ariba, etc.).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and a team simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Broad experience across multiple technology categories and industries preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPSM, or CPIM.
  • Experience in the SaaS industry leading a sourcing function.
  • Prior managerial/leadership experience with direct reports.
