About the Role

Okta is seeking a Senior Provisioning Analyst to drive end-to-end execution, governance, and Tier 2 escalation management across complex customer provisioning. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will champion operational integrity across multi-org customer environments, resolve critical provisioning bottlenecks, lead comprehensive reconciliation reporting, partner cross-functionally across global teams, and mentor team members to establish world-class operational excellence.

Position Overview & Impact

As a Senior Contributor within our Provisioning team, you will operate with high autonomy and serve as a Tier 2 Subject Matter Expert. You will take ownership of Tier 1 and Tier 2 incident resolutions, technical escalations, and multi-tenant systems management across a global scope.

In this role, you will collaborate daily on strategic and operational initiatives alongside Support, Sales Engineering, Customer Success (CSM), Renewals, and Product Engineering. Your work will directly align with organizational Vision, Methods, and Targets (VMTs) to drive customer retention and enterprise scalability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Deal & Org Provisioning: Lead end-to-end execution of complex Tier 2 customer provisioning cases, managing manual provisioning and deprovisioning alongside strategic high-value customer deprovisioning, validating contract structures, Salesforce opportunity associations, and multi-tenant org configurations while maintaining a ≥ 90% on-time SLA adherence.
  • Technical Org Management & Escalations: Resolve complex technical requests, including org migrations, Salesforce account re-associations, and custom identity tenant linkages, while seamlessly routing out-of-scope issues to specialized engineering tiers.
  • Deprovisioning & Security Governance: Execute rigorous deprovisioning and decommission workflows for transitioning and exiting accounts, upholding data privacy regulations, SOC 2 compliance standards, and corporate security guidelines with zero security defects.
  • Reconciliation Reporting & Audit Analysis: Prepare, audit, and analyze mission-critical weekly and monthly revenue/license reconciliation reports. Proactively detect systemic data variances, perform root cause analyses, and present remediation findings to leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Partner Enablement: Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success, and Support teams to unblock provisioning stalls, clarify contract parameters, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Process Innovation & Automation: Champion continuous improvement initiatives, identify automation opportunities in provisioning tooling, author standard operating procedures (SOPs), and optimize workflows for global operational scale.
    • Okta Principles in Action: Embody core values by striving to Raise your own bar in every deliverable, working to turn action into traction with measurable outcomes, learning to Thrive in change across shifting priorities, and continuous commitment to Move fast. Simplify. Repeat.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Enterprise Tooling & CRM Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, enterprise provisioning admin consoles, identity management tools, and contract lifecycle workflows.
  • Troubleshooting & Triage: Proven ability to independently troubleshoot complex Tier 1 and Tier 2 provisioning exceptions, tenant configurations, permission models, and account hierarchy mismatches.
  • Data Reconciliation & Analytical Mindset: Strong quantitative background with proven experience conducting multi-tier data reconciliations, trend audits, and variance pattern diagnostics with high attention to detail.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Superior written and verbal executive communication skills with a demonstrated aptitude for navigating cross-departmental partner relationships and de-escalating customer-critical issues.
  • Continuous Learning & Mentorship: Track record of active peer mentorship, knowledge transfer, workflow documentation, and commitment to continuous skill enhancement and career development.

Core Competencies & Leadership Behaviours

  • Build Inclusive & High-Performing Teams: Actively participate in collaborative forums, solicit diverse viewpoints, communicate transparently with colleagues, and align team efforts to operational goals.
  • Self-Awareness & Values-Driven Mindset: Treat all partners with integrity, respect, and professionalism. Actively pursue continuous learning, welcome constructive feedback, and adapt positively to change.
  • Talent Development & Knowledge Sharing: Partner proactively with management on Individual Development Plans (IDPs), share technical expertise openly, and serve as an informal mentor to onboard and upskill junior analysts.
  • Drive Results & Operational Excellence: Demonstrate relentless accountability to achieve KPIs and team targets, applying deep operational systems knowledge to deliver consistent, dependable outcomes.
  • Strategic Problem Solving & Agility: Approach complex ambiguities with an analytical, solution-oriented perspective. Formulate structured hypotheses, test assumptions, and drive scalable resolutions.

Key Performance Benchmarks (KPIs)

  • SLA Turnaround Adherence: Target: ≥ 90.0% execution of Tier 2 enterprise deal provisioning and customer change requests within SLA.
  • Quality & Governance Accuracy: Target: ≥ 99.5% accuracy across Salesforce org linkages, contract associations, and account deprovisioning workflows.
  • Reconciliation Reporting Punctuality: Target: 100% on-time completion of recurring weekly and monthly enterprise license reconciliation audits.
  • Mentorship & Culture Contribution: Target: Consistently exceeds expectations through peer coaching, process enablement, and team involvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or commensurate job experience
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Customer service oriented
  • Solid understanding of provisioning/software licensing, including upstream/downstream activity
  • Ability to take initiative, work flexibly, and adhere to priorities with minimal direct supervision
  • Meticulous and detail oriented
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Staff Software Engineer - Backend

Get to Know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box—we are looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences and backgrounds.

Join our team! We are building a world where Identity belongs to you.

Identity Security Pillar

Okta's Identity Security Pillar is at the forefront of defending modern enterprise environments against sophisticated identity-centric attacks. As enterprise attack surfaces expand across clouds, SaaS ecosystems, and hybrid networks, our pillar delivers unified, next-generation security capabilities that protect organizations across the entire threat lifecycle.

Joining our pillar gives you the unique opportunity to build and impact diverse, cutting-edge products across the security domain, including:

  • Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM): Delivering continuous, contextual visibility into complex identity infrastructure, surfacing misconfigurations, eliminating toxic combinations of permissions, and reducing overall attack surfaces.
  • Identity Threat Protection (ITP): ITP delivers real-time, surgical defense against the most sophisticated and rapidly evolving threats. By deeply integrating with existing security infrastructure, ITP relentlessly analyzes user behavior and system data to proactively hunt down and neutralize risks before they impact our customers.
  • Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR): Detecting sophisticated credential compromise, privilege escalation, and lateral movement with speed and automated response capabilities.

As we expand our engineering footprint in India, you will be a foundational member of a high-impact team driving architectural scale, technical innovation, and product synergy across this critical pillar.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Staff Software Engineer within the team, you will play a pivotal architectural and hands-on role in scaling our foundational platforms and web applications, with a primary emphasis on backend architecture and distributed services. You will partner closely with distributed teams to deliver robust, high-performance security solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, design, architect, and build high-quality, scalable software by enforcing best practices around software engineering, architecture, and processes
  • Raise the bar on engineering excellence by improving standard methodologies, producing best-in-class code, documentation, testing, and monitoring
  • Collaborate with product and R&D engineers to translate product requirements into technical solutions.
  • Identifying and resolving technical issues and performance bottlenecks.
  • Staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve our products.
  • Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining complex, enterprise-grade distributed systems in high-growth environments.
  • Backend Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing backend services using Python.
  • Architectural Mastery: Deep knowledge of backend architecture, pipeline design, and data persistence patterns.
  • Database & Storage Systems: Practical experience working with relational databases as well as NoSQL/caching stores.
  • System Principles: Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and scalable software design patterns.
  • Collaboration & Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with strong communication abilities to collaborate across distributed, global engineering teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Extra Credit If You Have Experience In

  • Modern cloud platforms (particularly AWS) and container orchestration.
  • Identity and security domains (IAM, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, posture management, threat detection, or cloud security).

descriptionHtml:

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Security Engineer, Customer Identity, Advanced Threat Protection

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Role 

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

Responsibilities:

  • Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)  
  • Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
  • Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses  
  • Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there  
  • Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited  
  • Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants  
  • Establish and execute a long-term engineering and threat research roadmap for Advanced Threat Protection aligned with company-wide business and security goals.
  • Own high-impact security architecture designs and decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience.
  • Drive cross-functional security strategies and partner across engineering, product, and enterprise security leadership across Okta to influence platform-wide standards and policies.
  • Actively coach, mentor, and level up Senior (P3) engineers and team members, fostering technical excellence, research discipline, and leadership growth.

What this position is not: 

  • Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work  
  • Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

Requirements:

  • You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks  
  • 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a proven track record of setting technical vision, driving cross-organizational initiatives, and leading architectural choices in cloud/product security.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior-level engineers, defining multi-quarter technical strategy, driving architectural consensus, and influencing cross-organizational security initiatives.  
  • You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research  
  • You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:  
    • AWS and/or Azure security  
    • Kubernetes  
  • You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices  
  • You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices  
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams  
  • You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

Bonus points if:

  • You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security  
  • You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment  
  • You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:  
    • Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research  
    • The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications  
    • Identity and access management  
    • Full-stack engineering  
    • Site reliability engineering  
    • Vulnerability and threat management  
    • Governance, risk and compliance

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Engineering Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join Okta's Emerging Products Group (EPG). Our mission is to build highly reliable, scalable, and secure cloud services that our customers can trust. We embrace an automation-first mindset and continuously invest in platform engineering, observability, and operational excellence to enable our engineering teams to move quickly and safely.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges at scale, building automation, and improving the reliability of production systems. You will serve as a technical leader within the EPG SRE organization, partnering closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, build, and operate world-class cloud services.

The ideal candidate exemplifies the philosophy of "if you have to do it more than once, automate it" and possesses a strong passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and software engineering.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Reliability & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale cloud infrastructure and production services.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting highly available customer-facing systems.
  • Lead incident response efforts and drive post-incident reviews focused on systemic improvements.
  • Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve service availability, scalability, performance, and resilience.
  • Continuously improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

Engineering & Automation

  • Develop software, automation, and infrastructure using Go, Python, Terraform, and related technologies.
  • Eliminate operational toil through automation, tooling, and platform engineering.
  • Improve deployment safety and operational workflows through CI/CD and GitOps practices.
  • Collaborate on modernizing existing workloads and aligning them with evolving platform capabilities.
  • Build self-service platforms, operational guardrails, and automation that improve developer velocity while maintaining reliability and security.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex reliability initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams.
  • Guide engineers in adopting operational best practices and reliability engineering principles.
  • Mentor engineers through technical collaboration, design reviews, incident analysis, and knowledge sharing.
  • Influence architecture and operational decisions through data-driven recommendations and engineering expertise.
  • Drive projects from conception through production rollout and long-term operational ownership.

Innovation

  • Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering techniques to improve operational efficiency, incident response, troubleshooting, and automation.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to reduce toil and improve engineering productivity.

Our Tech Stack

  • Infrastructure/Orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, Helm, Git, ArgoCD, GitOps
  • Programming: Golang, Python
  • Observability: Datadog, Splunk
  • Data Stores: PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch

What We Are Looking For

Technical Excellence

  • Strong experience operating large-scale production services in AWS and/or GCP.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes networking, storage, scheduling, scaling, and workload lifecycle issues.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and Helm.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Golang and/or Python.
  • Experience building automation and internal engineering platforms.
  • Experience operating and troubleshooting distributed data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, ingress, TLS, service networking, and traffic management.
  • Experience with observability platforms, monitoring strategies, and production telemetry.
  • Experience with or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering and operational automation.

Operational Excellence

  • Strong expertise operating customer-facing production systems.
  • Experience leading incident response and driving operational improvements.
  • Deep understanding of reliability engineering concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and automation-first operational practices.
  • Proven ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, and engineering velocity.

Security & Compliance

  • Understanding of cloud security fundamentals, IAM, secrets management, and secure infrastructure design.
  • Experience implementing operational controls and best practices in regulated or security-sensitive environments is a plus.

Leadership

  • Demonstrated success leading complex engineering initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Experience working effectively within globally distributed engineering organizations spanning multiple timezones and cultures.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and elevating technical capabilities within an organization.
  • Ability to influence technical direction through expertise, partnership, and execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating SaaS platforms serving large-scale customer workloads.
  • Experience working within Kubernetes-based microservices environments.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed production environments.
  • Experience with GitOps and ArgoCD.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted operational tooling or automation workflows.

title: Staff Product Manager - Developer Productivity
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Role Overview

AI is rapidly changing how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, deployed, and operated — and the industry playbook is being rewritten monthly. Okta's Developer Productivity and AI Enablement Engineering teams own building and operating the capabilities that make our engineers fast across the inner and outer development loops. This role is the product counterpart, embedded full-time with that organization, that makes those investments compound by uncovering and prioritizing frictions, bringing the outside in, driving standardize-vs-federate decisions, spreading what works across teams, funding and clearing the path for the best tools, and proving the value.

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to own developer productivity as a product across Okta's development lifecycle — AI-native and traditional tooling alike. You will start bottom-up: interviewing engineers, managers, tech leads, and architects; mapping current inner- and outer-loop tooling and the frictions; and baselining dev-cycle metrics. From there, you will own the roadmap with engineering leadership; benchmark how the best engineering organizations build with AI; define tooling requirements and/or run the tooling evaluations engineering needs in a landscape that changes monthly; find the teams inside Okta getting outsized results and turn their patterns into playbooks; lead build, buy, integrate, and standardize decisions, including the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0; clear the security, legal, procurement, and budget paths that slow adoption; and own the measurement that connects investment to engineering outcomes — evidence engineering leaders can take into any room.

This is a highly technical internal platform role that creates value for Okta through a cross-team, cross-industry, cross-functional layer that turns individual wins into organizational capability.

What You'll Do

  • Product Strategy & Discovery: Own the vision, PRDs, and prioritized backlog for Okta's internal developer productivity and AI tooling. Treat engineers as your customers: start with deep, bottom-up discovery (dozens of engineer, EM, tech lead, and architect interviews), baseline dev-cycle metrics, and secure tooling budgets with rigorous, ROI-driven business cases.
  • Ecosystem Validation (Build vs. Buy): Drive definitive "adopt, build, or pass" decisions. Run hands-on, structured evaluations of inner- and outer-loop tooling — from coding agents and MCPs to build, CI/CD, and code review systems — against strict security and TCO criteria to ensure internal investments amplify vendor capabilities.
  • Hands-On Execution: Embed full-time with Developer Productivity Engineering and own the roadmap jointly with its engineering leads. Define MVP scopes, manage sprints, and incrementally ship workflows. You own the strategy and requirements (the what and why); Engineering owns the technical execution (the how).
  • Adoption & Outcomes: Own org-wide adoption, clearing security, legal, and privacy hurdles along the way. Measure success by connecting tool usage directly to hard engineering outcomes (cycle time, quality, toil reduction).
  • Standardization & Lighthouses: Coordinate the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0 engineering. Study high-performing teams to see who is getting exceptional results, and convert those patterns into scalable playbooks that shift the broader org from passive AI use to agentic workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience with developer platforms, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI products.
  • Experience owning internal or platform products where users have alternatives — adoption driven through product quality rather than mandate.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development workflows — source control, IDEs, CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, production operations — across the inner and outer loops of development.
  • Hands-on, current fluency with AI-assisted software development — coding agents, context management, MCP, evaluation frameworks — and informed views on where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and run technology evaluations and controlled experiments, and to define measurement systems for developer productivity with judgment about their failure modes.
  • Ability to engage credibly in technical and architectural discussions with senior engineers while maintaining clear boundaries between product outcomes and engineering implementation.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, security, architecture, and finance without direct authority.
  • Excellent written communication in a docs-first culture; you can produce solid action plans from incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying or scaling developer tools across a large, multi-org engineering organization — including consolidating divergent stacks and the change management that comes with it.
  • Hands-on familiarity with developer AI tools, harnesses, APIs, MCPs, and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with developer productivity research (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and its failure modes.
  • Experience establishing governance, evaluation frameworks, or spend management for rapidly evolving, consumption-priced technologies.

Why This Role Matters

AI-assisted development is becoming both one of the largest levers on engineering velocity and one of the largest new variable costs in R&D. The playbook changes monthly, and the organizations that win are the ones that learn fastest from the outside, spread what works internally, and measure honestly. That learning-and-leverage layer doesn't build itself — engineering teams optimizing locally, however well, still leave organizational value uncaptured and accumulate divergent implementations that slow everyone down.

This role exists to capture it: dedicated product leadership that brings engineering the external intelligence, funded tooling, cleared paths, shared patterns, and defensible evidence to build with AI faster than any single team could alone — while deepening Okta's firsthand credibility as the company that secures the AI-powered enterprise for its customers.

title: Senior Product Manager, Okta for AI Agents
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. As a Senior Product Manager, Okta for AI Agents, you will drive the product strategy and execution for how Okta secures AI. As AI agents increasingly act on behalf of humans and organizations, the need for robust identity, permissions, and audibility has never been more critical. You will define how Okta secures this agentic future, building the capabilities that allow organizations to safely connect AI agents to their enterprise tools with strict, identity-driven governance. To achieve this, you will design, build, and launch core features spanning agent identity lifecycle management, dynamic permission scoping, delegated authorization, and comprehensive audit trails, directly shaping the underlying trust frameworks and APIs that power these secure workflows.

Okta for AI Agents is a foundational new pillar for the company, acting as the critical trust layer that sits between automated, agentic workflows and the rigorous security posture our customers require for their enterprise systems. You will partner closely with engineering, design, other product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Okta's platform to ensure AI identity capabilities evolve strategically, including driving how agent access, oversight, and governance are rolled out and managed at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with AI platform developers, security architects, and internal stakeholders to distill feature asks, gather feedback, and ensure product-market fit for AI agent identity.
  • Product Scope: Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for AI agent-specific capabilities, including agent-to-agent authentication and delegated authority.
  • Roadmap Ownership: Identify and prioritize the development of new features such as dynamic session management for AI, "on-behalf-of" token exchange, and agent-specific audit logs.
  • Technical Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to define protocols (e.g., extensions to OAuth/OIDC) and deployment models that align with modern AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Delivery & Execution: Drive cross-functional execution with design, engineering, and documentation teams to deliver high-quality features on time.
  • Market Awareness: Track industry trends in LLMs, agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT), and emerging AI security standards to develop differentiated solutions.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage product data to continually improve agent lifecycle management and drive adoption within the developer community.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert for AI Identity, enabling marketing and technical sales teams with the tools needed to position Okta for AI use cases.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of technical product management experience in enterprise-scale SaaS products, or an equivalent background demonstrating core PM competencies.
  • Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) protocols such as OAuth2, OIDC, and SAML.
  • Deep understanding of API security and the developer experience for integrating security services.
  • Analytical and decisive: Ability to drive action even with incomplete or ambiguous information in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
  • Excellent communication skills: Ability to work cross-functionally with research, design, engineering, and customer success teams.
  • Technical background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience that allows you to influence technical design decisions.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks or building products that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience with developer-centric products, such as building with SDKs, APIs, or no-code/low-code integration platforms.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and how it applies to non-human entities and automated workloads.
  • Prior experience in a "Zero to One" product environment, launching new products from initial concept to GA.
  • Advanced degree in a technical or business field

Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

Tagline: Build the engine that builds Okta.

🚀 Your Mission: Define the Future of Developer Velocity at Okta

Are you a software engineer who believes that an exceptional developer platform is the key to unlocking engineering-wide innovation? Are you obsessed with building the high-leverage tools, services, and automated infrastructure that make building, testing, and deploying software a seamless experience?

Okta's Platform & Infrastructure team is the central nervous system for all of Okta Engineering. We build and own the entire internal developer platform—the CI/CD pipelines, the build-and-test orchestration, and the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers it all.

This isn't just about maintaining systems. It's about building a scalable, resilient, and blazing-fast "paved road" that empowers hundreds of engineers to ship high-quality code, multiple times a day.

Our scale is immense. We run tens of thousands of automated tests for every single commit. As Okta grows, this CI/CD workload presents a monumental engineering challenge.

Your primary goal will be to attack this problem head-on. You will be a key builder  in our quest to shrink massive, distributed compute jobs from hours or days down to just minutes. This role requires deep systems thinking, clever orchestration, and a passion for wringing every last drop of performance out of the infrastructure.

💻 What You'll Do (The Impact)

As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader, architect, and hands-on builder. You will:

  • Architect & Build: Design, code, and operate the next generation of our CI/CD platform, primarily using Go (Golang) and Python.
  • Master Kubernetes: Leverage your deep Kubernetes (K8s) expertise to orchestrate our complex and ephemeral build, test, and deployment workflows at massive scale.
  • Own the Multi-Cloud: Build services and automation that abstract and manage workloads extensively across AWS, GCP, and Azure, optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability.
  • Build a Platform, Not Just Tools: Create robust, self-service, and elegant internal products for our engineers. You'll treat our internal developers as your first-class customers.
  • Drive Innovation: You will not just use our build and CI systems, you will be responsible for building and scaling them.
  • Mentor & Lead: Collaborate with peers, mentor other engineers, and set the technical direction for major platform initiatives.

✅ What You'll Bring (The Requirements)

We are looking for a seasoned engineer who has built and scaled internal platforms before.

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering 
  • Coding Skills: You are a strong software engineer first, with proven experience building and maintaining complex systems in Go (Golang) and/or Python.
  • Kubernetes is a Must: You have deep, practical experience building, running, and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes. You understand pods, operators, scheduling, and networking inside and out.
  • CI/CD as a Platform: You have architected, built, and/or significantly scaled CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Tekton, ArgoCD) as a platform for other engineers, not just as an end-user.
  • Cloud Expertise: You have demonstrable experience working in major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and understand the nuances of their core services.
  • The Platform Ecosystem: You're fluent in the tools of the trade: Docker, container registries (like Artifactory), and modern build systems (like Gradle or Bazel).
  • Platform Mindset: You are customer-obsessed (your customers are other engineers) and have a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects to completion.
  • Education: B.S. in Computer Science, equivalent technical experience, or just a proven track record of shipping incredible systems.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box—we are looking for lifelong learners and critical thinkers who can make us better with their unique experiences and drive.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Team

The Enterprise Technology – Agentic Operations team within Okta’s Technology, Data & Intelligence (TDI) organization delivers frontline and specialized business application support across Okta's global enterprise tech stack. Our application landscape is centered on Salesforce and deeply integrated with best-of-breed enterprise platforms, including Clari, DocuSign, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ServiceNow, and Jira.

Our team plays a critical part in realizing Okta’s business outcomes by driving operational clarity, rapid problem resolution, and accountability. We actively empower the broader TDI organization in its core mission: to Accelerate Okta’s Scale and Growth through intelligent automation and resilient systems.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and analytical Senior Business Applications Administrator to anchor the operational health, configuration, and continuous support of our Salesforce ecosystem and interconnected business applications.

In this role, you will support critical Go-To-Market (GTM) functions—spanning Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and CPQ—ensuring system stability, data integrity, and peak user productivity. You will act as an escalation point for frontline support administrators, champion operational excellence, and actively harness cutting-edge AI technologies (such as Gemini, Claude, and proprietary internal AI tools) to modernize incident triaging and drive automated operational workflows.

Duties & Responsibilities

Operational Support & Incident Management

  • Advanced Incident Resolution: Triage, diagnose, and resolve Tier 2/3 incidents across Salesforce and connected enterprise applications in alignment with strict response and resolution SLAs.
  • AI-Augmented Operations: Leverage generative AI platforms (Gemini, Claude, and internal custom AI assistants) to accelerate root-cause analysis, automate repetitive support workflows, and optimize ticket triage.
  • Critical Period Support: Provide dedicated operational readiness and real-time support during high-stakes business periods, including fiscal month-end and quarter-end close cycles.
  • Frontline Mentorship: Serve as an escalation partner and technical mentor to frontline system administrators and support analysts.

System Administration & Ecosystem Health

  • Configuration & Maintenance: Manage user provisioning, security controls (profiles, roles, permission sets), workflow automations (Flows), custom objects, page layouts, and reports/dashboards.
  • Integration Oversight: Maintain data flow and operational health between Salesforce and third-party SaaS platforms (e.g., Clari, DocuSign, Outreach, ServiceNow).
  • Release & Change Management: Execute change sets, sandbox seeding, regression testing, and production deployments following structured release management methodologies.

Governance, Compliance & Documentation

  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all system changes and administrative practices strictly adhere to TDI security guidelines, data privacy standards, and SOX controls.
  • Audit Readiness: Participate in periodic security and access reviews, proactively addressing vulnerabilities and compliance gaps.
  • Knowledge Management: Author and maintain comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs), system runbooks, and self-service knowledge base articles for global enterprise support teams.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in business systems administration or technical application support within enterprise environments.
  • Salesforce Expertise: Strong administrative expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud (configuration, Flow builder, permission management, data loader, reporting).
  • Ecosystem & Tooling: Working knowledge of modern enterprise SaaS stacks, including ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) and version control/release tools such as Gearset.
  • Compliance & Governance: Solid understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, audit requirements, and SOX compliance procedures.
  • Global Collaboration: Proven track record collaborating effectively with cross-functional and distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Communication & Problem-Solving: Outstanding analytical troubleshooting abilities, active listening skills, and clear technical communication for both colleagues and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Platform App Builder.
  • GTM & CPQ Familiarity: Hands-on exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Billing, or common revenue architecture workflows.
  • AI & Automation Enthusiasm: Experience incorporating LLM tooling (Gemini, Claude, custom GPTs) or workflow scripts into day-to-day administrative tasks to improve team efficiency.

Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering – Strategic (Auth0)

The Auth0 Solutions Engineering Team

Identity is the front door to digital customer experience and the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Auth0 by Okta secures consumer and B2B SaaS experiences by providing the trusted, developer-centric, and neutral identity layer that modern digital enterprises depend on. Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) sits at the critical intersection of security, developer velocity, and consumer friction. Delivering frictionless user onboarding, robust authentication, and enterprise-grade security at massive scale requires relentless problem-solvers. We are looking for builders and leaders who operate with speed and urgency and execute with technical excellence.

This is an opportunity to lead the technical presales strategy for our most transformative enterprise accounts.

The Okta Strategic Accounts Solutions Engineering Team

The Okta Solutions Engineering team unites deep technical architecture with commercial insight. We advise Okta’s largest, most strategic enterprises on architecting modern CIAM strategies that deliver seamless, secure digital journeys to millions of end users. As a leadership team, we partner with customers to evaluate complex customer-facing digital ecosystems, assess scale and privacy requirements, and deploy CIAM solutions that drive measurable business outcomes—from increasing user conversion rates to preventing account takeovers.

The Role

Reporting to the Senior Director, AMER Presales Strategic Accounts, this role leads the Auth0 Solutions Engineering team focused on Okta’s highest-value and highest-potential enterprise customers. Our SE leaders are domain experts in Auth0 who can see ahead to emerging digital trends and translate them into actionable, multi-year technical roadmaps. You will be a vital growth engine, partnering closely with Strategic Sales leadership to co-author and execute the technical strategy across complex Auth0 transformations.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead and Scale a High-Performing Team: Lead and mentor a team of ~10 Senior and Principal Solutions Engineers specializing in Auth0. Drive end-to-end talent acquisition, onboarding, and hands-on professional development, equipping your team to master both developer-led evaluations and C-suite architectural discussions.
  • Drive Strategic Engagements: Standardize and execute technical sales playbooks designed for complex Auth0 scenarios—including legacy user database migrations, omnichannel authentication, social and passwordless login, bot and fraud mitigation, and high-throughput peak events.
  • Champion Architectural Rigor: Oversee technical validations, proofs of concept (POCs), and architectural reviews for high-concurrency, mission-critical consumer and business applications. Establish metrics and KPIs to measure evaluation efficiency, technical win rates, and customer time-to-value.
  • Serve as an Executive Technical Sponsor: Act as an active executive sponsor on Tier-1 opportunities. Build high-trust advisory relationships with customer executives across both technical and digital product organizations (CPOs, CDOs, CMOs, CIOs, and CISOs), balancing developer experience, consumer friction, and rigorous security posture.
  • Influence the Auth0 Roadmap: Serve as a crucial strategic feedback channel between our largest enterprise clients and Auth0 Product and Engineering teams, translating field requirements into platform innovations.
  • Operationalize Cross-Functional Alliances: Partner closely with Strategic Sales leadership to operationalize enterprise sales methodologies (Command of the Message, MEDDPICC). Collaborate with Operations, Enablement, HR, and Finance to drive strategic workforce planning, technical skills development, and headcount/budget allocation, ensuring the SE organization is resourced for sustainable scale and high performance.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • Proven CIAM Domain Expertise: Substantial presales or architectural background specifically within Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM), developer platforms, or consumer-facing digital identity ecosystems.
  • Presales Leadership Experience: 4+ years of directly managing and scaling a high-performing technical presales or solutions engineering team within enterprise SaaS.
  • Deep Identity Protocol Knowledge: Strong working comprehension of modern identity protocols and architectures, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, Passkeys/WebAuthn, JWT, API security, and token management, along with exposure to mobile and web SDK integrations.
  • High-Scale Application Architecture Fluency: Proven ability to navigate large-scale architectural challenges, such as multi-region identity routing, tenant isolation, session management, and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA).
  • Enterprise Sales Acumen: Demonstrated success applying value-based selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) to close complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional executive teams spanning Security, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.

Extra Credit

  • 12+ years of total technical presales, solutions architecture, or professional services experience in enterprise security or software development.
  • Hands-on background in full-stack web/mobile application development, API design, or modern cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Direct experience competing in or analyzing the broader Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Customer Identity (CIAM) competitive landscape.
  • Familiarity with adjacent technologies: Web Application Firewalls (WAF), bot management/fraud detection, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), and CRM ecosystems.

* Role will require 2 days a week in office if you live within 50 miles of an Okta office. Other locations are remote.

  • Solid experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions)

You will align key program metrics with leadership objectives, oversee portfolio health, and support secondary operational areas such as productivity tooling and SaaS license oversight where needed.

  • End-to-End Program  and Project Leadership: Lead complex, multi-stream programs  and projects from initiation through execution and delivery, ensuring clear scope alignment, timeline tracking, and milestone achievements.
  • Portfolio Management & Alignment: Oversee the overall project portfolio, maintaining roadmap visibility, aligning resources, and balancing business priorities across cross-functional teams.
  • Program Analytics & Reporting: Define and track core program performance metrics, key health indicators, and business ROI, presenting executive dashboards and status updates to leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with business leaders, engineering teams, and global stakeholders to gather strategic requirements, resolve trade-offs, and drive enterprise alignment.

  • Process Optimization & Governance: Establish robust program governance framework, standardize delivery methodologies, and streamline execution workflows across global teams.
  • Change Management & Operational Enablement: Drive change management, communication plans, and training programs for newly rolled-out enterprise initiatives to maximize user adoption and operational success.
  • Secondary Operations & Resource Planning: Support partner functions including Procurement, Finance, and Security with contract reviews, resource optimization, and operational compliance as necessary.
  • Executive Escalations & Support: Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for strategic program roadblocks, scope changes, and executive alignment.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • Program Leadership Expertise: 5+ years of experience leading complex strategic programs or PMO portfolios in enterprise IT, SaaS, or high-growth technology environments.
  • Strategic Execution & Planning: Proven track record of managing end-to-end program delivery, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and multi-stream project roadmaps.
  • Data-Driven Insights: High proficiency in tracking program KPIs, performance dashboards, and executive reporting tools (e.g., Jira, Tableau, Power BI, Excel/Sheets) to support decision-making.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to lead alignment and use persuasion to align senior business partners and external vendors on new processes and business impacts.
  • Program Governance & Methodology: Deep experience with project and program management frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and PPM/ITSM tooling (Jira, ServiceNow, Asana).
  • Global Operational Agility: Proven experience working autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced environment supporting a distributed, global company across time zones (particularly US hubs).

License Management, Renewals & Automation

  • SaaS License Oversight: Oversee enterprise SaaS applications, monitoring seat utilization, provisioning metrics, and deployment health to optimize software spend.
  • Contract Renewals & Vendor Strategy: Partner with Procurement and IT leadership to manage renewal timelines, evaluate vendor commitments, and align contract terms with operational needs.
  • Workflow & Provisioning Automation: Identify opportunities to automate license request workflows, deprovisioning processes, and compliance tracking using enterprise orchestration tools.

Why Join

  • Drive Strategic Enterprise Impact: Directly shape and execute core business programs that influence global strategy and organizational efficiency.

title: Product Architect, AI (Auth0)
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Auth0, an Okta company, we help organizations build secure, seamless customer experiences. As AI agents become active participants in software systems (acting on behalf of people, organizations, and other agents) identity becomes even more foundational. We are building for a future where agents can securely authenticate, access resources, delegate authority, and operate within clear, auditable boundaries.

We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Architect, AI to help define how Auth0 and Okta lead the market in agentic identity, secure AI application development, and standards-based access for agents.

This is a senior, highly strategic, and deeply hands-on role. You will work across Product, Engineering, Security, Developer Relations, Design, Go-to-Market, and our customer community to shape the technical and product direction for AI-native identity capabilities.

You will bring a strong point of view on where the industry is going, grounded in real experience building AI-powered and agentic systems. You will help us translate fast-moving technical developments (including MCP, A2A, agentic commerce, delegated authorization, and emerging agent identity standards) into secure, practical product capabilities that customers can adopt with confidence.

This role is for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation: setting a long-term vision, designing platform primitives, engaging directly with customers and partners, contributing to standards and open source communities, and occasionally writing production-quality code or prototypes to prove what is possible.

What you’ll be doing

  • Define and evolve Auth0’s strategy for building, operating, and securing AI agents and agentic applications.
  • Shape the product and technical strategy for agentic identity, including how agents authenticate, receive delegated authority, access resources, establish trust, and maintain auditable boundaries.
  • Define approaches for securely exposing protected resources (including APIs, tools, data services, and MCP servers) to authorized agents.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering leaders to turn strategic opportunities into clear product bets, architectural principles, product requirements, and durable platform capabilities.
  • Help design and, where valuable, implement core identity capabilities that enable secure agent-to-resource and agent-to-agent interactions.
  • Develop an informed perspective on emerging technologies and standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent protocols, agentic commerce, AAuth, authorization frameworks, workload identity, and related specifications.
  • Deep curiosity and a disciplined approach to staying ahead of the AI landscape, including foundation models, agent harnesses, AI frameworks, orchestration tools, evaluation and observability platforms, and rapidly evolving developer practices. You can distinguish durable shifts from short-lived hype and articulate their implications for customers, developers, and Auth0’s product strategy.
  • Identify important industry shifts early, assess their implications for customers and the identity ecosystem, and communicate a clear point of view internally and externally.
  • Work directly with strategic customers to understand their AI and identity architectures, uncover unmet needs, validate product direction, and help them build securely.
  • Collaborate with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Trust teams to ensure that AI-related identity capabilities are secure, responsible, compliant, and usable in real-world enterprise environments.
  • Represent Auth0 and Okta in the developer and identity communities through technical content, speaking engagements, customer conversations, standards participation, and open-source engagement.
  • Build prototypes, reference implementations, and technical demonstrations using technologies such as Node.js, React, Python, and Go.
  • Partner with Developer Relations and Go-to-Market teams to make complex identity and AI concepts approachable for developers, architects, customers, and partners.
  • Raise the technical bar across the organization by mentoring others, documenting architectural patterns, and creating clarity in an evolving technical landscape.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in product architecture, technical product management, software architecture, platform engineering, developer platforms, or a similarly customer- and technology-facing leadership role.
  • Experience building and shipping AI-powered applications, agentic systems, developer tools, or platforms used by developers to build them.
  • Deep expertise in modern identity and authorization standards, especially OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, workload identity, token exchange, delegated authorization, API authorization, and related identity protocols.
  • A strong understanding of how to securely design access to APIs, tools, data, and services in distributed systems.
  • Practical familiarity with the emerging agent ecosystem, including MCP, agent-to-agent interactions, tool invocation, AI application architectures, and the evolving questions around agent identity, authorization, delegation, consent, intent, and auditability.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop a strategy in ambiguous, quickly evolving markets and turn it into concrete product and technical decisions.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, developers, and partners to solve complex technical problems and influence product direction.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain deeply technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • A strong external presence in relevant technical communities through speaking, standards work, open-source contributions, technical writing, or other visible contributions.
  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries, influencing without direct authority and driving alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong software development skills and comfort writing code in one or more of Node.js/TypeScript, React, Python, or Go.

And extra credit if you have

  • Experience contributing to or participating in identity, security, AI, or agent-related standards organizations and open-source projects.
  • Experience designing developer-facing authentication, authorization, API security, or identity platform products.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, B2B platforms, consumer-facing applications, or both.
  • Experience with authorization policy systems, fine-grained authorization, consent, entitlements, and delegated access models.
  • Experience building or operating MCP servers, AI agent platforms, AI-enabled workflows, or agent-to-agent systems.
  • Experience with cloud security, workload identity, zero trust, API gateways, service-to-service authorization, or secure software supply chains.
  • A track record of helping organizations navigate major platform shifts, such as cloud, mobile, API-first development, or AI.
  • A pragmatic approach to innovation: excitement about emerging technology paired with a clear understanding of security, customer value, operational realities, and adoption barriers.

  • Making Social Impact
  • Developing Talent and Fostering Connection

Okta cultivates a dynamic work environment, providing the best tools, technology, and benefits to empower employees to work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs.

Staff Software Engineer, Device Identity (Java)

Device Identity and Access Organization

The Device Identity and Access organization is at the forefront of Okta’s Zero Trust vision. As a foundational pillar within Okta Research and Development (ORD), our mission is to transform the device itself into a secure, trusted, and effortless identity factor. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world.

We engineer the end-to-end device experience—from our flagship FastPass, Okta Device Access (ODA), and Device Assurance. Our teams own the continuous authentication pipeline, device lifecycle management, and the sophisticated cloud services that analyze real-time trust and assurance signals to make frictionless, passwordless access a reality across Windows, macOS, iOS, Linux and Android.

Our organization is comprised of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user.

Explore our culture and technical innovations on the Okta Engineering Blog.

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

We seek a dynamic and influential Staff Software Engineer to join our Device Identity engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their deep Java experience to architect, build, and scale the critical server-side software and services at the heart of our security and identity platform. This is a high-visibility, hands-on opportunity to design solutions for current and emerging industry challenges.

You will not only demonstrate an aptitude for software engineering excellence but also act as a player-coach, mentoring other engineers and elevating the team's capabilities. You will join an engineering team that shares a passion for elegant solutions and believes in designing for scale, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and an iterative process to build high-quality enterprise software.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and QA to ensure the seamless delivery of our most critical engineering initiatives.
  • Lead the design and implementation of new features and services within our core Java platform, taking ownership from conception to deployment.
  • Define and champion engineering best practices, and make critical contributions to technical designs, proposals, and long-term architectural decisions.
  • Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and by setting a high bar for quality and security.
  • Develop high-quality, maintainable software with comprehensive test coverage and drive improvements to our testing and CI/CD strategies.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation and foster a culture of knowledge sharing within the team and the broader organization.
  • Champion the adoption of AI-native engineering practices within our Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while ensuring rigorous security and code quality standards.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 7+ years of software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, high-performance server-side features using Java and Spring.
  • Deep expertise with high-performance Postgres or MySQL environments, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience designing, building, and securing RESTful APIs for large-scale systems.
  • Expert knowledge of server-side technologies, including caching, asynchronous processing, and multi-threading.
  • A deep understanding of design patterns, scalability patterns, security engineering, and object-oriented principles.
  • Experience in fast-paced agile environments, with a strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence technical direction.
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle, with a focus on maintaining high standards for code quality and security.

Nice-to-haves

  • Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (FIDO, U2F, WebAuthn, SSO, SAML, OAuth, Federation, etc.)
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+.
  • Experience with UI technologies such as ReactJS
  • Exposure to gRPC API development
  • Exposure to microservice architecture  

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Senior Software Reliability Engineer - Data Platform 

About the Team

The Data Platform team is responsible for the foundational data services, systems, and data products for Okta that benefit our users. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables:

  • Streaming analytics 
  • Interactive end-user reporting 
  • Data and ML platform for Okta to scale
  • Telemetry of our products and data

Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever.

About the Position

This is an opportunity for experienced Software Reliability Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low-latency, distributed data-platform services & data products. In this role, you will get to work with engineers throughout the organization to build foundational infrastructure that allows Okta to scale for years to come. title: GTM Strategy & Activation - Pre and Post Sales Readiness
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

Role Summary

Okta Secures AI is Okta's product line for agent identity—securing what AI agents can access and do across the enterprise.

This role owns GTM readiness across the full customer lifecycle, from first conversation through deployment, adoption, and expansion. Pre-sales, you ensure AEs, SEs, and FDEs can position, demo, differentiate, and win. Post-sales, you ensure Professional Services, partners, TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs can deploy, drive adoption, and expand.

This is a strategy role, not a traditional enablement role. You own the customer insight, messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, and readiness strategy. You build from what you hear in customer conversations and see in live deployments, then partner with the teams that own enablement and delivery to scale it.

AI is moving weekly. The work needs to move just as fast.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales Readiness

  • Messaging and positioning: Build the narrative, value proposition, proof points, and persona-specific stories sellers use in live deals.
  • Competitive readiness: Develop competitive positioning, objection handling, and talk tracks as the market evolves.
  • Demo readiness: Equip SEs and FDEs with the stories, scenarios, and technical depth needed to demonstrate Okta Secures AI credibly.
  • Launch and pricing readiness: Ensure the field understands what's new, what's changed, and how to take it to market.
  • Field signal: Partner directly with sellers and SEs to identify gaps in live deals and turn those insights into reusable solutions.

Post-Sales Readiness

  • Deployment readiness: Work with FDEs and Professional Services to turn real deployment patterns into repeatable use cases, reference architectures, and playbooks.
  • Partner readiness: Help SI and implementation partners deliver Okta Secures AI deployments to the same standard as Okta Professional Services.
  • Adoption and expansion: Equip TAMs and CSMs with health signals, use-case expansion paths, and messaging for renewal and growth conversations.
  • Customer proof: Turn deployment and adoption outcomes into customer stories, proof points, and references that strengthen both pre- and post-sales.
  • Feedback loop: Bring deployment and adoption learnings back into product, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and GTM decisions.

Strategic Scope & Influence

You will own the GTM strategy behind readiness—not the training channels themselves.

Your scope includes:

  • Messaging architecture: Define what each audience needs to know and say while maintaining one consistent Okta Secures AI narrative.
  • Buyer and persona insight: Understand how buying and adoption decisions differ across CIO, CISO, CTO, developer, and technical audiences.
  • Competitive strategy: Help the organization win against competitors before the sale and defend the business after it.
  • Launch readiness: Set the readiness bar for new products, releases, and pricing changes across the customer lifecycle.
  • Customer evidence: Turn customer conversations, deployments, and outcomes into insights and proof the organization can use.
  • Outcome ownership: Measure the impact on win rate, time to deployment, adoption, and expansion.

Note: You do not build a parallel enablement organization. Sales Enablement, Partner Enablement, Dev Enablement, Customer Success, and Professional Services own their channels and programs. You own the strategy, content, and customer signal that feeds those programs.

How You'll Work

  • Stay close to customers: Join discovery calls, deal reviews, deployments, and post-sales conversations every week.
  • Work directly with FDEs: See where customers get stuck and turn those patterns into better positioning, playbooks, and deployment guidance.
  • Work across the field: Partner with sellers, SEs, consultants, TAMs, and CSMs to identify the highest-impact gaps.
  • Scale through existing teams: Get your strategy and content into Sales Enablement, Partner Enablement, Dev Enablement, Customer Success, and Professional Services programs.
  • Influence the business: Bring customer signal into product, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and GTM decisions.
  • Build champions: Deliver key sessions yourself while developing field and partner leaders who can scale the message.
  • Measure impact: Track whether the work improves readiness, win rates, deployment speed, adoption, and expansion.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in product marketing, GTM strategy, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services for a technical B2B product. Security or identity experience is a plus.
  • Domain expertise: Strong expertise in messaging, positioning, personas, and competitive strategy, grounded in customer experience.
  • Field experience: Experience driving readiness across both pre-sales and post-sales technical audiences.
  • Technical acumen: Enough technical depth to learn quickly and explain complex concepts clearly—from the agent identity story to MCP, Cross App Access, and enterprise AI deployment.
  • Customer centricity: Experience working directly with customers and deployment teams and turning real-world problems into scalable solutions.
  • Cross-functional influence: A track record of influencing teams you don't own and getting your work adopted across an organization.
  • Communication: Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to adapt to sellers, engineers, consultants, executives, and customers.
  • Prioritization: Strong judgment and prioritization—you know what to build, what to reuse, and when to push back.
  • Agility: Comfort operating in an early, rapidly changing market where products, pricing, competitors, and customer needs evolve quickly.
  • Travel requirements: Willingness to travel for customer engagements, field events, QBRs, and partner sessions.

Bring all the passion and dedication along and there’s no telling what you could accomplish!
