Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box, we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Engineering Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join Okta's Emerging Products Group (EPG). Our mission is to build highly reliable, scalable, and secure cloud services that our customers can trust. We embrace an automation-first mindset and continuously invest in platform engineering, observability, and operational excellence to enable our engineering teams to move quickly and safely.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges at scale, building automation, and improving the reliability of production systems. You will serve as a key contributor within the EPG SRE organization, partnering closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, build, and operate world-class cloud services.

The ideal candidate exemplifies the philosophy of "if you have to do it more than once, automate it" and possesses a strong passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and software engineering.

What You'll Be Doing

Reliability & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale cloud infrastructure and production services.
  • Participate in a global on-call rotation supporting highly available customer-facing systems.
  • Participate in incident response efforts and drive post-incident reviews focused on systemic improvements.
  • Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve service availability, scalability, performance, and resilience.
  • Ensure all infrastructure and operational practices adhere to strict FedRAMP compliance and security mandates, maintaining continuous audit readiness.
  • Continuously improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

Engineering & Automation

  • Develop software, automation, and infrastructure using Go, Python, Terraform, and related technologies.
  • Eliminate operational toil through automation, tooling, and platform engineering.
  • Improve deployment safety and operational workflows through CI/CD and GitOps practices.
  • Collaborate on modernizing existing workloads and aligning them with evolving platform capabilities.
  • Build self-service platforms, operational guardrails, and automation that improve developer velocity while maintaining reliability and security.

Collaboration & Technical Contribution

  • Support complex reliability initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams.
  • Guide engineers in adopting operational best practices and reliability engineering principles.
  • Collaborate, mentor, and assist junior and mid-level engineers on the team, providing code reviews, operational guidance, and promoting best practices.
  • Participate in architecture design and operational decisions through data-driven recommendations and engineering expertise.
  • Drive projects from conception through production rollout and long-term operational ownership.

Innovation

  • Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering techniques to improve operational efficiency, incident response, troubleshooting, and automation.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to reduce toil and improve engineering productivity.

Our Tech Stack

  • Infrastructure/Orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, Helm, Git, ArgoCD, GitOps
  • Programming: Golang, Python, Rust
  • Observability: Datadog, Splunk, Graphana
  • Data Stores: PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, Snowflake

What We Are Looking For

Technical Excellence

  • Strong experience operating large-scale production services in AWS and/or GCP.
  • Deep expertise with Linux and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes networking, storage, scheduling, scaling, and workload lifecycle issues.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and Helm.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Golang and/or Python.
  • Experience building automation and internal engineering platforms.
  • Experience operating and troubleshooting distributed data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, ingress, TLS, service networking, and traffic management.
  • Experience with observability platforms, monitoring strategies, and production telemetry.
  • Experience with or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering and operational automation.

Operational Excellence

  • Strong expertise operating customer-facing production systems subject to SLA
  • Experience leading incident response and driving operational improvements.
  • Deep understanding of reliability engineering concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and automation-first operational practices.
  • Proven ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, and engineering velocity.

Federal Eligibility Requirements

  • This role supports US FedRAMP projects and requires the employee to be a US Person (US Citizen or Green Card Holder) to meet FedRAMP compliance and security clearance standards.

Security & Compliance

  • Understanding of cloud security fundamentals, IAM, secrets management, and secure infrastructure design.
  • Experience implementing operational controls, compliance standards (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC2, HIPAA), and best practices in highly regulated or security-sensitive government cloud environments is highly preferred.

Leadership

  • Demonstrated success contributing to complex engineering initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Experience working effectively within globally distributed engineering organizations spanning multiple timezones and cultures.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and contributing to technical capabilities within an organization.
  • Ability to influence technical direction through expertise, partnership, and execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating SaaS platforms serving large-scale customer workloads.
  • Experience working within Kubernetes-based microservices environments.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed production environments.
  • Experience with GitOps and ArgoCD.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted operational tooling or automation workflows.

title: Director, M&A People Strategy & Integration
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Director, M&A People Strategy & Integration to lead the human capital lifecycle for our deal pipeline. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will design and execute due diligence and post-merger integration strategies centered on talent, organizational design, compensation, and cultural alignment.

You will serve as the primary human resources quarterback during transactions, partnering closely with internal People team functional leads (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, People Operations) and collaborating with Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and IT to ensure seamless operational continuity, compliance, and employee experience from announcement through post-close integration.

Key Responsibilities

People Due Diligence & Risk Assessment

  • Diligence Execution: Lead HR and talent due diligence across target organizations, analyzing organizational structures, total rewards programs, workforce demographics, employment contracts, and labor compliance risks.
  • Talent & Cultural Assessment: Evaluate key talent retention risks, leadership team capabilities, organizational design, critical skills gaps, and cultural alignment to inform valuation, deal terms, and integration strategies.
  • Cost & Synergy Modeling: Partner with Finance to analyze workforce cost structures, including compensation, benefits, harmonization costs, retention packages, severance exposure, and synergy targets.

Cross-Functional Integration Planning & Execution

  • Integration Playbook & Strategy: Build and maintain scalable People M&A playbooks, defining key deliverables across HR, Legal, Finance, and IT for Day 1 readiness and First 100 Days goals.
  • Legal & Compliance Alignment: Partner with Legal to manage employment contract transfers, equity roll-overs, restrictive covenants, immigration/visa transfers, works council/labor relations requirements, and employment law compliance.
  • People Ops & Systems Transition (with TD&I & Finance): Collaborate with TD&I and People Ops to manage HR Information System (HRIS) migrations, identity/access management transitions, payroll cutovers, and benefit vendor consolidations.
  • Total Rewards Harmonization: Partner with Total Rewards to design side-by-side benefit maps, compensation alignment structures, equity conversions, and stay/retention bonus programs for acquired employees.

Employee Experience & Change Management

  • Change & Communications: Partner with Internal Comms and Legal to design Day 1 announcement communications, offer letter rollouts, onboarding experiences, and executive town halls.
  • Retention Strategy: Track, monitor, and support key talent post-close, driving initiatives that preserve company culture and minimize unwanted attrition.

Stretch Opportunities & Total Rewards Impact: M&A activity naturally ebbs and flows. During lower deal volume periods, you will drive and project-manage strategic, high-visibility initiatives across the broader Total Rewards organization. 

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 7–10+ years in M&A HR and Talent strategy, People Integration, or M&A Human Capital consulting (Big 4 / strategic advisory), with end-to-end deal lifecycle management.
  • Cross-Functional Expertise: Proven ability to drive joint workstreams with Legal, Finance/Payroll, IT, and HR functional leads without direct line management authority.
  • Technical HR Acumen: Strong fluency in global/domestic employment law fundamentals, compensation/benefits harmonization, equity compensation, and HRIS systems migrations.
  • Data-Driven Analysis: Solid skills in workforce data modeling, salary/benefit side-by-side mapping, and workforce financial synthesis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related field; Master's or SPHR/SHRM-SCP certification preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Adept at aligning disparate stakeholder priorities across Legal, Finance, IT, and HR teams toward tight deal deadlines.
  • Proactive "Driver" Skillset: High-agency operator with a strong bias for action; proven ability to take full ownership of deal outcomes, push cross-functional workstreams forward, hold partners accountable to tight deal timelines, and solve complex roadblocks with urgency. 
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to bring structure, playbooks, and clarity to ambiguous, rapidly moving transaction environments.
  • Empathy & Discretion: High emotional intelligence, discretion, and tact when handling sensitive employee information and high-stress organizational changes.

You will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior Category Managers and serve as an escalation point for Tactical Sourcing on technology-related matters.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and collaborative individual who works well in a fast-paced environment and can operate with a high degree of autonomy. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology.

Gather business and technical requirements to produce documentation supporting RFx events, and develop internal presentations and business cases to secure management approval for multi-year supplier agreements.
  • Sourcing & Project Management: Lead and support all aspects of the strategic sourcing process end-to-end — RFx events, supplier evaluations, and day-to-day commercial contract negotiations — for the most complex, high-value technology sourcing initiatives.

Identify and mitigate both internal and external risks associated with technology purchase transactions. 
  • Stakeholder Partnership:  Build effective, strategic relationships with senior business stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy) to align sourcing initiatives with business requirements, ensuring policies and procedures are followed and met. 
  • Supplier Relaitonship Management:  Own the relationship strategy for Okta's most strategic or highest-spend Technology suppliers. Drive supplier performance review meetings and serve as the escalation point when supplier issues or negotiations exceed what P3 Category Managers can resolve independently.

title: Staff Product Security Engineer, Offensive Security
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Staff Product Security Engineer, Offensive Security Team

The Offensive Security Team, part of Product Security, actively assesses the security of Okta's products, services, and infrastructure, and we are seeking a highly technical and driven staff-level engineer to contribute to this effort. This role demands more than running vulnerability scans. Excelling here requires a thorough understanding of offensive security testing and a strong drive to identify and leverage security weaknesses. Above all, the most critical attribute of this role is an innate ability to think and operate as a sophisticated adversary. This skill is key to solving security challenges, drawing on deep technical expertise and creativity.

The ideal candidate will possess demonstrable expertise in the following areas:

  • Application & Network Security: Solid understanding of application security principles, common vulnerabilities, backend/middleware testing, and network penetration testing methodologies.

Identity Security: Experience testing identity and access management systems, including authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC, and their associated attack surfaces.

  • AI/LLM Security: Experience assessing the security of systems that integrate large language models and AI-driven automation, including supply-chain risks in model pipelines. Ability to develop novel attack techniques against AI-augmented products and evaluate guardrail effectiveness.
  • Automation & Offensive Tooling: A track record of building maintainable, repeatable Offensive Security tools that accelerate security assessments, automate vulnerability discovery, and integrate with existing workflows.
  • Operating Systems: Thorough familiarity with Linux and macOS operating systems, including their security features, command-line tools, and common attack surfaces.
  • Cloud Security: Understanding of cloud security architecture and common attack vectors. Experience with GCP is required, and depth in AWS or Azure is also welcomed.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Experience with infrastructure tooling such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, and ArgoCD, and an understanding of how they shape the operational environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly and concisely articulate vulnerabilities and remediation strategies to technical and non-technical audiences. 

We actively encourage and support the external publication of impactful security research and findings through papers, blog posts, and presentations at industry conferences.

What You Will Do

  • Apply an attacker mindset to identify, plan, and exploit complex security gaps across app, cloud, and network layers.
  • Conduct targeted security assessments and pentests; deliver actionable findings, detailed exploit recreation, and architectural remediation guidance.
  • Assess the security of AI/LLM-integrated features and agent-based workflows, develop novel attack techniques, and evaluate defensive controls.
  • Design, build, and maintain offensive automation frameworks that scale security coverage from custom fuzzers and scanners to pipeline-integrated validation tools.
  • Act as a security SME across internal teams and represent Okta in internal and external forums when appropriate.
  • Periodically triage internal vulnerability tickets and external bug bounty submissions.

What You Bring

  • Demonstrable experience in penetration testing web applications, related infrastructure, and networks (5+ years preferred)
  • Extensive experience testing identity/IAM platforms, multi-tenant SaaS architectures, or authentication/authorization systems
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks and experience or strong interest in developing offensive techniques against AI-integrated systems
  • Track record of building and shipping offensive security tooling beyond ad-hoc scripts
  • Experience in operating within and securing cloud environments (GCP required)
  • Familiarity with Threat Modeling concepts and frameworks
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) for building and testing environments
  • Solid understanding of modern cryptographic principles and their application

We are looking for a dedicated Events and Experiences Designer to bring this system to life, translating complex identity and security concepts into high-impact, physical environments and branded spaces.

About the role

As an Events & Experiences Designer, you will be a vital, hands-on creative maker driving Okta’s physical presence across our global event calendar. You will partner closely with art directors, creative leads, and event marketing partners to concept, build, and produce work across our flagship owned moments (such as Oktane and Showcase) as well as our high-velocity third-party and field activations (including AWS re:Invent, RSA Conference, Gartner Symposiums, and Executive Briefing summits).

This role is built for a craft-obsessed practitioner who thrives in the full arc of event creative—from spatial ideation and environmental typography to the rigorous, meticulous prepress work required to ship flawless, fabrication-ready files on tight deadlines.

What you'll be doing

  • Concept & Spatial Execution: Translate creative briefs into compelling physical and environmental activations—designing large-format booth graphics, spatial layouts, entrance structures, dimensional signage, and interactive demo zones.
  • End-to-End Production Ownership: Take full ownership of production deliverables. Prepare flawless, press-ready, and fabrication-ready art files tailored to precise vendor specifications, architectural scale, and material substrates.
  • Scale the Experiential System: Actively implement and evolve Okta’s experiential design system and modular "kit of parts," ensuring consistency, premium craft, and brand recognition across all event tiers.
  • Multi-Track Project Management: Autonomously drive several concurrent projects across different stages of the event lifecycle (e.g., concepting one activation, producing another, and prepping print proofs for a third) with high accuracy and composure.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Partnership: Collaborate directly with Event Marketing, Field Marketing, and external fabrication partners (printers, booth builders, and staging agencies) to ensure design intent translates seamlessly into built environments.
  • Brand Quality Assurance: Conduct prepress proof reviews, oversee physical print approvals, and safeguard creative excellence across all physical touchpoints.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Demonstrated Experience: 4+ years of dedicated professional experience in experiential design, spatial/environmental graphic design, or event production within an in-house creative team or top-tier branding/experiential agency.
  • Deep Production Fluency (Required): Proven, hands-on expertise preparing large-format print and environmental graphics for physical builds (tension fabric/SEG, hardwall structures, vinyl wraps, dimensional lettering, and acrylics). You understand bleeds, resolutions at architectural scale, color management (CMYK, Pantone matching), and vendor handoff specs.
  • High-Craft Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing shipped, physical event environments and environmental graphics that demonstrate elevated typography, spatial hierarchy, and production fidelity (photographs of built environments and technical specs preferred alongside 2D/3D visualizations).
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level fluency with Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
  • Autonomy & Technical Problem Solving: Demonstrated track record of managing overlapping timelines, navigating ambiguous project requirements, and proactively resolving real-world fabrication challenges.
  • Collaborative Conviction: Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate design rationale, incorporate stakeholder feedback thoughtfully, and maintain high standards of visual excellence.

Extra points if you have

  • Working knowledge of 3D spatial software or spatial visualization tools (SketchUp, Cinema 4D, Blender, or Vectorworks).
  • Experience localizing creative for international regional series (EMEA and APJ markets).
  • Direct experience communicating with fabrication shops and conducting on-site print/install inspections.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Staff: Lead a domain such as harnesses, evaluations or model quality across workers and implement its critical components.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

title: Regional Alliances Manager - Distribution & Emerging Partners (ANZ)
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box. We're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Partner and Alliances Team

This role is a critical part of Okta's ANZ Partners and Alliances team. The team owns relationships and business development with Okta's partners in ANZ and is a significant contributor to the region's growth, with partner-sourced and partner-influenced business a core measure of its success. Okta's ANZ go-to-market is "Partner First", and this team is central to executing it.

The Role

The Regional Alliances Manager - Distribution & Emerging Partners is the strategic catalyst for growing Okta's distribution channel and a new network of emerging partners across Australia and New Zealand. You will own Okta's distribution relationships in ANZ and build a new segment of emerging partners: boutique enterprise consultancies, digital transformation firms and AI builders.

About 80% of your focus is distribution. The other 20% is bringing emerging partners into Okta's partner program and helping them mature, using distribution to scale that motion. You will craft and run joint go-to-market plans that create partner-sourced pipeline, accelerate subscription revenue and drive regional expansion, with the operating discipline to make it repeatable.

You will report to the Director of Partners & Alliances, ANZ. 

What You'll Achieve (Desired Role Outcomes)

  • Develop and execute annual and quarterly joint business plans (JBPs) that accelerate customer acquisition, platform adoption and revenue across ANZ.
  • Own forecasting, pipeline development and revenue targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced business through distribution and emerging partners.
  • Give our Commercial sales team scale in ANZ through distributors and partners.
  • Onboard and enable 6 new emerging partners within 12 months, and move each along the program's maturity path: certified sales, pre-sales and delivery staff; first registered deal; first closed deal; repeatable pipeline.
  • Give Okta and partners clarity on our Routes to Market (Distribution, Cloud Marketplaces and Direct) and what they mean for each stakeholder.

What You'll Be Doing

Distribution (primary focus, about 80%)

  • Own annual and quarterly JBPs with ANZ distribution partners, translating revenue targets into co-sell initiatives, enablement tracks and clear milestones.
  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline growth and keep forecast discipline in Salesforce/PRM, including a healthy pipeline coverage model across co-sell and resell channels.
  • Run a lightweight governance rhythm: a monthly operations review (revenue pace, MDF, order-to-cash) and quarterly executive QBRs measuring performance against JBP commitments. Deal-desk and quote-to-cash processes are owned by Deal Desk and Sales Operations; you partner with them to keep deals moving.
  • Work with distributors to manage the full partner lifecycle and drive measurable, incremental revenue.
  • Lift distribution-managed partner capability in the market, measured by certification growth across sales, pre-sales and delivery.
  • Be the escalation point for deals worked by distributor-led partners and remove roadblocks across Okta Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance and Legal.
  • Manage Market Development Funds (MDF) to maximise pipeline return, using pre-approved business cases and post-campaign ROI reviews.

Emerging partners (about 20%)

  • Identify, recruit and onboard boutique consultancies, solution providers, SIs, transformation firms and AI builders who are building identity and access management into modern AI architectures and cloud stacks.
  • Run a structured 30-60-90 day onboarding playbook covering contract, partner portal, sales enablement and initial co-sell pipeline.
  • Build a joint plan with each partner covering enablement, certification targets, account planning and first-deal support.
  • Embed new partners in Okta's partner program, progressing tier accreditation and certification.
  • Work with distributors to transact, support and scale these partners.
  • Track each partner's maturity and report on pipeline, certifications and revenue.

Across both

  • Build a deep understanding of your top 15 partners and articulate their value proposition, internally and externally.
  • Drive field collaboration between Okta Account Executives and partner sellers and distributor sales desks to increase pipeline creation, customer wins and successful deployments, and to avoid channel conflict.
  • Work with Okta Partner Enablement to deliver sales, pre-sales and technical certification tracks to distributor teams and priority emerging partners.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support partner-led customer engagements and remove blockers to execution.
  • Have fun. You'll spend time on-site with distributors and partners and at industry events.

What You'll Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience working with distributors and cybersecurity partners in ANZ.
  • Proven success using partners to drive sourced pipeline and revenue for a vendor.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong prioritisation and organisation, juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Influence without authority across Sales, Presales, Marketing and Delivery.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Extra credit if you have:

  • Understanding of the Cyber, AI and Digital Transformation ecosystem, including how different partner types (distributors, consultancies, transformation firms, AI builders) create and win business.
  • Existing relationships with boutique/transformation consultancies or AI partners in ANZ.
  • Established relationships with ANZ distribution specially in the New Zealand market.
  • A background in the Security and/or Identity market in ANZ (desirable).
  • Experience using AIto improve forecasting, partner planning or reporting.

descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Opportunity

Okta is looking for an entrepreneurial, data-driven Nonprofit GTM Strategy Manager to join our team. At Okta, we are building a world where anyone can safely use any technology. Mission-driven organizations, from global NGOs to local community services, are among the most targeted sectors for cyberattacks today, yet they often operate with severe resource constraints.

In this cross-functional role, you will be both a strategist and executor for our global nonprofit segment. You will drive revenue, impact, and customer growth targets for the segment and share responsibility for its performance and long-term health. You will analyze segment metrics to diagnose what's working, partner with customers to pressure-test our go-to-market (GTM) positioning, and lead the work to fix what isn't. Your analytical skills and proven wins with nonprofit customers will shape how we grow.

You will enable GTM leadership and maintain ongoing feedback loops with field sales teams. You will align and mobilize senior stakeholders, both internal and customer-facing, around shared business objectives. By connecting historical success data with active market opportunities, you will make sure our field resources are used well and that Okta's nonprofit initiatives translate into scalable market expansion. Your work will grow Okta's addressable market while helping secure the organizations that provide critical services around the world.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Accelerate Nonprofit Segment Growth: Grow Okta's existing nonprofit go-to-market (GTM) motion. Design, launch, and manage targeted sales plays, specialized programs, field events, and market initiatives that turn our overall strategy into active market expansion.
  • Drive Segment Performance and Long-Term Health: Drive the performance of the global nonprofit segment across the full lifecycle, including pipeline creation, deal velocity, customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Work across the GTM organization to diagnose trends, remove friction, and rally stakeholders around growth initiatives.
  • Embed with GTM Leadership: Work closely with GTM teams to make the nonprofit business a core part of the planning, cadence, and execution of the broader GTM organization. Use segment performance data and peer benchmarks to continuously improve and champion Okta's nonprofit vertical strategy.
  • Support Field Enablement: Build consistent feedback loops with Field and Sales Enablement teams to remove obstacles, refine messaging, and help them win and grow nonprofit deals. Work directly with Account Executives (AEs) and sales development representatives (xDRs) to capture insights from the field and turn winning approaches into scalable GTM motions and playbooks.
  • Sharpen Market Focus and Positioning: Analyze historical wins and market dynamics to find where Okta competes most effectively. Identify high-growth nonprofit sub-segments, map the buying journeys, purchase triggers, and compliance requirements of target verticals, and direct GTM investment toward the opportunities where we are best positioned to win.
  • Measure Social Impact Alongside Growth: Keep Okta's social impact commitment measurable, not just stated. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to track the impact and value of donated and discounted licenses alongside revenue and pipeline. Use these results to make pragmatic decisions about where donated licenses create the most impact.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS GTM strategy, sales enablement, growth operations, customer success, or a vertical-specific sales overlay role, preferably within identity, cybersecurity, or cloud.
  • A proven track record of program ownership. You build a program strategy, gather feedback, refine the approach, and execute with minimal oversight.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. You apply deep professional knowledge and company objectives to design and resolve complex operational models.
  • Exceptional persuasion and communication skills. You align and mobilize senior cross-functional and external stakeholders around shared business targets.
  • Strong data and analytical skills. You have hands-on experience tracking pipeline health, sales velocity, and conversion metrics in Salesforce or Tableau.
  • Resource and project management experience. You are comfortable defining program requirements, managing budgets, and directing external partners.
  • Proven wins with nonprofit customers. Experience in the nonprofit tech ecosystem, cybersecurity, or SLED/Public Sector GTM is a strong plus.

Get to know OktaOkta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Auth0 and Okta Platforms enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box, we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Okta Technical Account Management Team

The TAM team empowers Okta customers to deliver secure, scalable, and transformative identity solutions by acting as their trusted identity coach. We drive lasting success through elevated technical maturity, proactively guiding their identity decisions and long-term identity vision. We guide a customer’s strategy for customer identity, workforce identity, and security posture while driving value in Okta’s suite of products and, ultimately, retention at contract renewal.

The Auth0 Technical Account Manager Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical expert to join the TAM team. This role specialises in the Auth0 platform, which is an easy-to-implement, adaptable authentication and authorization platform for Consumer and SaaS applications. Basically, we make your login experience awesome. You will be working with a portfolio of well-known brands on their Auth0 implementations as an identity coach. Building close relationships with technical stakeholders from early in the customer lifecycle, you will learn their business, goals, challenges and technical landscape, ensuring Okta delivers on a long-term strategic plan to help solve these challenges and realize the value of their Auth0 platform investment, while continuing to evolve to solve new objectives and improve security posture.

The ideal candidate for this role is competent with both technical delivery and customer business-facing engagement, preferably with experience in identity and security. They showcase both interest and adaptability to Identity, SDLC, and SaaS discussions, including agility in unpredictable customer interactions, with technical accuracy top of mind.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Serve as a trusted Identity Coach, guiding customers to achieve their objectives through timely technical guidance, advice, enablement, and best practice sharing
  • Learn our customers’ business deeply, gaining deep insights into their strategies, goals, and challenges - through the lens of identity
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with stakeholder personas from developers, engineering leads, app builders, and product owners, through to C-level exec, evolving customers into Auth0 champions
  • Conduct regular customer meetings with executives to recap past value, show progress on current initiatives and future state or roadmap items
  • Conduct regular customer meetings with technical practitioners on identity solutions, technical guidance and best practices
  • Monitor customer health, satisfaction, and engagement, proactively addressing risks and escalations
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to develop strategies to increase customer adoption, and uncover growth opportunities that will solidify Auth0 for the entirety of customer identity
  • Analyze trends, identify areas for improvement, and take action to optimize customer outcomes
  • Act as a product evangelist, educating customers on new features and alignment of roadmaps to enhance their experience
  • Represent the voice of the customer, ensuring their needs and feedback shape the company’s approach

  • Fluent in French and comfortable communicating with French-speaking customers and stakeholders.
  • Working proficiency in the following core CIAM areas or technical competencies: 
    • Technologies and protocols to support authentication and authorization (OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2.0)
    • Consuming APIs and HTTP request methods
    • High-level understanding of custom consumer and SaaS apps both web and native, including their architecture, user experience considerations, and common integration patterns
    • Security and performance monitoring, and 3rd party signals integrations (SIEM, WAF, etc)
    • Understanding of the general cybersecurity landscape with respect to threats and challenges
    • Experience with SaaS/PaaS/cloud-based services, driving their adoption, integration, and ongoing use
    • Understanding of software development lifecycle and application builder practices
  • A customer-first mindset with the energy and problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and achieve customers' business and technical objectives
  • Strong business acumen, history of success owning enterprise segment customer relationships and escalations
  • Ability to track and manage the moving parts of multiple parallel initiatives or projects
  • Strong presentation and whiteboarding/diagram skills
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to set expectations, and communicate goals and objectives with customers at various levels, from a developer to C-level exec
  • Ability to influence customer behaviour & health metrics across a portfolio of customers

  • Demonstrable experience architecting distributed systems and making complex technical tradeoffs (e.g., consistency vs. availability, build vs. buy).
  • Deliver work incrementally, and bring strong operational experience leading incident response, driving RCAs, and implementing preventative measures.
  • Experiment with AI models, exploring the capabilities of different effort levels and context. 
  • Are comfortable working on a fully-distributed (remote) team.

Extra Points:

  • Experience with Redis, Kafka and/or PostgreSQL at scale.

title: Senior Director, R&D Planning & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We are looking for a seasoned operations leader to run the financial and workforce operating engine for Okta's Product & Technology organization — a 2,000+ person R&D function spanning the Okta Platform (ORD) and Auth0. The team is accountable for the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, program spend and budget governance, financial compliance including Capitalized Software and R&D tax credit capture, vendor operations, and headcount governance in partnership with Recruiting. The team also runs the annual goal-setting process and the operating cadence that tracks R&D performance against those goals. This is a role that demands real depth in engineering finance operations alongside the organizational judgment to translate executive strategy into a defensible budget and a credible hiring plan.

This role sits within Okta's R&D ("ORD") organization, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Operations and Chief of Staff to the President of Okta R&D. This role is hub-based: it sits in San Francisco, Seattle or Chicago, and candidates must live within commutable distance of one of those offices. We expect this leader to work from the office multiple days each week.

Job Duties / What This Role Entails

  • Own the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, translating corporate strategy and the long-range plan into a fully resourced annual plan across ORD and Auth0.
  • Direct R&D budget governance for a 2,000+ person organization — program spend oversight, variance reporting, fiscal discipline, and executive-level budget reviews with the President of Okta R&D and Finance leadership.
  • Own and evolve the P&L framework for R&D lines of business, arming executive leadership with the cost and investment data behind portfolio decisions.
  • Model, govern and optimize AI token spend across the P&T organization — establish the cost baseline and forecasting model, build the framework for measuring return on that spend, and partner with engineering leaders to drive efficiency as consumption scales.
  • Lead engineering cost modeling, and partner with FP&A and Deal Desk on account-specific margin analysis to support pricing, packaging and large-deal decisions.
  • Own financial compliance for R&D, including Capitalized Software entries and maximizing US/Canada R&D tax credit capture.
  • Build and own the P&T expense data platform on Snowflake to enable clean line-of-business cost distribution and self-service cost visibility for engineering leaders.
  • Set the fiscal year workforce strategy in partnership with Recruiting leadership — headcount governance, real-time allocation tracking, backfills, organizational growth mapping, and location strategy.
  • Own the contingent workforce program end to end, including contractor and agency lifecycle, capacity and spend.
  • Own vendor operations for R&D — third-party relationships, capacity management, contract renewals, and performance SLAs.
  • Continuously refine the financial and workforce operating processes to eliminate friction and ensure the organization scales efficiently as it grows.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to develop the fiscal year goals and OKRs for the R&D organization, and run the program cadence — monthly and quarterly reviews — that gauges performance against them.
  • Set the standard for AI-first operations — apply AI to financial analysis, dashboard generation and workflow automation, and build a team for which AI fluency is core to how the work gets done rather than an experiment on the side.
  • Build, mentor and develop the operations team as a source of durable advantage for Okta R&D, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.

This is a team leadership role with five direct reports.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Must Have)

  • 12+ years of work experience, including 6+ years leading business operations, R&D / engineering operations, or FP&A functions within a technology company.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an engineering or R&D budget at scale — annual planning, in-year governance, variance management, and executive budget review.
  • Proven ownership of workforce planning and headcount governance in close partnership with Recruiting and Finance.
  • Experience managing a vendor portfolio, including contract negotiation and renewal, SLA management, and capacity planning.
  • Hands-on experience with Capitalized Software accounting and R&D tax credit programs in the US and/or Canada.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models and engineering cost structures.
  • Track record of building and developing high-performing operations teams, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.
  • Extensive experience navigating complex data sets and operating with ambiguity, where clean data is not available.
  • Demonstrated use of AI to do the substance of finance and operations work — analysis, reporting, dashboard generation and workflow automation — with a clear point of view on where to apply it next.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Good to Have)

  • Experience operating across multiple product units or post-acquisition entities with distinct financial and operational systems.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, or comparable experience building financial data platforms and self-service reporting.
  • Experience modeling or governing consumption-based spend, such as cloud infrastructure or AI / LLM token usage.
  • Experience with global workforce and location strategy, including India-based engineering centers.
  • Understanding of the B2B enterprise technology space, specifically Enterprise Security.
  • Experience running an annual goal-setting or OKR process for a technology organization, including the review cadence that tracks progress against it.
  • Prior experience in FP&A, management consulting, or a central strategy and operations function.
  • MBA, or an undergraduate degree with a concentration in Finance, Economics, Statistics or Engineering.

Why this role?

  • Own the full financial and workforce operating infrastructure for a 2,000+ person R&D organization at a category-defining security company.
  • Rare breadth of charter: FinOps, workforce operations and vendor operations, across an at scale SaaS R&D organization.
  • A genuinely new problem to own: defining how a 2,000+ person R&D organization budgets for, measures the return on, and optimizes its AI spend.
  • Direct line of sight into executive decision making — your models and plans are the basis on which R&D investment is allocated.
  • High degree of autonomy to shape the R&D operating model rather than inherit it.
  • Strong executive sponsorship from Okta's product and engineering leadership team.

Additional requirements:

  • There is no citizenship requirement. The Okta employee must be on US Soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101

The Okta Android platform team is responsible for building Okta's Android Apps and SDKs. Okta Verify is a mobile app that allows users to securely access their apps via 2-step verification, ensuring that they, and only they, can access their app accounts. It integrates deeply with Android system features, communicating with our backend to grant proper application access across a wide variety of Android devices.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Android platform team. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining Okta Verify and associated SDKs across the Android ecosystem (phones, tablets, and wearable devices). 

In this role, you will report to the Manager, Quality Assurance and be responsible for robust, secure releases and test automation of the Okta Verify application and SDKs on the Android platform. You will also be responsible for developing test scripts, building and expanding the test automation framework, and working collaboratively with application developers to execute tests, log, track, and validate test results.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Define and own the Android test automation strategy and framework architecture for Okta Verify and its SDKs.
  • Mentor and technically guide engineers across quality and development teams; write and review designs and code in Java/Kotlin with colleagues of varying seniority.
  • Establish and drive quality metrics, including test coverage, flakiness rates, and CI pipeline health, holding teams accountable to targets.
  • Partner with Security to define and execute security and privacy test coverage for Android authentication flows.
  • Represent quality in architecture and design reviews for new Okta Verify app and SDK features.
  • Define and communicate quality plans for the Android platform and dependency scrum teams.

Testing and Automation

  • Design and build structured test automation frameworks using Espresso, UI Automator, and Jetpack Compose testing tools using Kotlin.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality functional, regression, performance, and end-to-end tests for Okta Verify across diverse Android form factors and OS versions.
  • Validate bug fixes and recommend product improvements across Android OS versions to ensure seamless user experiences for major and minor Android/Google operating system updates.
  • Leverage CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions), cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Sauce Labs, BrowserStack), JIRA, XRay, and ADB tools to identify and raise quality issues with development teams in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with product management, software development, and cross-functional teams using JIRA and Confluence to define test plans grounded in business requirements and application software designs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of software test automation experience for Android mobile applications, with 3+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining Android UI test automation frameworks.
  • Proficiency in developing Android test tools and scripts using Kotlin and Java.
  • Experience defining test strategy at a platform or product-area level, leading release testing, and managing complex product issues.
  • Experience building and maintaining Mobile CI/CD pipelines (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Bitrise).
  • Hands-on experience with core Android testing tools and frameworks (Espresso, UI Automator, JUnit, AndroidX Test).
  • Experience with collaboration and test management tools like JIRA, Confluence, and XRay.
  • Experience with scripting languages like Python, Bash/Shell, etc.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Android security and hardware-backed features (Android Keystore system, StrongBox, BiometricPrompt API, TEE).
  • Experience with cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Bitbar, BrowserStack, Firebase Test Lab).
  • Experience testing Jetpack Compose UI elements.

Education

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields preferred.

title: Senior Technical Consultant, Okta
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

COMPANY DESCRIPTION:       

Okta is the foundation for secure connections between people and technology. By harnessing the power of the cloud, Okta allows people to access applications on any device at any time, while allowing for strong security protection. The Okta service integrates directly with an organization’s existing directories and identity systems, as well as 6,500+ applications.

Because Okta runs on an integrated platform, organizations can implement Okta quickly at large scale and low total cost.

Thousands of customers, including Adobe, Allergan, Chiquita, LinkedIn, and Western Union, trust Okta to help their organizations work faster, boost revenue, and stay secure.

To learn more about Okta, visit https://www.okta.com. 

JOB PURPOSE:

In this role, you will be tasked with providing hands-on implementation and deployment services to our customers. We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and hands-on leader who can rapidly learn the Okta platform, our technology and the value proposition that we bring to customers of all sizes. You will lead multiple concurrent customer deployment projects with the number one goal to ensure long-term customer success. Additionally you will engage with the full Customer Success team in order to assure a smooth transition post-deployment to the support/maintenance phases. Finally, you will also be responsible for the continuous improvement of delivery processes and methods.

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Work hands on with Okta customers, primarily in a post-sales role, to provide innovative consulting services.
  • Gather, analyze, and document post-sales requirements.
  • Communicate to customers and partners at the technical and/or functional level appropriate for the situation.
  • Be dedicated to providing excellent design and deployment solutions resulting in extraordinary customer satisfaction.
  • Be prompt and deliver high quality service and leadership to align with customer goals and requests.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, status, and documentation.
  • Mentor and train customers on the service.
  • Act as a liaison between Customers and Product Management to drive product development.
  • Lead interaction and collaboration with other Okta teams such as Engineering and Support as needed to address escalated issues.
  • Interact with management and other roles within the customer organization and Okta.
  • Collaborate with the sales team on existing customers up-sell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Perform hands on technical design, configuration, and troubleshooting of the Okta service.
  • Shape and Influence Okta’s growth and scalability, by designing new offerings, and finding new ways to deliver amazing customer satisfaction.
  • Manage multiple concurrent deployment projects.
  • Apply knowledge of technologies and protocols to support identity federation and robust access control models, such as SAML 2.0, WS-Federation, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.
  • While providing customer service, apply knowledge of cloud architectures as well as complex enterprise on-premise IT landscapes.
  • Apply software development experience (Java, Ruby, .Net, PHP, REST/JSON, etc) when working with customers.
  • Utilize knowledge of typical enterprise identity life cycle management processes and standards.
  • Apply experience with JavaScript and one of the major JavaScript MVC frameworks (Backbone, Angular, Ember, React, etc.) when working on customer integrations.
  • May provide mentoring, guidance, and expertise to less experienced team members.
  • Ensure quality and time management processes are followed by team (e.g., change controls, time tracking).
  • Commit to and use a knowledge repository for deployment standard methodologies and other customer ideas as continuous improvement.
  • Up to 50% future travel required to customer sites. 

Minimum REQUIRED Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • 5-7 years experience as a technical consultant delivering solutions to external customers.
  • Experience with technologies and protocols to support identity federation and robust access control models (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, WS-Federation).
  • Software development experience (Java, Ruby, .Net, PHP, REST/JSON, etc).
  • Some knowledge of enterprise web technologies, security and cutting-edge infrastructures.
  • Experience with JavaScript and one of the major JavaScript MVC frameworks (Backbone, Angular, Ember, React, etc.)
  • Ability to work independently and multi-functionally supporting the development of client work you're doing.
  • Knowledge of typical enterprise identity life cycle management processes and standards.
  • Ability to Multi-task and manage multiple customer engagements is a requirement.
  • Able and willing to be a hands-on contributor
  • Superb communication skills, including issue tracking, triaging and crisis management.
  • Experience in Process Improvement, Decision-making, Managing Processes, Planning, Analyzing Information and Developing Standards.
Additional requirements:
  • This position requires the ability to access federal environments and/or have access to protected federal data. As a condition of employment for this position, the successful candidate must be able to submit documentation establishing U.S. Person status (e.g. a U.S. Citizen, National, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee. 22 CFR 120.15) upon hire.
  • Must be available to work onsite at Fort Meade.
  • Must have active Top Secret Clearance.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in designing and implementing security and identity management solutions to support critical systems and business programs
  • Experience in delivering Okta implementations for organizations
  • Mobile development experience preferred (iOS and Android)

Problem Solving:

  • Exhibits confidence and an extensive knowledge of emerging industry practices when solving business problems.
  • Asks probing questions to elicit facts and clarify a situation.
  • Identifies critical issues with ease.
  • Engages appropriate resources to obtain information, seek suggestions and acquire assistance.
  • Pushes creative thinking beyond the boundaries of existing industry practices and customer mindsets.

Communication:

  • Communicates with internal and external customers and all levels of management.
  • Effectively communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Delivers informative, well-organized presentations.
  • Understands how to communicate difficult/sensitive information thoughtfully.
  • Uses active listening skills to figure out and understand the customer's business goals, objectives and priorities.

Team and Customer Interaction:

  • Facilitates effective team interaction.
  • Communicates effectively with customers to identify needs and evaluate alternative technical solutions with customers.
  • Continually seeks opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships.
  • Manages client expectations effectively.

Education:

A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology or related discipline required.

descriptionHtml:

Key Account Director

Role: The Strategist

The Key Account Executive (KAE) is responsible for managing and significantly expanding revenue within our most strategic, high-value accounts across the Americas. This role goes beyond transactional selling, positioning the KAE as a business strategist for the company's most important relationships.
The successful candidate will manage a select portfolio of named, multi-million-dollar accounts and be the primary executive contact for key stakeholders. This role requires proven executive presence and engagement, with an ability to drive demand, navigate highly complex sales cycles, and drive dedicated cross-functional account teams globally to ensure maximum Lifetime Value (LTV) and deliver high customer outcomes.

Results: What You Will Achieve

  • Account Growth: Consistently exceed revenue targets by identifying, qualifying, and closing complex, multi-million dollar expansion opportunities (up-sells and cross-sells) within the assigned portfolio.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year strategic account plans that map executive relationships, solution alignment, and maximizing the long term value for each assigned top account.
  • Sales Process: Accurately forecast revenue and maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities, providing clear visibility into potential revenue and risk to executive leadership.
  • Negotiation: Expertly manage highly complex contract negotiations and renewals, involving internal Legal, Finance, and Procurement teams.
  • Portfolio Leadership: Lead through leveraging our entire product portfolio of offerings (Okta, Auth0 and AI), acting as both visionary and influencer without authority.

Relationships: Who You Will Impact

  • Customer C-Suite: Serve as the primary executive contact and trusted advisor, confidently holding strategic discussions and influencing decisions with the highest-ranking executives (CEO, CFO, CIO).

This role will be responsible for procurement strategy development and execution, conducting strategic sourcing events and negotiating acceptable terms and conditions with Suppliers. The position will perform data analytics and work collaboratively with senior stakeholders and other Strategic Sourcing team members to meet stakeholder supply market requirements, create value, ensure process compliance and drive negotiated cost savings and avoidances.

You will be expected to build relationships with internal business partners working with cross-functional groups to support negotiations, risk mitigation and supplier management.

You will report to the Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology.

title: Senior Director, R&D Planning & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. We are looking for a seasoned operations leader to run the financial and workforce operating engine for Okta's Product & Technology organization — a 2,000+ person R&D function spanning the Okta Platform (ORD) and Auth0. The team is accountable for the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, program spend and budget governance, financial compliance including Capitalized Software and R&D tax credit capture, vendor operations, and headcount governance in partnership with Recruiting. The team also runs the annual goal-setting process and the operating cadence that tracks R&D performance against those goals. This is a role that demands real depth in engineering finance operations alongside the organizational judgment to translate executive strategy into a defensible budget and a credible hiring plan.

This role sits within Okta's R&D ("ORD") organization, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Operations and Chief of Staff to the President of Okta R&D. This role is hub-based: it sits in San Francisco, Seattle or Chicago, and candidates must live within commutable distance of one of those offices. We expect this leader to work from the office multiple days each week.

Job Duties / What This Role Entails

  • Own the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, translating corporate strategy and the long-range plan into a fully resourced annual plan across ORD and Auth0.
  • Direct R&D budget governance for a 2,000+ person organization — program spend oversight, variance reporting, fiscal discipline, and executive-level budget reviews with the President of Okta R&D and Finance leadership.
  • Own and evolve the P&L framework for R&D lines of business, arming executive leadership with the cost and investment data behind portfolio decisions.
  • Model, govern and optimize AI token spend across the P&T organization — establish the cost baseline and forecasting model, build the framework for measuring return on that spend, and partner with engineering leaders to drive efficiency as consumption scales.
  • Lead engineering cost modeling, and partner with FP&A and Deal Desk on account-specific margin analysis to support pricing, packaging and large-deal decisions.
  • Own financial compliance for R&D, including Capitalized Software entries and maximizing US/Canada R&D tax credit capture.
  • Build and own the P&T expense data platform on Snowflake to enable clean line-of-business cost distribution and self-service cost visibility for engineering leaders.
  • Set the fiscal year workforce strategy in partnership with Recruiting leadership — headcount governance, real-time allocation tracking, backfills, organizational growth mapping, and location strategy.
  • Own the contingent workforce program end to end, including contractor and agency lifecycle, capacity and spend.
  • Own vendor operations for R&D — third-party relationships, capacity management, contract renewals, and performance SLAs.
  • Continuously refine the financial and workforce operating processes to eliminate friction and ensure the organization scales efficiently as it grows.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to develop the fiscal year goals and OKRs for the R&D organization, and run the program cadence — monthly and quarterly reviews — that gauges performance against them.
  • Set the standard for AI-first operations — apply AI to financial analysis, dashboard generation and workflow automation, and build a team for which AI fluency is core to how the work gets done rather than an experiment on the side.
  • Build, mentor and develop the operations team as a source of durable advantage for Okta R&D, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.

This is a team leadership role with five direct reports.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Must Have)

  • 12+ years of work experience, including 6+ years leading business operations, R&D / engineering operations, or FP&A functions within a technology company.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an engineering or R&D budget at scale — annual planning, in-year governance, variance management, and executive budget review.
  • Proven ownership of workforce planning and headcount governance in close partnership with Recruiting and Finance.
  • Experience managing a vendor portfolio, including contract negotiation and renewal, SLA management, and capacity planning.
  • Hands-on experience with Capitalized Software accounting and R&D tax credit programs in the US and/or Canada.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models and engineering cost structures.
  • Track record of building and developing high-performing operations teams, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.
  • Extensive experience navigating complex data sets and operating with ambiguity, where clean data is not available.
  • Demonstrated use of AI to do the substance of finance and operations work — analysis, reporting, dashboard generation and workflow automation — with a clear point of view on where to apply it next.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Good to Have)

  • Experience operating across multiple product units or post-acquisition entities with distinct financial and operational systems.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, or comparable experience building financial data platforms and self-service reporting.
  • Experience modeling or governing consumption-based spend, such as cloud infrastructure or AI / LLM token usage.
  • Experience with global workforce and location strategy, including India-based engineering centers.
  • Understanding of the B2B enterprise technology space, specifically Enterprise Security.
  • Experience running an annual goal-setting or OKR process for a technology organization, including the review cadence that tracks progress against it.
  • Prior experience in FP&A, management consulting, or a central strategy and operations function.
  • MBA, or an undergraduate degree with a concentration in Finance, Economics, Statistics or Engineering.

Why this role?

  • Own the full financial and workforce operating infrastructure for a 2,000+ person R&D organization at a category-defining security company.
  • Rare breadth of charter: FinOps, workforce operations and vendor operations, across an at scale SaaS R&D organization.
  • A genuinely new problem to own: defining how a 2,000+ person R&D organization budgets for, measures the return on, and optimizes its AI spend.
  • Direct line of sight into executive decision making — your models and plans are the basis on which R&D investment is allocated.
  • High degree of autonomy to shape the R&D operating model rather than inherit it.
  • Strong executive sponsorship from Okta's product and engineering leadership team.

Additional requirements:

  • There is no citizenship requirement. The Okta employee must be on US Soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101

The Opportunity: Enterprise Regional Sales Manager – Indonesia

We are looking for an experienced, high-performing, and commercially driven Enterprise Regional Sales Manager to accelerate Okta's growth across strategic and enterprise accounts in Indonesia.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of Indonesia's largest organisations, focusing on winning net-new enterprise customers and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. As AI adoption accelerates, identity security is becoming increasingly critical. Okta is looking for an experienced, self-motivated team player who will be a vital component for Okta’s sustainability (1) analytics and reporting, and (2) automation. This person will drive accurate and timely reporting and insights to meet the expectations of external stakeholders (customers, investors, and regulators) and internal stakeholders (executives, program leads, etc). This person will identify opportunities to automate data collection, analytics, reporting, and dashboards across various programs to streamline and simplify this work, and to enable our teams to scale to meet the moment and the growing stakeholder requirements. The role will drive impact as reporting is a customer business requirement, and data insights are foundational to building sustainability programs that drive business value and reduce environmental impacts. 

The ideal candidate for this role has 4+ years of data analytics, visualization, reporting, and automation experience, as well as sustainability, GHG accounting and carbon analytics experience. We are looking for highly motivated team players who have strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work cross functionally, as well as independently. This is a great opportunity for candidates seeking experience within a dynamic Finance organization deeply embedded in the teams we support.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage reporting, including collect and clean data; maintain accuracy of Okta’s sustainability metrics; analyze, summarize and visualize for external reporting/disclosures -  annual GHG Inventory and public language, sustainability section of annual Fact Sheet, CDP, and for internal dashboards and reporting, and supporting regulatory compliance.                                 . 
  • Prepare audit ready data sets and documentation; maintain traceable audit controls and trails; implement any feedback to strengthen internal controls and improve future assurance readiness; and manage third party assurance processes.
  • Carbon analytics: Own the design and maintenance of models to track and analyze, forecast, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions and environmental impact. Support quantifying the value of this work in terms of cost savings from reducing energy consumption, revenue supported by meeting customer expectations, etc. 
  • Support key teams with related analytics and reporting, such as
    • IR team with investor ESG questionnaires/surveys and data analysis and visualization for investor disclosures and presentations.
    • Finance SEC Accounting, Legal, & Sustainability teams with sustainability data for SEC and other public disclosures. 
    • Finance to integrate and maintain sustainability metrics in T&E dashboard, and to conduct analysis and provide recommendations and visualizations for each team/org.
    • Workplace team with building & utility sustainability data and analytics 
    • Finance, Technology, Data & Insights (TDI), and Sustainability teams to understand AI usage and environmental impacts, and identify opportunities to use AI more efficiently. Also partner with Engineering and Product teams to turn environmental data insights into actionable impact. 
  • Design, build, automate and maintain user-friendly dashboards, analytical tools, and reports to track metrics and performance indicators, and prepare slides and briefs, such as
    • Quarterly sustainability metrics/dashboards for Okta’s Executive Committee (CFO, CLO, COO) and Board of Directors. 
    • Quarterly sustainability metrics in Okta for Good (O4G) dashboard and QBR to streamline and simplify quarterly internal reporting for the team.

  • Cross-collaborate effectively with partner organizations
  • Leverage and improve current systems to increase productivity and accuracy 
  • Assist with and manage frequent ad hoc projects to support management and business decisions

  • Masters degree in sustainability and/or GHG accounting (preferred)

Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
