Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Build and lead a high-caliber SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet. 
  • Partner with global engineering, product, and infrastructure leaders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure services. 
  • Define and execute the SRE strategy in alignment with global reliability goals. 
  • Lead post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure long-term corrective actions. Participate in incident management, on-call rotations, and blameless RCAs. 
  • Implement automation and observability to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of modern infrastructure practices: infrastructure as code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and AI within the SRE org. 
  • Hire, mentor, and develop top SRE talent; build a strong engineering culture centered on reliability and innovation. 
  • Foster collaboration across global teams. 
  • Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and process improvement. 
  • Maintain a deep knowledge of industry best practices, evolving trends, and technologies. 
  • Manage service and business expectations and prioritize resource allocation. 
  • Accelerate the velocity of SRE and product engineering by developing robust platforms, powerful tooling, and intuitive self-service capabilities. 
  • Improve SDLC processes for Cloud infrastructure as a code, including the maturity of CI/CD pipelines, change and release management. 

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • 15+ years of experience in site reliability, infrastructure, or production engineering roles. 
  • 8+ years of experience in technical leadership & people management including managing managers. Strong expertise in automation, observability, performance optimization, and incident response. 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-cultural collaboration skills—particularly in a global matrixed setup. 
  • Experience building and scaling offshore SRE teams that partner with global counterparts. 
  • 4+ years of experience running the SRE org supporting a SaaS/Cloud service in a public Cloud, preferably AWS. Experience supporting a multi-Cloud environment will be a plus.

Computer Science Degree or related degree or equivalent experience

title: Specialist AI GTM Strategy and Activation - Technical Market Engagement
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About this role

Okta Secures AI is how enterprises give AI agents an identity, govern what those agents can reach, and prove it to auditors. The buyers are engineers, architects, and security practitioners who expect technical proof, not a business-value slide. The Technical focus area owns that audience: the reference architectures, technical content, demos, and deep-dive assets that hold up under live questioning.

You are the execution engine for that motion. You keep the technical content set accurate, current, and usable as the product ships new capabilities, and you take on well-scoped builds so the rest of the team can focus on net-new strategy and proof. Your first major ownership area is the technical content for the Blueprint Maturity Model (BMM). The BMM is the staged framework (Foundational, Scaling, Advanced, Strategic) that TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs use to move customers from first agent discovery to fully governed, production-scale agent identity. You also help with the plans, guides, and templates that go with it.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You will learn the product deeply, build and maintain assets, and work with the field teams who use your content every day. You'll start mostly behind the scenes and close to the field. As your depth and judgment grow, you'll spend more time directly in front of customers.

Core responsibilities

Every role in this org carries these, applied to its focus area. At this level, you contribute to and execute against each one, with guidance from the Technical lead.

  • Messaging and positioning: Apply the Technical narrative consistently across every asset you build or maintain, and flag where content has drifted from what the product actually does.
  • Buyer, persona, and market insight: Capture what you hear from TAMs, CSMs, FDEs, SEs, and customer calls, and turn it into concrete updates to content and the BMM.
  • Competitive and category intelligence: Track roadmap changes, competitor feature releases, and protocol developments (MCP, Cross App Access, agent auth patterns), and summarize what they mean for our technical content.
  • Go-to-market planning and launch execution: Get technical assets, guides, and BMM entries updated and ready when features move from roadmap to Beta, EA, and GA.
  • Sales enablement and field readiness: Maintain the guides, demo catalog, and reference material that SEs, TAMs, and CSMs rely on, and track whether they actually use it.
  • Customer-facing content and asset ownership: Own accuracy and freshness for your assigned assets end to end, starting with the BMM, and retire what's outdated.
  • Cross-functional influence: Work with product, engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to collect the inputs you need without formal authority over any of them.
  • Roadmap, pricing, and packaging input: Bring recurring field and customer feedback (product gaps, feature requests, deployment friction) to the Technical lead with the evidence behind it.

What you'll own

  • The Blueprint Maturity Model technical content. Keep each stage and capability current: the customer value, the Okta feature that delivers it, and the guide that implements it. Add new capabilities as they ship, move "to be released" items into active stages as they reach Beta, EA, or GA, and keep stage criteria aligned with how customers actually progress.
  • The BMM's associated content and templates. Keep the TAM Technical Project Plan, Customer Overview, Status Overview, and Actions & Deliverables templates consistent with the model. That means matching numbering, accurate task lists, and correct ownership (RACI) across CSM, TAM, PS, and FDE.
  • Implementation guides and technical collateral. Build and maintain the step-by-step guides linked from the BMM and the wider content set (for example SSO for agents, Cross App Access, agent import and registration, token exchange, secure token storage, system log streaming to a SIEM, and agent deactivation), so every BMM entry points to something a TAM can hand to a customer.
  • Demo environments and the demo catalog. Keep demos working as the product changes, document every setup to the team's standard, and capture high-quality screenshots, visuals, and recordings for reuse.
  • Field feedback loop. Gather input from TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs on where customers get stuck in the BMM, and turn it into proposed updates for the Technical lead to review.
  • Release and roadmap tracking. Watch Okta Secures AI release notes, Beta and EA programs, and competitor launches, and keep a running log of what needs updating in the content set.
  • Scoped builds for the team. Take on assigned pieces of larger projects, such as reference architecture diagrams, deep-dive sections, and demo scenarios, and deliver them accurately and on time.

How you'll work with customers

You'll start close to the field rather than out in front of it. You'll join TAM, CSM, and SE calls to hear where customers get stuck, support demos and technical sessions, and check that BMM guidance holds up in real deployments. As your product depth and confidence grow, you'll run demos and technical sessions yourself, present the BMM to customers, and represent Okta Secures AI at technical and developer events. Your customer-facing scope expands as you earn it.

What you'll bring

  • 2–5 years in technical marketing, solutions engineering, technical account management, professional services, developer relations, or another technical customer-facing role for a B2B software product. Identity or security experience is a plus.
  • Hands-on proficiency with SaaS admin consoles, CLIs, and APIs. You can stand up an integration, follow (and improve) technical documentation, and debug when a setup doesn't behave.
  • Working knowledge of identity fundamentals (SSO, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML) and a strong interest in going deep on agent identity: MCP, Cross App Access, token exchange, and agent authentication and authorization patterns.
  • Clear technical writing. Your guides are accurate, well-structured, and usable by someone who wasn't in the room.
  • Rigor and attention to detail. You keep a large, fast-changing body of content consistent, version-controlled, and correct.
  • Proactive habits. You spot gaps and stale content without being asked, and you come with a proposed fix.
  • Comfort working across teams and taking input from TAMs, CSMs, SEs, product managers, and engineers.
  • Comfort operating in an early, fast-moving market where the product, the roadmap, and the guidance change weekly.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally (roughly 10%) for customer engagements, team sessions, and events. This will grow as your role becomes more customer-facing.

Success looks like

  • BMM and associated content are accurate, current, and delivered on time, and no shipped capability is missing from the model or its guides.
  • TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs use the BMM and its guides to drive customer progression without reworking them.
  • Assets you build are reused across at least two channels or teams.

Growth path

This role is the foundation of the Technical team. Growth toward the next level means moving from executing assigned work to independently finding gaps, building self-documented solutions without being asked, and owning more of the customer-facing technical conversation yourself.

descriptionHtml:

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Product

Auth0 is a developer-friendly identity platform that simplifies authentication and authorization for applications. Designed by developers for developers, we make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-Ø global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation. Know more about our product at https://auth0.com/.

The Role

We are hiring for a new team within Core Identity, the Engineering organization entrusted with the very heart of the Auth0 application. Our teams own the authentication pipeline, identity protocols, user sessions, and all the fundamental concepts and foundational elements that underpin our entire product. We are also the stewards of the platform's technical health, performance, and efficiency.

As a Senior Engineer for this new team, named Core Frontier, you will operate at the vital intersection of deep product innovation and the global customer experience. Your mission is to ensure that the sophisticated features developed across the Core Identity organization (such as Native to Web, Cross-App Access and Custom Token Exchange) are hardened, scaled, and seamlessly integrated into the Auth0 ecosystem. You will act as the architectural bridge, ensuring that complex internal logic translates into a polished, secure, and high-performance experience that millions of developers and end-users interact with every day.

This is an opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges at a global scale, whilst providing a delightful and secure experience for our customers. You will primarily work with our NodeJS backend (TypeScript/JavaScript), with data stored in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis, all running on a multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure). If you have a passion for simplifying complex problems, building resilient and secure software, and care deeply about the final "feel" of a product, we encourage you to apply. Experience with or an interest in Identity and Access Management is highly valued.

What you will do: 

  • Be a founding engineer of this new team in Bengaluru, setting the technical bar and engineering culture for our growing presence in the region and working in collaboration with our global teams in Europe and North America.
  • Build and design  innovative features that extend the capabilities of Auth0’s platform to help our customers innovate around the world securely and delightfully.
  • Contribute to the strategic technical quality, security, reliability, and scalability of our systems, and advocate for engineering best practices.
  • Thrive in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, working with talented engineers and partners across Product, Security, Design, Architecture and QA to deliver features that delight our customers and ensure a unified technical vision.
  • Deepen or gain expertise in identity, security, and modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure) while working on distributed systems at scale.
  • Mentor and be mentored by other engineers and contribute to our culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our critical services remain healthy and reliable.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in designing and  building services with Node.js (JavaScript or TypeScript).
  • Experience creating and maintaining public and secure APIs, as well as front ends.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • A strong commitment to quality, with experience in various testing strategies (e.g., unit, integration, end-to-end).
  • A product-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs and work collaboratively to find effective solutions.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain.
  • Knowledge of security engineering principles and application security best practices.

Finer print

  • Conduct prompt and thorough investigations into potential policy violations, including allegations of harassment, discrimination, bullying, retaliation, and other misconduct.  Conduct investigatory interviews, gather other relevant evidence, write investigation reports, collaborate with cross-functional partners as needed, and debrief stakeholders. 
  • Calibrate and present recommendations for formal disciplinary action and/or other employee corrective action based on investigation findings.  Work with leaders to influence their alignment consistent with Okta’s values and the Code of Conduct. Ensure consistent application of policies and procedures.

title: Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Role

We seek a technical, hands-on Security Engineering Manager to build and lead a security engineering team within Auth0 Customer Identity that secures how we build and use AI. The team's work spans two areas. The first is building security tooling and controls for AI, including gateways and guardrails that secure the use of MCP servers, LLMs, agents, and the systems around them. The second is architecting and reviewing the security of our AI products, working shift-left with engineering and product teams so that security is built in from the start of design instead of added afterward.

This role leads a single team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across Product, Engineering, and the broader Okta Security organization to turn AI security guidance into shipped controls, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the AI threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for a team that doesn't just advise on AI risk — it builds the gateway, guardrails, and tooling that enforce secure AI usage, and reviews AI systems early enough to shape their design.

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a player-coach role. You will stay hands-on: designing and prototyping, writing and reviewing code, challenging architectures, and earning the respect of strong engineers, while also hiring, growing, and retaining your team and shaping its roadmap.

Responsibilities:

  • Hire, lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and pragmatic security
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for the team, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, balancing gateway engineering with security review demand
  • Lead the design and delivery of an internal AI gateway that secures internal AI traffic — including agent, MCP, and LLM access — with authentication and authorization, policy enforcement, guardrails, auditing, and observability
  • Be hands-on in the team's technical work: contribute to architecture, prototypes, and code, and set the engineering bar for the team
  • Run an AI security review practice, similar to product security, that assesses AI-enabled features, services, models, and agent/MCP integrations through intake, threat modeling, design review, and actionable remediation guidance
  • Review and build security controls for AI systems, addressing risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool and agent permissions, data leakage, excessive agency, model and supply-chain risk, and abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A)
  • Turn recurring review findings into reusable, secure-by-default controls, libraries, and patterns that engineering teams can adopt without a security engineer in the loop
  • Manage the intake and prioritization of AI security review requests, and decide what the team takes on, defers, or declines in line with capacity
  • Partner across Product, Engineering, and Identity Security leadership to embed AI security into the development lifecycle
  • Own and influence high-impact AI security architecture decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure
  • Communicate risk, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, and turn technical findings into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
  • Manage team health, prioritization, and delivery across remote, distributed time zones

What this position is not: 

  • A purely people-management role without technical depth
  • Compliance-focused or policy-only AI governance leadership
  • Owning reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function

Requirements:

  • You have 3+ years of experience managing security or software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers
  • You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
  • You have a hands-on development background in Golang and Node.js, and you remain hands-on, sufficient to design and build micro-services, evaluate prototypes, and contribute code to security tooling and the AI gateway
  • You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse, adversarial ML) — and an interest in building controls, not just assessing risk
  • You have experience performing product security or application security reviews, including threat modeling and architecture/design review, ideally applied to AI/LLM-based systems
  • You have working knowledge of the AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications, and of building secure API or gateway/proxy infrastructure (authentication, authorization, policy enforcement, rate limiting, auditing)
  • You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
  • AWS and/or Azure security
  • Kubernetes
  • You have strong knowledge of OWASP security standards and frameworks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
  • You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices
  • You have a proven record of setting technical vision, defining multi-quarter strategy, driving architectural consensus, and influencing cross-organizational security initiatives
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn technical findings into clear guidance for engineering, product, and executive audiences
  • You have experience leading a globally distributed and remote team across multiple time zones

Bonus points if:

  • You have built or led teams building an AI/LLM gateway, proxy, or guardrail platform in a production environment
  • You have built or led teams building AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment
  • You have published security research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security
  • You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:
    • Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research
    • Identity and access management, including workload and agent identity
    • Full-stack engineering
    • Site reliability engineering
    • Governance, risk and compliance

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Role

We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired.

This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture — they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps.

Responsibilities:

  • Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for your teams, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, and balance investment and prioritization across them
  • Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable micro-services and automation that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including secrets storage, rotation, access control, auditing, and workload identity
  • Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials
  • Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from, then prioritize investments in detection, tooling, and protections to get there
  • Direct research and protections against emerging general and AI-driven security threats targeting Auth0 and Auth0's customers — including traditional identity attacks as well as adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP), and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
  • Guide the review and hardening of Auth0's AI security offering, using analysis of past incidents to drive improvements such as new detection signals, heuristic updates, and data labeling enhancements, while identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
  • Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through comprehensive defenses and security countermeasures
  • Partner across Product, Engineering, and Identity Security leadership to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants, both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
  • Drive adoption of scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize threat defenses and secrets protections at scale
  • Own and influence high-impact security architecture decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience
  • Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations, root cause analysis, and remediation
  • Advise stakeholders on mitigation strategies for security risks, including end-of-life software and vulnerabilities, in support of the teams that own patching
  • Communicate risk, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, and turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
  • Manage team health, prioritization, and delivery across time zones, including India

What this position is not: 

  • Dedicated application security, line-by-line code review, or compliance-focused leadership
  • Owning reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them
  • A purely people-management role without technical depth

Requirements:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
  • You have 3+ years of experience managing security or software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers
  • You have a hands-on development background — Go / Node preferred — sufficient to guide the design and review of micro-services, evaluate prototypes, and steer the building of security tooling and AI-powered defenses
  • You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks
  • You have working knowledge of secrets management and cryptographic key handling (e.g., vaulting, rotation, short-lived credentials, workload identity)
  • You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
    • AWS and/or Azure security
    • Kubernetes
  • You have strong knowledge of OWASP security standards and frameworks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
  • You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices
  • You have a proven record of setting technical vision, defining multi-quarter strategy, driving architectural consensus, and influencing cross-organizational security initiatives
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering, product, and executive audiences
  • You have experience leading a globally distributed and remote team, ideally across multiple time zones including India

Bonus points if:

  • You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security
  • You have built or led teams building AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment
  • You have experience building or operating secrets management platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, cloud KMS and secret managers) at scale
  • You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:
  • Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research
    • The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications
    • Identity and access management
    • Full-stack engineering
    • Site reliability engineering
    • Vulnerability and threat management
    • Governance, risk and compliance

title: Staff FullStack Engineer, Secures AI
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. You are the architect of our unified control plane, ensuring that we operationalize our North Star: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every agent action.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Proactively shape the technical strategy of the Identity Security Fabric, partnering with leadership to prioritize open standards like IPSIE.
  • Govern and monitor agentic behavior by implementing the four-pillar maturity model across our fullstack ecosystems.
  • Architect for the agentic era, ensuring systems can discover and secure all agents, including "Shadow AI" assets.
  • Enforce secure access and least privilege for agents through capabilities like Agent Gateways and short-lived credentials.
  • Drive continual evolution in the adoption of AI-native development practices, helping the team rethink how we design, review, and ship software with AI as a core part of the workflow.
  • Proactively identify and prioritize tech debt; drive improvements in areas beyond feature work - CI/CD, observability, documentation, reliability, and support processes.
  • Partner with Product and Design to understand and own the desired customer outcome, not just the technical deliverable.
  • Actively invest in the growth of peer engineers, taking responsibility for raising the technical bar of the team as a whole.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Operates well beyond basic AI tool usage - understands how to apply AI meaningfully across the full software development lifecycle, can evaluate and adopt new AI tooling with good judgment, and is able to establish practices and bring a team along.
  • Proven experience defining scalable backend architectures and integrating complex APIs with modern web technologies - including the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with lasting org-wide impact.
  • Solid understanding of web authentication and authorization fundamentals - how auth flows work, and best practices for securing sensitive user data.                                                                                                                                               
  • Deep expertise in building highly reliable, secure, enterprise-grade software using Java or another type safe programming language.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to navigate and contribute to the frontend to unblock feature development.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, with experience designing and operating large-scale services on AWS

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following! 

  • Prior experience leading a team of engineers through a meaningful shift in ways of working - whether around AI adoption, developer tooling, or engineering culture change.
  • Experience building or maintaining publicly released SDKs used by external developers.
  • Experience in one of the following areas is preferred: developing Identity and Access Management (IAM) tooling and contributing to a "zero-to-one" startup-like team.

title: Software Architect, AI Systems and Platform
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Architect Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

We are hiring two hands-on architects. One will lead agent execution, harnesses and evaluations. The other will lead backend services, integrations, data and platform reliability. You will write critical code, resolve cross-team decisions and work with engineers through production rollout.

About You

Hands-on builder: You still write production code and test important decisions through implementation.

Practical architect: You choose a small, clear design and make it easy to extend when the product grows.

Trusted partner: You earn confidence through useful code, clear feedback and customer understanding.

What you will be doing

  • Define and implement shared contracts for tasks, events, permissions, approvals, evidence and usage.
  • Set clear boundaries between model reasoning, agent harnesses, durable workflows and services that enforce authorization.
  • Select a harness through representative identity tasks, failure tests and operational evidence. Keep model providers and harness components replaceable.
  • Design integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, including data boundaries, latency, cost, version changes and measured release quality.
  • Build reference services for tenant isolation, scoped tool execution, idempotency, long approval waits and verified results.
  • Define the transactional and analytics data architecture. Keep PostgreSQL application state separate from the planned ClickHouse or BigQuery analytics layer.
  • Connect Product, Applied AI and Platform engineers through clear ownership and practical APIs. Resolve dependencies that slow delivery.
  • Write critical implementations, review recovery and security, and guide technical leads through production rollout and customer expansion.

What you will bring to the role

  • A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple engineering teams, with recent production code you personally implemented.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed services, API design, data consistency, cloud security and production operations.
  • Experience making systems simpler while improving reliability, security or delivery speed.
  • The ability to explain design tradeoffs, guide senior engineers and remain accountable through implementation.
  • Depth in at least one of the two role areas below, plus the ability to work across the full product.

Role focus

AI systems architect: Build and evaluate agent harnesses, context management, model integrations and quality controls. Relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a comparable custom runtime.

Platform architect: Lead backend, connector, security, data and workflow architecture. Bring deep production systems experience and practical knowledge of integrating model-driven workflows.

Our stack

Python FastAPI, React and TypeScript, AWS Amplify, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and API Gateway. Storage uses RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector and S3. Security and operations include KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.

We are adding OpenAI and Anthropic model API integrations. An agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery are planned. You will help choose and implement them.

And extra credit for

  • Enterprise identity, security products, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or complex customer integrations.
  • ClickHouse, BigQuery, agent evaluations, post-training systems or open-source infrastructure.
  • Building a new product within a larger enterprise and keeping technical decisions reversible.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.

About You

Reliable builder: You design for failure and prove that recovery works.

Hands-on engineer: You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.

Strong owner: You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.

What you will be doing

  • Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
  • Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.
  • Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.
  • Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.
  • Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.
  • Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.
  • Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.
  • Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role

  • Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.
  • Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.
  • Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Scope by level

Senior: Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Principal: Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.

Our stack

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.

And extra credit for

  • ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.
  • Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. Okta authenticates, authorizes, and provisions millions of users a day. Internally, TDI Infrastructure Engineering runs the platforms that our own engineering and business teams build on — hosted on AWS, increasingly Kubernetes-native, and expanding fast to support AI-driven internal workflows. We're looking for a Staff SRE to help us evolve Site Reliability Engineering from a traditional operations model into a true Platform as a Service (PaaS) organization.

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer on our Bengaluru/India team, you will be the senior-most technical voice on the ground — setting architectural direction for our Kubernetes platform, driving the hardest reliability and scaling problems to resolution, and partnering with Staff/Principal engineers on our US and India teams to keep our global platform strategy coherent. You'll report to the Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the India SRE team, as well as global SRE peers.

What you'll be doing: 

  • Owning the architecture and evolution of our Kubernetes platform for the Bengaluru/India team — cluster strategy, multi-tenancy, networking, and security posture — in close coordination with counterparts in the US and India
  • Leading the technical design and rollout of self-service platform capabilities, golden paths, and self-healing patterns that let internal teams ship and operate workflows without deep platform expertise
  • Driving the platform's readiness to host AI-driven internal workflows reliably at scale — model serving, GPU scheduling, and orchestration infrastructure
  • Taking ownership of the hardest, highest-ambiguity reliability problems: complex production incidents, capacity and scaling challenges, and cross-system failure modes
  • Participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation shared with SRE peers in the US and India, and driving root-cause resolution and postmortems for the incidents you own
  • Setting technical standards for SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and on-call practice, and holding the team accountable to them
  • Improving SDLC processes for infrastructure-as-code, including CI/CD pipeline maturity and change/release management
  • Mentoring engineers across the team and raising the technical bar through design reviews, architecture discussions, and hands-on pairing
  • Partnering with architects, security, and product engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with the business's reliability, security, and delivery needs
  • Representing the Bengaluru/India team in global platform architecture discussions, working as a peer with Staff/Principal-level engineers in the US and India

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering, with a track record of staff-level technical leadership
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Kubernetes at production scale — architecture, multi-tenancy, networking, security, and day-2 operations
  • Experience running large-scale internal infrastructure platforms in a public cloud, preferably AWS
  • Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions)
  • Strong proficiency in Python or similar scripting and programming languages.
  • Experience building or operating infrastructure that hosts AI/ML or agentic workflows — model serving, GPU scheduling, or orchestration frameworks
  • Deep experience with observability platforms and monitoring tools (Grafana, Splunk, APM, or equivalent) in a large-scale environment
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams and geographies without formal authority
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with experience mentoring engineers and driving technical alignment across distributed teams
  • Computer Science degree or related field, or equivalent experience

Good to have:

  • Building internal developer platforms (IDPs) with a "platform as a product" mindset
  • Hands-on experience with AI agent orchestration, vector databases, model routing, or inference optimization infrastructure
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS plus Azure or GCP)
  • Service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd) or GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux) in production Kubernetes environments
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD) or equivalent cloud certifications
  • Experience managing or administering an enterprise-scale SCM platform (GitHub, GitLab, or equivalent)

Location:

This role is based in Bengaluru, India. Okta operates a flexible hybrid work model; specific in-office expectations will be discussed during the hiring process. This role requires close, regular collaboration with SRE peers and engineers in the US and India, so some flexibility in working hours should be expected. The Opportunity

We are in search of a top tier Payroll Accountant to join our Compensation GL team.  The ideal candidate is a detailed-oriented, self-motivated team player, who enjoys working in a challenging and fast-paced environment.  This individual should have a solid working knowledge of GAAP, SEC regulations, and internal controls and will be responsible for the timely and accurate recording of compensation and benefits related activities of the company.

title: Senior Digital Strategy and Growth Manager
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Role Overview

As a Senior Digital Growth & Personalization Manager, you'll be the strategic advisor and thought partner to our Digital Strategy team—helping define what to test, why it matters, and what the results mean for our customers. You'll own the intersection of customer research, testing strategy, and stakeholder guidance, building a testing roadmap grounded in deep understanding of B2B buyer journeys. This is a hands-on strategic role where you'll launch tests yourself, present findings, and become the trusted expert voice of site optimization and personalization. 

Responsibilities

  • Test and personalization strategy: Define what should be tested and personalized and why. Guide teams with optimization best practices and refine test hypotheses with stakeholders to ensure rigor.
  • Own roadmap management: Build and manage a quarterly testing roadmap grounded in customer research and business priorities. 
  • Customer journey research: Initiate your own research to understand friction points, user segments, and behavior patterns across our B2B buyer journey. Synthesize findings into actionable testing hypotheses and personas.
  • Hands-on test ownership: Launch and manage tests independently (copy changes, simple targeting, basic segments) while collaborating with engineering on more complex builds. Own test plans, success criteria, and validation.
  • Insights & analysis: Dig beyond winner/loser narratives. Uncover segment-specific lift, identify which experiences resonate with which buyer profiles, and translate findings into the next phase of strategy.
  • Stakeholder leadership & storytelling: Present test ideas, progress, and conclusions. Frame personalization and testing wins as drivers of sales cycle efficiency and user experience. Become the trusted advisor on digital strategy and buyer behavior.
  • Technical fluency & collaboration: Understand data layers, tracking requirements, and technical frameworks well enough to brief engineers and unlock deeper personalization triggers. You won't be implementing—but you'll speak the language.

Necessary Experience

  • 5+ years of growth, experimentation, or optimization experience with a track record of managing testing roadmaps and building strategic plans across marketing functions.
  • Segmentation & targeting expertise: You understand how to define audiences, test hypotheses against specific segments, and identify which experiences move the needle for which buyer profiles.
  • Personalization campaign management: You’ve created new campaigns for web properties, reported progress, and iteratively improved personalization strategies.
  • Customer research & synthesis: You’re data-first, and seek to understand customer journeys and translate findings into testing strategy.
  • Testing platform expertise: Hands-on experience launching and managing tests through tools like Adobe Target is a plus. (Optimizely, VWO, experience with a testing platform is required).
  • Strategic stakeholder communication: You've presented test ideas, results, and strategic recommendations to Directors and Sr. Directors. You know how to frame testing wins as business outcomes, not just metrics.
  • Technical literacy: You understand data layers, tracking, and how personalization gets built and can launch simple tests (copy, basic targeting) independently.
  • B2B mindset: Experience in B2B environments, understanding longer sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and the buyer journey complexity that shapes testing strategy.

Preferred Experience

  • B2B martech stack: Familiarity with tools like Marketo, Demandbase, 6sense, or similar—used to inform targeting and audience strategy.
  • Cross-organization collaborator: You've successfully shaped testing strategy or roadmaps as a peer advisor, pushing back on ideas and driving toward better hypotheses.
  • Advisory/council experience: You've been brought into strategic meetings as a trusted expert voice on digital strategy, user behavior, or testing—eventually spanning multiple teams.
  • Visualization & storytelling: You're comfortable building presentation decks, dashboards (Tableau, Looker, etc.), or visual narratives that make data compelling to leadership.
  • AI-Augmented Program Management: Active adoption of generative AI tools and workflows to compress the experimentation lifecycle

Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineering

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer that will join the Auth0 Security Engineering organization. In this role, you will join a team of Software Engineers dedicated to building and managing services that secure the platform that Auth0 runs on. You will be instrumental in expanding our platform security controls and architecting custom workflows in a scalable, reliable manner. 

What You Will Do

  • Service Development: Build, maintain, and operate platform security services and controls using Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • Security Data Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize custom workflows to ingest, process, and distribute security data to downstream systems at scale.
  • Scalable System Architecture:Architect maintainable, secure, and resilient microservices and platform integrations that protect our infrastructure without adding friction for engineering teams.
  • Engineering Quality: Write clean, testable, and well-documented code while driving technical designs and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
  • Mentorship & Influence: You raise the bar for the entire organization by mentoring junior engineers and influencing senior leadership on critical security decisions.

What You Bring

  • Software Development Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade software services.
  • Core Language Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • System Design Expertise: Strong track record of designing scalable, maintainable, and secure software architectures.
  • Cloud & Containers: Solid experience with cloud-native environments (AWS or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Security Mindset: Practical experience building platform security controls, managing service permissions, and applying secure coding practices.
  • Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have

The team

The UI Platform team is the force multiplier for Okta’s entire product portfolio. By building world-class components, accessible frameworks, and developer-friendly tools, your work will directly impact millions of administrative and end-user interactions every day. You will work alongside dedicated product and engineering partners in an environment that values speed, clarity, and career-defining impact.

The role

The Staff Product Designer – UI Platform is a high-impact individual contributor role, serving as a foundational design lead for Okta's global user experience infrastructure. Joining the Product Platform group, you will act as a resident expert and strategic thought partner, shaping the horizontal design patterns, design architecture, localization/globalization frameworks, and accessibility standards (WCAG) that power every Okta Workforce Identity product.

You will partner directly with cross functional UI Platform leads to drive platform-level initiatives, harmonizing user experience (UX) and developer experience (DevEx) across our engineering and product organizations. You will also collaborate closely with the Design Systems team, acting as a bridge between the system and feature teams applying it to our product.

What you’ll be doing

When everyone on the team can generate UI, the designer's role shifts. You become the person responsible for strong systems thinking, taste, quality, experience, and being the voice of the customer. You hold the quality bar when speed is pushing everything toward "fine."

  • UI & system leadership: In partnership with the Design Systems team, serve as a UI platform and design system expert, identifying / creating, documenting, and evangelizing scalable, accessible (WCAG), and localized patterns to resolve dependencies across products.
  • Strategic partnership: Partner with cross functional UI Platform leads to align vision with design strategy, co-owning the roadmap to balance features, tech debt, quality, and adoption.
  • Raise the craft: Enable Okta Research and Development teams through clear alignment and documentation. Improve org-wide processes and mentor designers to promote craft excellence, candid feedback, and growth.
  • Data informed decision making: Leverage data and AI insights to inform clear, platform-level design decisions and streamline governance.

Who we are looking for

  • You are proficient in AI workflows and how to apply them to the product design process, along with opinions about where AI tools help and where they fall short
  • You are passionate about helping customers solve real problems and upholding design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive and quality user experiences

  • You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation and can effectively identify elegant, extensible solutions
  • You have excellent craft and enjoy diving into the details to ensure high quality experiences for our customers, while providing design feedback and mentorship to fellow designers

  • You are someone who sees design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area
  • You have strong communication skills and can distill complex concepts into simple, easy to understand narratives, while advocating for consistent, high quality design based on sound rationale
  • Your portfolio will show that you've worked on and led complex and challenging projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design) across large, horizontal scopes and groups, with a preference for large-scale enterprise and SAAS products

Qualifications

  • Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer

title: Senior Software Engineer, Performance ( Toronto)
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology - anywhere, on any device or app. Our Identity as a Service solution enables secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

The Engineering Opportunity

Okta's Workforce Identity Cloud secures billions of global logins every day. The Platform Scalability team within the Resilience organization owns the speed, efficiency, and scale of Okta's core authentication and authorization service. We analyze and optimize system behavior across every layer of the stack - from virtualized hardware and the JVM, through MySQL query execution, caching, and the edge, up to cloud components (AWS/GCP) and application code - and we build the frameworks that keep the platform fast and protected for thousands of organizations and millions of daily active users.

We are seeking a Senior Back-End Software Engineer to help own the scalability, efficiency, and service protection of our expanding Identity as a Service platform.

You will build traffic-shaping and service-protection frameworks (rate limiting, concurrency limits, query timeouts, read isolation), create tooling and automation that makes latency and resource bottlenecks easy to find, and dig into production metrics to understand how the system behaves under real customer traffic. While SRE and Database Reliability Engineering keep the service up and running, the Platform Scalability team keeps it fast and efficient - and we partner closely with them to get there.

Because we own monitoring of system latency, throughput, and resource utilization, this is not a heads-down coding role: keeping an eye on system health is part of the regular rhythm of the job, alongside project work and deep-dive investigations.

We value iterative development, automated testing, and individual ownership. Join our creative, fast-paced team to work on impactful projects at serious scale.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design and implement backend frameworks that protect and optimize critical system resources, including rate limiting, traffic shaping, concurrency controls, and query timeout enforcement.
  • Monitor production latency, throughput, and resource utilization across the database, application, cache, and edge layers; create and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerts, often through automated tooling.
  • Analyze latency and scalability bottlenecks end-to-end - JVM profiling, thread and heap analysis, SQL query plans, slow logs, and Hibernate behavior - and drive fixes in code, SQL, and configuration.
  • Perform capacity and cost-efficiency analysis (for example, determining whether databases and compute are right-sized for current load), participate in weekly metrics reviews, and support onboarding of large customers and high-traffic events.
  • Advise engineering teams on scalable, efficient feature design; review pull requests and SQL changes for latency, resource, and scale impact and recommend tuning or refactoring.
  • Actively explore and integrate modern AI-driven developer tooling, automated diagnostics, and intelligent monitoring to accelerate latency and capacity investigations, automate analysis of metrics and logs, and reduce toil.
  • Write high-quality unit and functional tests and participate in design and code reviews to keep the engineering bar high.
  • Participate in on-call rotations handling latency and scale-related customer escalations, rate limit requests, and production incidents; contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and long-term mitigations.
  • Collaborate closely with SRE, Database Reliability Engineering, Architects, QA, Product Owners, and Customer Support to deliver secure and dependable software.

Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience as a software developer with strong knowledge of Java or a similar language, including a solid understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and concurrency.
  • Strong experience with relational databases - preferably MySQL and Hibernate - including query optimization, indexing, execution plan analysis, and schema design.
  • Proven experience diagnosing and resolving latency, throughput, and scaling bottlenecks in high-availability, multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience with profiling and observability tools (e.g., Java Flight Recorder, async-profiler, thread/heap dump analysis, Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana or similar).
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, or GCP/Azure) and modern container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes).

The TDI Client Platform Engineering Team

The Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI) team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. We are a group of innovative engineers who prioritize automation, testing, and performance tuning. We touch every part of the business, and we are obsessed with creating a seamless, secure end-user experience for every Okta employee.

The Staff Client Platform Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Client Platform Engineer, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s macOS and iOS fleet. While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our Windows, Android, Linux, and VDI management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks automation-first. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

What makes this role unique: You are Customer Zero. Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Apple Fleet Management: Own the global macOS and iOS fleet using Jamf Pro, overseeing enrollment, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
  • Cross-Platform Support: Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.
  • Tooling & Evolution: Administer open-source tools (Munki, Santa) and lead evaluations of emerging platforms like FleetDM to enhance cross-platform fleet visibility.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure endpoints meet NIST, CIS, and STIG standards. Partner with Security teams to respond to vulnerabilities across the entire fleet.
  • Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Apply an IaC mindset to device management using code-based workflows (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or Jamf API). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable, and automated deployments regardless of the OS.
  • Technical Direction: Set the architecture and technical direction for a domain, such as Apple platform, endpoint security tooling or devices-as-code, and write design or docs that formalize it.
  • Customer Zero Advocacy: Act as a primary feedback loop for Okta’s internal product teams. Test new features in production and influence the product roadmap based on operational data.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide Tier 3 escalation support for global IT teams and participate in an on-call rotation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Core Experience: 8+ years in endpoint engineering with a focus on Apple platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Technical Versatility: A strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems; you aren't just a "Mac person", you understand how to apply engineering principles to any OS.
  • MDM Mastery: Deep expertise in managing endpoints at scale via MDM, such as Jamf Pro. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, FleetDM or other cross-platform MDM/UEM solutions is a significant plus.
  • Scripting: Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, or Swift (PowerShell experience is a bonus).
  • Tooling: Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar CI/CD frameworks.
  • Security: Understanding of ADE/DEP, MDM/DDM protocols, and platform-specific hardening (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).
  • Identity Knowledge: Familiarity with SAML and OIDC and how they integrate with endpoint authentication.

Additional requirements:

  • This position requires the ability to access federal environments and/or have access to protected federal data.  As a condition of employment for this position, the successful candidate must be able to submit documentation establishing U.S. Person status (e.g. a U.S. Citizen, National, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee. 22 CFR 120.15) upon hire.

Extra Credit

  • Hands-on experience with FleetDM or osquery for multi-OS visibility.
  • Experience with Autopkg pipelines or AWS Lambda for endpoint automation.
  • Background in Federal compliance (FedRAMP).
  • Relevant certifications (Apple, Okta, Microsoft, AWS, Jamf).

Location & Work Style

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be located near an Okta office. In the San Francisco Bay Area, employees are expected to be in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

The Okta Vision

At Okta, our vision is to enable everyone to safely use any technology. As the world's leading independent identity partner, we help organisations securely connect people, applications, and technology.

As AI adoption accelerates, identity security has become more critical than ever. Organisations must now secure not only employees and customers, but also non-human identities, including service accounts, automation tools, and AI agents.

Okta is at the forefront of this transformation, helping enterprises strengthen their security posture, embrace Zero Trust, and securely adopt emerging technologies.

The Opportunity – Senior Solutions Engineer

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer to join our Enterprise Solutions Engineering team.

As a trusted technical advisor to some of the region's leading organisations, you will help customers solve complex identity and cybersecurity challenges through Okta's technology.

Partnering closely with our Enterprise Sales team, you will shape technical strategies, influence technology decisions, and demonstrate how Okta enables organisations to securely accelerate digital transformation and AI adoption.

This is an opportunity to combine your technical expertise, business acumen, and consultative skills to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.

What You'll Be Doing

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with Enterprise Account Executives to develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities to deliver value through Okta's Identity Security Platform.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, understanding customers' business challenges, security priorities, and technical requirements.

  • Engage stakeholders at all levels, including CISOs, CIOs, security architects, developers, and IT leaders.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into compelling business outcomes through presentations, demonstrations, and architecture discussions.

  • Build strong technical relationships with customers, technology partners, and delivery partners.

Solution Design & Technical Sales Execution

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, and validation throughout the enterprise sales cycle.

  • Deliver tailored demonstrations, technical workshops, and outcome-focused Proofs of Concept (POCs).

  • Architect identity and security solutions integrating with customers' cloud platforms, applications, and security ecosystems.

  • Advise customers on modern identity strategies, including authentication, access management, identity governance, and Zero Trust.

  • Address technical objections, resolve integration challenges, and collaborate with internal teams to progress complex opportunities.

  • Advocate for customers by sharing technical feedback with Product Management and Engineering.

Innovation & Thought Leadership

  • Advise customers on emerging security challenges, including non-human identities, AI agents, and hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

  • Stay current with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, identity standards, and AI security developments.

  • Represent Okta at customer workshops, industry conferences, and partner events.

  • Collaborate with regional and global Solutions Engineering teams to share knowledge and best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Presales, Solutions Architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, ideally within SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise technology.

  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to design solutions and articulate value to technical and business audiences.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Experience delivering technical demonstrations, solution workshops, and POCs.

  • Strong consultative and problem-solving capabilities, aligning technical solutions with business objectives.

  • Ability to collaborate with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to progress enterprise opportunities.

  • Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for cybersecurity and emerging technologies.

Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), or Identity Governance.

  • Familiarity with identity protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Understanding of Zero Trust architecture, cloud security, and enterprise application environments.

title: Staff Security Compliance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.
