This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Security Compliance team’s mission is to strengthen Okta’s position as the leading Identity-as-a-Service solution through a security-first approach to compliance.  We are looking for someone with a strong compliance background and experience in the technical implementation of security controls from ISMAP, IRAP Protected, SOC2, ISO 27001, and other international frameworks.  The right candidate will have participated in a mature ISMS program, delivered ISMAP compliance, and will play a key role in providing customers with confidence in Okta’s leadership in the identity space.  As a Staff Security Compliance Analyst, you will support security initiatives by engaging various process owners in the design, documentation, implementation, monitoring of the appropriate controls in our computing environments, and demonstrating those controls to external auditors.  In addition you will plan and lead the private sector compliance initiatives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with the technical implementation of ISMAP, SOC2 and ISO controls in a cloud-based environment using tools such as Salesforce, Okta, ServiceNow, JIRA and others.  This position requires a unique set of skills including project management, and an eye towards future standards and regulations that will impact our customers.  If you’re a self-starter who wants to make a difference in global cloud security, we want you on board.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Participate in Security Compliance Assessments of the company’s computing environment, with focus on security controls
  • Facilitate Okta’s ISMAP compliance assessment
  • Interpret requirements across multiple compliance frameworks 
  • Collaborate to manage and maintain common controls framework for Okta 
  • Scheduling compliance walkthroughs
  • Ensuring consistent operations and communications across compliance teams
  • Ensuring visibility into key compliance projects through reporting and metrics
  • Analyze gaps between current status and future compliance framework needs
  • Perform controls testing and develop recommendations based on confirmed observations
  • Work with process and control owners to help them understand the audit results, identify remediation options, and prioritize their closure
  • As needed, develop appropriate security documentation, including system security plans, information security policies, and risk assessment procedures
  • Assess security impact on changes to the systems and applications
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the Compliance program and build plans to address them

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Information Technology or similar, preferably in a Security Governance, Risk, or Compliance (GRC) focused role
  • Comprehensive understanding of IT Security practices and the Governance, Risk, and Compliance lifecycle
  • Fluent in English and Japanese
  • Experience at ISMAP compliant organization(s), or performing ISMAP assessments
  • Familiarity with Japanese cybersecurity laws and regulations
  • Knowledge in IT security frameworks and best practices, such as NIST publications, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, CCM, IRAP Protected, ISMAP, BSI-C5, TISAX, SOX, HIPAA, ENS, HDS, and SOC2 Trust Principles and Criteria
  • Understanding of IT methodologies, such as software development lifecycle and operations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to “think-out-of-the-box”
  • Strong oral, written and presentation communication skills
  • Able to work independently or with a team
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Management Information Systems or Accounting, or equivalent experience

descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to Know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or application. Our Workforce Identity Cloud and Customer Identity Cloud (Auth0) solutions enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box—we’re looking for lifelong learners and owners who can make us better with their unique experiences, technical acumen, and passion for continuous improvement.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

About the Role

Okta is searching for an experienced, detail-oriented, and high-impact Senior Internal Auditor to join our global Internal Audit team and drive the successful execution of Okta’s global Internal Audit and SOX IT compliance program.

In this role, you will lead and execute IT General Control (ITGC), IT Application Control (ITAC), and Information Produced by Entity (IPE/Key Reports) walkthroughs and testing across Okta’s critical enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments. You will operate with significant autonomy, collaborate closely with external auditors, mentor and review the work of auditors, and partner with Engineering, Information Security, and Finance stakeholders to safeguard the integrity of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR).

Key Responsibilities

1. Audit Execution & Testing (ITGC & ITAC)

  • Independently lead end-to-end SOX IT walkthroughs and execute design (TOD) and operating effectiveness (TOE) testing in strict alignment with Okta’s Internal Audit and SOX methodology.
  • Assess IT General Controls across all primary domains:
  • Logical Access & Security: User lifecycle management (provisioning/deprovisioning), privileged access management (PAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and segregation of duties (SoD).
  • Change Management: Source code repository management, deployment approval gates, testing validation, emergency changes, and CI/CD pipeline controls.
  • Computer Operations & Resiliency: Automated batch job scheduling and monitoring, data backup verification, incident/problem management, and disaster recovery.
  • Perform rigorous evaluations of automated application controls (ITAC), system-generated reports/queries (IPE), key data integrations, and interface reconciliations.
  • Review third-party Service Organization Control reports (SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type II) to evaluate complementary user entity controls (CUECs) and determine impacts on in-scope hosted/SaaS systems.
  • Participate and support Internal Audits planned for the year. 

2. Workpaper Quality, Staff Coaching & Methodology

  • Prepare self-reviewed, audit-ready workpapers and documentation within Okta's GRC platform  with clear evidence, testing samples, and audit conclusions requiring minimal editorial revision.
  • Review staff and associate auditor work products, providing actionable coaching and feedback to elevate overall team quality and audit rigor.
  • Actively champion SOX methodology improvements, control standardization, and testing efficiencies across the Internal Audit team.

3. Deficiency Evaluation & Stakeholder Advisory

  • Pinpoint systemic root causes of control breakdowns and bridge technical gaps between engineering realities and compliance expectations—moving beyond symptom identification.
  • Draft precise, well-contextualized deficiency write-ups and collaborate with control owners (TDI, Security, Engineering, and Finance) to reach alignment on remediation strategies and Compensating Controls.
  • Track Management Action Plans (MAPs) and perform remediation testing to validate sustained resolution of identified gaps.
  • Support direct audit coordination with external auditors, effectively addressing queries and facilitating seamless walkthroughs and sample validations.

4. Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to rationalize redundant controls, eliminate manual testing fatigue, and leverage automated system capabilities.
  • Assist in incorporating data analytics, scripting, and RPA/bot governance to streamline audit sample extraction, configuration inspections, and continuous control monitoring.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or related STEM/business discipline.
  • Experience: 4–6 years of relevant experience in IT audit, SOX compliance, technology risk consulting, or internal controls assurance within a Big Four public accounting firm and/or a publicly traded enterprise (high-growth SaaS / cloud technology company preferred).
  • Technical Mastery:
  • Deep functional knowledge of SOX 404 requirements, PCAOB standards, COBIT, NIST CSF, and the COSO internal control framework.
  • Practical experience testing core enterprise systems, including ERP platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Workday), CRM/Billing systems (Salesforce), Identity & Access Management tools, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Demonstrated track record evaluating ITGCs, automated application controls, and complex report/query logics (IPE).
  • Deficiency & Root Cause Analysis: Proven capability in assessing control deficiencies, determining financial statement impact/significance, and formulating corrective actions with process owners.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; demonstrated confidence in facilitating walkthroughs and presenting findings to cross-functional leadership.
  • Global Team Player: Self-motivated mindset with the ability to operate independently across distributed time zones (including supporting Pacific Time collaboration when necessary).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certification such as CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) strongly preferred; CIA, CISSP, CISM, or CPA is an added advantage.
  • Direct hands-on experience using modern GRC tools such as Optro.
  • Familiarity with database query languages (SQL) or data analytics platforms (Alteryx, Snowflake, Tableau) to automate testing validations.
  • Understanding of modern DevOps environments, cloud security posture, and CI/CD release management tools (e.g., GitHub, Jira).

Okta’s Core Leadership Competencies

  • Drives Results: Consistently achieves results and meets deliverables with high precision, even under tight SOX filing timelines and shifting priorities.
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness (EQ): Solicits feedback, reflects on outcomes, and proactively adapts communication styles across technical engineering teams and non-technical finance leaders.
  • Develops Talent: Passionate about mentoring junior auditors and sharing domain knowledge to foster a high-performance culture.
  • Strategic Mindset & Innovation: Looks ahead to emerging compliance challenges (cloud architectures, AI governance, identity-first security) and translates them into proactive internal audit strategies.

We are looking for a dynamic, hands-on Partner Team Leader (Player-Coach) to lead and accelerate our partner ecosystem across the ASEAN, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Korea regions.

title: Manager, Field Process & Systems
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Field Process and Systems Team

At Okta, the Field Process & Systems team serves as the strategic connective tissue between our Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and the technology and processes that power it. We manage the end-to-end design of GTM workflows, optimize our global tech stack, and deploy scalable operational capabilities across our field organization. Our mission is to eliminate operational friction and accelerate growth by delivering data-backed, scalable process and system solutions. As a member of this team, you will work alongside experts in revenue operations, enterprise systems, and GTM strategy to ensure our tools and workflows allow our field organization to execute with speed and precision.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Field Process & Systems to serve as an operational problem-solver for our field organization. In this role, you will hold a deep, end-to-end understanding of our GTM technology stack while actively driving initiatives that optimize field performance and eliminate daily friction.

You will combine a "process-first" mindset with strong analytical rigor—using data to identify and quantify operational friction points (such as lead routing breakdowns, deal velocity bottlenecks, and handoffs). Crucially, your analytical findings will directly inform our team’s project prioritization—ensuring we tackle the highest-impact operational gaps aligned with overarching company strategy. Additionally, you will own our team's operational drumbeat: managing project intake and leading our monthly cross-functional stakeholder updates.

What You’ll Be Doing

GTM Tech Stack Mastery

  • End-to-End Tech Fluency: Maintain a deep, hands-on understanding of our core GTM technology ecosystem (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Outreach, etc.) to ensure tools are configured, optimized, and utilized effectively.
  • Systems & Workflow Architecture: Design scalable, friction-free system solutions and process enhancements that allow sales and revenue teams to execute efficiently.
  • Tool Adoption & Best Practices: Ensure high utilization and proper execution across our tech stack by establishing clear process documentation, user guidelines, and operational standards for field teams.

Data-Driven Friction Hunting & Strategic Alignment

  • Identify & Quantify Inefficiencies: Leverage system telemetry, CRM data, and operational metrics to uncover field bottlenecks (e.g., lead routing delays, stage-gating friction, and handoff misalignments) and calculate their real business impact.
  • Shape Strategy & Prioritization: Use data-backed findings to directly inform what our team prioritizes—balancing quantified operational needs against overarching company strategy to build a high-impact roadmap.
  • Propose & Lead System Solutions: Translate operational gaps into concrete, end-to-end system and process proposals, leading execution from concept to close to eliminate friction.

Governance, Intake & Backlog Prioritization

  • Manage Project Intake: Take ownership of the Field Process & Systems project intake framework, evaluating incoming requests, system enhancements, and process change proposals from field leadership and business partners.
  • Impact-Driven Prioritization: Rigorously evaluate and rank incoming work based on quantified friction, estimated ROI, and strategic business goals to maintain a clear, transparent project backlog.

Stakeholder Management & Operational Cadence

  • Lead Monthly Stakeholder Syncs: Own the operational drumbeat for our key initiatives—preparing agendas and decks, leading monthly cross-functional update calls with key stakeholders, and delivering recaps and action items.
  • Cross-Functional Visibility: Keep field leadership and key business partners consistently informed on active projects, backlog status, and measurable outcomes from deployed initiatives.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 5+ Years of Experience: Background in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Process Strategy, or Systems Optimization within a fast-paced SaaS environment.
  • GTM Tech Stack Expertise: Deep, hands-on fluency with Salesforce and standard GTM technologies (e.g., Clari, ZoomInfo, Gong, LeanData/routing engines).
  • Data-Driven & Analytical Acumen: Proven ability to query, analyze, and translate complex operational data into quantified business cases that directly drive roadmap prioritization.
  • Structured Intake & Prioritization: Demonstrated success managing project intake frameworks, grooming backlogs, and balancing competing requests against strategic business priorities.
  • Cadence & Presentation Mastery: Strong executive presence and communication skills, with proven experience designing polished slide decks and leading cross-functional stakeholder meetings.
  • Process-First Mindset: Ability to look beyond quick fixes to build scalable, long-term workflows that reduce friction for field reps while preserving data integrity.

Reporting to the Director of AMER Okta Partners & Alliances, the Regional Alliance Manager will drive co-sell execution across a defined portfolio of focus partners within the Commercial customer segment. This role is responsible for collaborating with partners and Okta Sales to advance active opportunities, create new Okta pipeline, and align the resources and actions required to move deals forward.   • Forecast alliance revenue, inclusive of Focus Partners and co-sell motion accurately with strong Salesforce.com skills
  • Apply strong data & analytical skills to measure KPIs around pipe-gen, sourced ARR, marketing, deal registration, accreditations and certifications

  • 5+ years of Partners and Alliances experience, preferably in the SaaS and/or CIAM space, with a strong focus on high-tech alliance sales working with regional, national, and global Partners
  • Proven track record and success with Commercial customer engagements

  • Familiarity with CSP Co-Sell motions

Role Summary

This leader manages a globally distributed team of employees, contractors, and vendor partners supporting AV systems, hybrid meetings, executive events, and workplace technologies. The role balances operational excellence with long-term planning, process improvement, technology standards, vendor management, and people development.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead the global AV Operations and Events team, setting clear goals, operating standards, and service expectations across regions.

  • Build a strong people-leadership culture through coaching, regular feedback, career development, cross-training, and succession planning.

  • Oversee daily AV support, workplace technology services, and in-person, virtual, and hybrid meetings across global offices.

  • Lead technical and logistical planning for high-visibility events, executive forums, company meetings, and external-facing productions.

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor for C-level executives, senior leaders, and white-glove events.

  • Manage production vendors, venues, SOWs, RFPs, and external partners to ensure quality delivery and cost-effective outcomes.

  • Drive standardization, documentation, maintenance practices, incident management, and Root Cause Analysis for AV and workplace technology services.

  • Use metrics and dashboards to track utilization, SLAs, support trends, spend, room performance, and event demand.

  • Partner with Workplace, IT, Security, Comms, and business teams to improve collaboration spaces, event experiences, and hybrid work capabilities.

  • Evaluate industry trends and recommend technology, process, and service improvements that scale globally.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 8+ years of experience in AV operations, workplace technologies, unified collaboration, enterprise support, or event production.

  • Experience leading global or distributed teams, including employees, contractors, and vendor partners.

  • Strong people-leadership skills, with a track record of developing talent, building team capability, and improving team performance.

  • Proven ability to support executive stakeholders and deliver high-pressure, high-visibility events.

  • Advanced knowledge of AV systems, workplace technologies, UC platforms, SaaS tools, and support operations.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to make sound decisions in complex, fast-moving environments with limited oversight.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in Computer Science, Networking, Audiovisual, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Expertise

  • Experience with AV-over-IP, UC platforms, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, QSC, Dante, Crestron, Shure, Ross Ultrix, audio consoles, and related production systems.

  • Working knowledge of networking concepts that impact AV performance, including Wi-Fi, DNS, QoS, VLANs, and enterprise connectivity.

  • Understanding of security, collaboration platform governance, service accounts, shared storage, and event services best practices.

  • Ability to document standards and train support teams on consistent AV and event support practices.

Preferred Experience

  • Dante, CTS, Jamf, Q-SYS, or related certifications.

  • Experience standardizing event formats such as all-hands, town halls, fireside chats, and executive meetings.

  • Strong understanding of audio and video signal flow, production workflows, and IT networking principles.

  • Experience building alignment with senior decision-makers and acting as a proactive thought partner.

  • Ability to lead complex initiatives and solve ambiguous problems with creativity, ownership, and minimal oversight.

title: Vice President, Global Affairs
descriptionHtml:

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About Global Affairs at Okta:

Okta’s Global Affairs organization is a newly consolidated, highly strategic function designed to drive business growth, navigate and shape regulatory landscapes, and advance our mission to build a more secure, inclusive, and sustainable world. Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer, this unified Global Affairs team brings together Government Affairs, Sustainability & Responsible Technology, and Social Impact & Nonprofit Go-To-Market (Okta for Good). 

We operate at the critical intersection of public policy, trust, commercial strategy, and social good. Together, this team ensures Okta meets and promotes rigorous AI governance, sustainability, and compliance requirements of our largest enterprise and public sector customers, while advocating for public policy that advances Okta’s business and maintaining Okta’s strong brand reputation and cultural impact. 

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Vice President of Global Affairs: a commercially-minded executive with a strong background in government affairs and public policy, coupled with a demonstrated ability to champion a corporate impact function. The ideal candidate is a strategic operator, a compelling storyteller, passionate about technology’s ability to lift communities, and a seasoned leader capable of navigating complex ecosystems—from public sector leaders and regulators to enterprise customers and global nonprofit partners.

This leader will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer and serve as a vital bridge between Okta’s legal and compliance frameworks, our responsible stewardship programs and our Go-To-Market (GTM) machinery. You will provide executive-level air cover for our durable business growth and success while relying on highly seasoned, domain-expert leaders to run the day-to-day operations of the team. You will be a thoughtful, courageous and publicly vocal proponent of Okta’s Global Affairs efforts.

This leader will oversee three critical pillars of Okta's business:

Government Affairs & Public Sector Growth

  • Lead Okta’s global Government Affairs strategy, navigating and shaping regulatory environments and advancing Okta’s public policy priorities through thought leadership and advocacy.
  • Partner directly with Okta’s GTM and public sector sales leaders to accelerate pipeline and unlock new commercial opportunities.
  • Help expand Okta’s thought leadership in critical technology domains, helping us fulfill our vision to free everyone to safely use any technology.
  • Expand the capacity and reach of the Government Affairs function by leveraging cross-trained talent across the Global Affairs organization.

Sustainability & Responsible Technology

  • Oversee Okta’s sustainability strategy, disclosures, and compliance with escalating customer and regulatory requirements (including protecting and accelerating deal flow).
  • Drive the successful reset and Board approval of Okta’s Science-Based Targets for emissions reductions.
  • Champion a robust, centralized Responsible AI governance program across the business and our customers.

Social Impact & Okta for Good

  • Oversee Okta’s nonprofit business and product donation commitment, partnering with GTM to drive growth while balancing social impact.
  • Oversee Okta’s donor-advised fund, including the execution of our current $50M philanthropic commitment and the development of a future funding strategy.
  • Champion Okta’s award-winning culture of giving, sustaining high employee engagement and brand value.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

  • Set a unified, bold strategy for Global Affairs that directly supports Okta’s commercial growth in large enterprise and public sector markets.
  • Serve as an executive champion for trust, responsible AI, and mission-aligned growth.
  • Represent Okta with senior external stakeholders, including government officials, regulators, enterprise customers, nonprofit partners, and investors.
  • Present vision and operations to employees, executives and board members on an ongoing basis.

Go-To-Market (GTM) Integration

  • Operate a powerful overlay model across GTM to drive revenue via Okta’s compliance readiness, sustainability commitments, and nonprofit product offerings.
  • Ensure Okta is positioned as a trusted partner to the public sector and our most highly regulated customers.

Operational Excellence & Team Leadership

  • Manage and develop a high-performing leadership team acting as a leader and champion of leaders.
  • Foster a culture of cross-pollination, allowing team members to expand their domain expertise across government affairs, ESG, and social impact.
  • Strengthen cross-functional relationships with GTM, Sales, Product, Marketing, Security, and the broader Legal organization.

What We’re Looking For:

Experience and Technical Expertise

  • 15+ years of experience spanning Government Affairs, Public Policy, Global Affairs, Social Impact, and/or Corporate Strategy. 
  • Strong, demonstrated background in Government Affairs and public sector engagement is required.
  • Executive-level experience in fast-paced, complex organizations (enterprise SaaS or technology experience highly preferred).
  • While deep day-one expertise in Government Affairs, ESG or Philanthropy is not strictly required, you must possess a demonstrated ability and passion for championing policy, cultural, brand, and social impact functions.
  • Senior-level financial oversight experience, including managing large operating and/or philanthropic budgets.

Competencies

  • Commercial Acumen: A deep understanding of how public policy, sustainability, and social impact directly drive revenue and mitigate enterprise risk.
  • Storytelling & Advocacy: Exceptional communicator and storyteller, with proven external speaking and public advocacy experience in high stakes settings.
  • Leadership Presence: Calm, grounded leadership presence with the ability to influence C-level executives and the Board of Directors.
  • Systems Thinking: Strong systems thinking and the ability to manage ambiguity with confidence, uniting disparate functions into a cohesive strategy.
  • Talent Development: A track record of empowering seasoned domain experts while providing the executive air cover they need to scale their impact. 

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in cybersecurity, identity, trust, or AI governance.
  • Existing relationships with key policymakers, regulators, and industry coalitions relevant to Okta’s business.

Auth0, an Okta company, is the leading customer identity platform for developers. Our mission is to secure the world’s identities so innovators can innovate. As AI reshapes how applications are built and used, identity and security are becoming critical to enabling safe and trusted agentic experiences.

Our team builds Auth0 products for Agentic AI with a focus on agent identity, access management, and protocols that extend trust to our customers’ AI products. This includes enabling secure experiences for enterprise agents and the emerging class of personal agents that act on behalf of individuals.

The role is for a highly technical product manager who is adept at developing strong, customer-focused product strategies.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Execute the AI Product Strategy: Drive the roadmap and execution for Auth0’s AI portfolio, with a specific focus on Auth0 for AI Agents. Identify tactical integration opportunities and ecosystem partnerships that secure agentic workflows and deliver immediate value to developers.
  • Be an Owner and Builder (0-to-1): Bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset to define, prototype, and launch new capabilities for AI applications. Balance rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required to scale features into secure, production-grade products.
  • Collaborate and Influence Without Authority: Serve as the core product owner and direct collaborator for engineering, design, and security teams. Translate the broader AI product vision into concrete, technical requirements, managing the backlog to ensure the timely delivery of developer-friendly features.
  • Engage Directly with Developers and Customers: Gather direct feedback from the developer community and early adopters. Actively uncover pain points in AI implementation, including the needs of organizations building personal agents, and validate that Auth0’s AI capabilities solve real-world problems.
  • Be an AI Standards Expert: Strategize and implement emerging standards in AI and identity, with a focus on Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability, and the protocols that enable trusted agentic experiences.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive adoption of secure AI products.

Requirements

  • Senior Product Management Experience: 5–7+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of building world-class agentic products. Experience with B2C and B2B SaaS, as well as developer-facing products, is strongly preferred.
  • Agentic AI Developer Credibility: Deep understanding of the emerging agent ecosystem, including personal agents. Ability to write code, work directly with APIs and SDKs, and build prototypes that validate customer and developer needs. Has defined and shipped successful API or SDK products for developer usage.
  • Deep Technical Acumen and Hands-On Developer Credibility: Strong understanding of identity protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML, as well as AI protocols and technologies including MCP and mTLS.
  • Proven “0-to-1” and Feature Launch Experience: Demonstrated success in building and launching new products, features, or programs from scratch, and executing the technical roadmap to scale them. Strong bias for execution and rapid prototyping. Startup founder or early-stage employee experience is a significant plus.
  • Exceptional Product Instincts: Ability to deeply understand developer pain points, security requirements, and friction in AI experiences, translating them into compelling, secure, and integrated product experiences.
  • Growth Mindset with Technical Depth: An individual contributor who is highly comfortable diving into technical API specifications, data schemas, and AI standards while collaborating on a Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.
  • Collaboration and Influence Without Authority: The ability to drive alignment and lead through influence in a highly cross-functional organization, working daily with engineering, design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales teams.
  • Excellent Communication Skills: Consistently demonstrates an understanding of their audience when communicating by appropriately simplifying the message. The ability to concisely articulate complex technical architectures, developer workflows, and product value propositions clearly to both internal engineering teams and external developers.
  • Passion for AI and Identity: A genuine enthusiasm for the potential of AI and a deep, demonstrable interest in the future of secure identity for users and agents.

title: Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Overview 

At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you’ll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we’re researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta’s portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

The Finer Print 

You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research & Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

In this role, you have the opportunity to:

  • Lead a holistic, human-centered approach to design.
  • Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long-term strategy for your product area.
  • Design and facilitate co-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
  • Craft user-centered artifacts and end-to-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
  • Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
  • Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
  • Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
  • Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team-level and design practice and process improvements.
  • Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
  • Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
  • Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
  • Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
  • Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You have experience leading cross-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
  • You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
  • You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day-to-day design workflow.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
  • You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
  • You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
  • You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
  • You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation.
  • You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
  • Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
  • You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
  • Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
  • Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
  • Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
  • Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)

descriptionHtml:

Okta's Strategic Sourcing and Procurement (SS&P) team is looking for an experienced Procurement/Category Manager (Technology Sourcing) to join our energetic Strategic Sourcing team to support and be part of Okta's continued growth. You will lead and co-lead the Sourcing initiatives supporting our Technology organization globally. This includes leading complex, high-value sourcing projects, activities & contract negotiations for various IT service and product categories that may include Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony and other direct or indirect requirements on a local or global scale.

This role will be responsible for procurement strategy development and execution, conducting strategic sourcing events and negotiating acceptable terms and conditions with Suppliers. The position will perform data analytics and work collaboratively with senior stakeholders and other Strategic Sourcing team members to meet stakeholder supply market requirements, create value, ensure process compliance and drive negotiated cost savings and avoidances.

You will be expected to build relationships with internal business partners working with cross-functional groups to support negotiations, risk mitigation and supplier management.

You will report to the Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology.

This hybrid office role, 2 days a week in office, requires being based in either Bellevue, WA, or the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Category Strategy & Planning:  Actively develop sourcing strategies in support of business initiatives for Technology categories (Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, AI, and related technology requirements), working with internal partners to identify risks and dependencies.
  • Sourcing & Project Management:  Lead and support all aspects of the strategic sourcing process, including RFx, supplier evaluations, and day-to-day commercial contract negotiations and projects.
  • Contract Negotiation:  Lead commercial term negotiations for project-level agreements and partner with Legal on Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and related exhibits, applying strong negotiation and legal acumen to secure favorable terms on high-stakes, high-dollar technology contracts.
  • Cost Optimization & Risk Management:  Use experience and industry expertise to find and execute cost optimization opportunities within assigned categories, improving service levels and driving efficiency.  Identify and mitigate both internal and external risks associated with technology purchase transactions.
  • Stakeholder Partnership:  Build effective, strategic relationships with senior business stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy) to align sourcing initiatives with business requirements, ensuring policies and procedures are followed and met.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Drive supplier performance review meetings with key suppliers within assigned categories, and measure performance against contract SLAs and expectations, managing remediation as required. 
  • Process Governance & Compliance: Work with Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy, and other subject matter authorities within Okta to ensure that policies and procedures are followed and met. 
  • Data Analysis & Reporting:  Conduct spend analytics within assigned categories to identify opportunities for streamlining and consolidation of spend, and provide findings and recommendations to leadership. 

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in Sourcing and Procurement of Technology (Infrastructure, SaaS, Telecom, IaaS, AI, etc.), including category management, strategic sourcing, consulting, vendor management, risk management, and/or procurement in a large, global company environment (Required)
  • Strong Negotiation & Legal Acumen: Deep understanding of tech contract law, commercial terms, and risk requirements
  • Agile & Pragmatic Decision-Maker: Instinctively differentiates between high-stakes, irreversible commitments and fast, two-way/reversible choices
  • High Ownership & Velocity: Ability to take full responsibility for multiple fast-moving projects and consistently deliver in a high-tempo environment with tight deadlines
  • Self-Starter Mentality: Proven ability to manage competing priorities and thrive independently in a dynamic, fast-paced setting with general guidance from more senior roles
  • Technical Systems Experience: Proficiency in Workday Strategic Sourcing (Scout), Coupa, or Ironclad is a strong plus
  • Flexibility: Ability to travel as needed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPSM, or CPIM.
  • Experience supporting M&A-related sourcing activity, including contract novation and consolidation.
  • Technical Systems Experience: Proficiency in Workday Strategic Sourcing (Scout), Coupa, or Ironclad is a strong plus
  • Flexibility: Ability to travel as needed
